en: Do you have those moments that just stick out in your mind?
ko: 유난히 머릿속에 콕 박혀 있는 순간, 그런 거 있지 않아?

en: Those ones that just stay with you forever?
When I was a kid, I was told you are what you do...
ko: 어릴 때 이런 말을 들었어. 네가 하는 일이 곧 너라고...

en: So choose wisely.
And I tried to choose doctor...
That didn't take.
I can still hear them, you know, "this... this just isn't for you." But I knew what they meant, "this just isn't you."
ko: 아직도 그 말이 들려. "이건... 이건 너한테 안 맞아." 근데 무슨 뜻인지 알았어. "이건 네가 아니야."

en: That's probably not a problem for you, is it, buddy?
ko: 너한텐 그런 고민 없지, 그렇지, 친구?

en: Chomper, world's best pup and friend. Chaser of squirrels, smeller of city streets, and chewer of literally everything.
ko: 촘퍼, 세상에서 제일 멋진 강아지이자 내 친구. 다람쥐 추격자, 도시 거리의 냄새 탐정, 그리고 말 그대로 모든 걸 씹어대는 녀석.

en: See, you know exactly who you are.
ko: 봐, 넌 네가 누군지 정확히 알잖아.

en: I wish I could say the same. I probably should've had a back up plan, huh? I guess I haven't exactly made the best decisions lately.
ko: 나도 그렇다고 말할 수 있으면 좋겠다. 플랜 B 정도는 있었어야 했나? 요즘 내가 썩 좋은 결정만 한 건 아니니까.

en: Except for adopting you, of course. Without you, I'd be pretty lost.
ko: 물론 널 입양한 건 빼고. 네가 없었으면 난 완전히 길을 잃었을 거야.

en: And I sure as hell wouldn't be out on this road in the middle of nowhere, Alaska.
ko: 그리고 이렇게 알래스카 한복판 외딴 길 위에 있지도 않았겠지.

en: But, we needed a fresh start and I've dreamed of dog sledding since I was a kid. Margot made the races sound incredible.
ko: 그래도 우린 새 출발이 필요했고, 난 어릴 때부터 개썰매를 꿈꿨어. 마고가 들려준 경주 이야기는 정말 굉장했거든.

en: And from how you've dragged me up and down the streets of San Francisco, I think you have dog racing dreams too.
ko: 샌프란시스코 거리를 이리저리 날 끌고 다닌 걸 보면, 너도 개썰매 경주를 꿈꾸는 것 같아.

en: Well, let's go assemble us a team, huh, Chomper. We need 4 more pups to start training.
ko: 자, 우리 팀을 꾸리러 가 보자, 촘퍼. 훈련을 시작하려면 강아지가 네 마리 더 필요해.

en: Oh! Hey, we just passed mile marker 32!
So, the ad said just after this mile marker there'd be a kennel with a dog sledding veteran we could adopt. I figure we can check out the pup and maybe add some experience to our team.
ko: 광고에 따르면 이 표지판을 지나자마자 개썰매 베테랑을 입양할 수 있는 견사가 있대. 가서 녀석을 보고, 우리 팀에 경험을 좀 더해 볼까 해.

en: Especially since we're a bit new.
You've always wanted a best friend.
We need someone who can match our drive.
ko: 우리 열정을 따라올 수 있는 녀석이 필요해.

en: And you can't carry this sled and gear on your own... even if you think you can.
ko: 그리고 너 혼자서 이 썰매랑 장비를 다 끌 순 없어... 네가 할 수 있다고 생각해도 말이야.

en: Let's find someone that complements your squirrel hunting obsessions. Maybe a calmer pup?
ko: 네 다람쥐 사냥 집착을 보완해 줄 녀석을 찾아보자. 좀 더 차분한 강아지는 어때?

en: I'm tired of people thinking we can't cut it.
ko: 우리가 못 해낼 거라고 생각하는 사람들, 이제 지긋지긋해.

en: Oh, you're not a small fella, are ya? They said you were big, but you're gonna make Chomper look like he was mixed with a corgi.
ko: 오, 넌 작은 녀석이 아니구나? 크다고는 들었는데, 너 옆에 있으면 촘퍼가 코기 섞인 것처럼 보이겠다.

en: You're actually kind of intimidating...
Ok, it sounds like you've gotten into a few fights out there in the wilderness.
ko: 좋아, 듣자 하니 야생에서 싸움을 꽤 벌였나 보네.

en: And that you always stuck by your Musher's side, but they were afraid that you would jump into a fight you couldn't win.
ko: 그리고 늘 머셔 곁을 지켰지만, 네가 이길 수 없는 싸움에 뛰어들까 봐 걱정했대.

en: But now you've become restless, being stuck back in the kennel, howling at night for the wild you can't get to.
ko: 그런데 지금은 견사에 갇혀서 몸이 근질근질하고, 갈 수 없는 야생을 그리며 밤마다 울부짖는다고.

en: Well, we're hopefully going to have a nice training run out to a new home... we'll see plenty of wild things, I'm sure.
ko: 음, 우린 새 보금자리까지 멋진 훈련 주행을 할 거야... 야생 동물도 잔뜩 보게 되겠지.

en: And I'd like to avoid the fights I can't win, too.
ko: 그리고 나도 이길 수 없는 싸움은 피하고 싶어.

en: I think this could be good for both of us.
ko: 우리 둘 다한테 좋은 일이 될 것 같아.

en: Alright...
What do you think?
You wanna join our team?
I'm sorry, but you're not what we need.
ko: 미안하지만, 넌 우리가 찾는 녀석이 아니야.

en: I like the look of you too. Come on, time to meet, Chomper.
ko: 나도 네가 마음에 들어. 가자, 촘퍼를 만날 시간이야.

en: I like the look of you too. Let's hop in the van and you can meet the rest of the crew.
ko: 나도 네가 마음에 들어. 밴에 타. 나머지 친구들을 소개해 줄게.

en: It looks like you've got a pretty good life here.
ko: 여기서 꽤 잘 지내고 있는 것 같네.

en: It was great meeting you, Barkley.
I'm not sure I understand why they call you Barkley. You haven't made a single sound since I met you. Should we give you a new name? Something that reflects your quiet nature?
ko: 왜 다들 널 바클리라고 부르는지 모르겠어. 만난 뒤로 한 번도 짖지를 않았잖아. 새 이름을 지어 줄까? 조용한 네 성격에 어울리는 걸로?

en: Mouse
Slippers
Snoozer
Mouse sounds nice, right?!
Slippers it is. What do you think?
Snoozer is definitely a better fit.
Alright so not quiet, just one to pick your moments. I will make sure to listen. So let's keep Barkley, then.
ko: 좋아, 조용한 게 아니라 때를 가릴 줄 아는 거구나. 네 말에 귀 기울일게. 그럼 바클리로 그냥 두자.

en: Noodle, huh? I can see that.
They said running alone wasn't enough for you. You were looking for some kind of challenge and a musher who'd listen to you too.
ko: 혼자 달리는 걸로는 성에 안 찼다고 들었어. 뭔가 도전할 거리와, 네 말도 들어 줄 머셔를 찾고 있었다고.

en: Well, I don't really know what I'm doing, so having some help out there might be nice.
ko: 음, 사실 난 내가 뭘 하는지도 잘 모르니까, 거기서 도움을 받으면 좋을 것 같아.

en: You sound perfect.
Do you always just lay on the ground?
ko: 넌 항상 그렇게 바닥에 누워 있니?

en: You don't look very enthusiastic.
You just need something to motivate you. Perhaps a new adventure and a new family?
ko: 동기 부여가 좀 필요할 뿐이야. 새로운 모험이랑 새 가족은 어때?

en: You still like to run, right? I promise we'll still get plenty of rest. You look ready for snugs.
ko: 아직 달리는 거 좋아하지? 쉬는 시간도 충분히 줄게. 껴안고 뒹굴 준비가 된 얼굴인걸.

en: Are you ready for the retired life or you just waiting for someone to believe in you again?
ko: 은퇴 생활을 할 준비가 된 거야, 아니면 누군가 다시 믿어 주길 기다리는 거야?

en: Just know that I still have to make the calls and try to do what's best for us. Will that work for you?
ko: 그래도 결정은 내가 내려야 하고, 우리에게 최선인 걸 하려고 노력할 거란 건 알아 둬. 그래도 괜찮겠어?

en: Welcome to the team, Noodle.
I don't think you're what I'm looking for.
ko: 넌 내가 찾는 녀석이 아닌 것 같아.

en: Let's hop in the van and I'll introduce you to Chomper.
Ready to go meet the rest of the new team?
ko: 새 팀의 나머지 친구들을 만나러 갈 준비 됐어?

en: Enjoy your nap.
Well, welcome to the van. This is Chomper. He's a city pup, but he's ready to get out there and learn how to become a sled dog.
ko: 자, 밴에 온 걸 환영해. 얘는 촘퍼야. 도시 강아지지만, 썰매견이 되는 법을 배우러 나갈 준비가 됐어.

en: It sounds like you weren't too big of a fan of indecision last time you raced?
ko: 지난번 경주 때 우유부단한 걸 별로 안 좋아했나 보네?

en: And that I should trust you when I'm not sure what's best.
ko: 그리고 내가 뭐가 최선인지 모를 땐 널 믿어야 한다고.

en: I can work with that.
ko: 그 정도는 맞춰 줄 수 있어.

en: You're going to have to listen me.
We'll find a good compromise.
I'm more than willing to defer to you if your instincts are sharp. I trust that you're a smart pup, Noodle, and I need help with more than running.
ko: 네 직감이 날카롭다면 기꺼이 네 판단에 따를게. 넌 똑똑한 강아지라고 믿어, 누들. 그리고 달리는 것 말고도 도움이 필요해.

en: I get that you think you might know best, and that you definitely know Alaska better than me, but sometimes I have to make the call. I've got a lot to balance here on our trip home.
ko: 네가 더 잘 안다고 생각하는 것도, 알래스카를 나보다 훨씬 잘 아는 것도 알아. 그래도 가끔은 내가 결정을 내려야 해. 집으로 가는 이 여정에서 신경 쓸 게 많거든.

en: How bout I take the lead on most decisions, but if I'm unsure you can help me out.
ko: 대부분의 결정은 내가 내리고, 내가 확신이 없을 때 네가 도와주는 건 어때?

en: But you can't just lay down in the middle of the trail, okay? We've got a new life to start. And once we're home, I'll build you a nice little den with a perfect nap zone.
ko: 그래도 길 한복판에 그냥 드러누우면 안 돼, 알았지? 우린 새 삶을 시작해야 하니까. 집에 도착하면 완벽한 낮잠 공간이 있는 멋진 굴을 만들어 줄게.

en: How's that sound?
Alright, you're right. Rest up. We've got plenty of running ahead of us.
ko: 좋아, 네 말이 맞아. 푹 쉬어. 앞으로 달릴 일이 잔뜩 있으니까.

en: You look like a force to be reckoned with.
Gale, is it?
I don't think you'll be needing much motivation. You might need more than a nudge in the right direction, but looks like you'll set your sights on a destination and get there.
ko: 넌 동기 부여가 별로 필요 없겠다. 올바른 방향으로 살짝 미는 것 이상이 필요할지도 모르지만, 목적지를 정하면 끝까지 가는 타입 같아.

en: I'll probably have to make sure you take some time to rest so we can keep this energy up.
ko: 이 에너지를 유지하려면 네가 쉬는 시간을 꼭 갖게 챙겨야겠어.

en: Want to join the team?
I don't know if I can manage you.
ko: 내가 널 감당할 수 있을지 모르겠어.

en: I'm not sure I'm ready for you. One day, I hope I am.
ko: 아직 널 맞을 준비가 안 된 것 같아. 언젠가는 준비가 되면 좋겠다.

en: You really want that window open.
ko: 창문 열어 주는 게 그렇게 좋아?

en: Do you always need the wind in your fur?
ko: 넌 항상 털에 바람을 맞아야 하니?

en: Yeah, it can be hard to be cooped up.
ko: 그래, 갇혀 있는 건 힘들 수 있지.

en: Did you know you're about to venture into the vast expanse of the Alaskan wilderness?
ko: 너 이제 곧 광활한 알래스카 야생으로 떠난다는 거 알아?

en: That should be fun.
Vast is a big word.
Yeah, who knows what's out there. Snow, for sure. And plenty of running, but I'm sure we'll be surprised by what we find. That's what adventure's all about.
ko: 그래, 저기 뭐가 있을지 누가 알겠어. 눈은 확실하고, 달릴 일도 많겠지. 그래도 분명 뭔가 놀라운 걸 발견할 거야. 그게 모험이잖아.

en: I guess you'll have plenty of room to run. Just let's try to stay somewhat on track. I'm not sure what's out there.
ko: 달릴 공간은 충분하겠다. 그래도 경로에서 너무 벗어나진 말자. 저기 뭐가 있는지 모르니까.

en: Do you think you're ready for that, girl?
We've got a pretty good team assembled so far. Some speed, some strength, some smarts. I think we just might be alright.
ko: 지금까지 꽤 괜찮은 팀을 꾸렸어. 속도도 있고, 힘도 있고, 머리도 있고. 이 정도면 해볼 만할지도.

en: You're the first one on our team. You and Chomper. I might need to get someone to keep you both in line.
ko: 넌 우리 팀 첫 번째 멤버야. 너랑 촘퍼. 너희 둘을 단속할 녀석을 하나 구해야 할지도 모르겠다.

en: I can't wait to just let you loose and pull us along.
ko: 너를 풀어 주고 우릴 끌고 달리는 걸 빨리 보고 싶어.

en: It's easy to tell that's your true calling. Get you in your element. Never let that wind leave your fur.
ko: 그게 네 천직이라는 게 딱 보여. 네 무대로 데려가 줄게. 털에 늘 바람이 스치도록.

en: Dear god your eyes are blue. They're brighter than the sky, Stilton.
ko: 세상에, 눈이 정말 파랗네. 하늘보다 더 맑아, 스틸턴.

en: And you don't seem to miss a thing. You're keeping a constant watch.
ko: 그리고 넌 뭐 하나 놓치는 게 없구나. 늘 지켜보고 있어.

en: I bet you know everything that goes on, huh, old boy?
ko: 돌아가는 일은 다 알고 있지, 영감님?

en: You're supposed to be retired, but sounds like you've been keeping tabs on the pups and leading their training runs.
ko: 은퇴한 몸이라더니, 강아지들을 지켜보면서 훈련 주행까지 이끌고 있었다며.

en: You still got another race in you?
ko: 경주 한 번 더 뛸 힘 남아 있어?

en: I'll leave you to retirement.
I know some pups that would love to have you around.
ko: 널 정말 좋아할 강아지들을 알고 있어.

en: I know a pup that would love to have you around.
ko: 널 정말 좋아할 강아지를 하나 알고 있어.

en: Seems like you've got a nice thing going here. Enjoy it, buddy.
ko: 여기서 잘 지내고 있는 것 같네. 즐겨, 친구.

en: Soooo, meet the team. I think we're a pretty great bunch. You should have fun here.
ko: 자~ 팀원들 소개할게. 우리 꽤 괜찮은 무리라고 생각해. 여기서 즐겁게 지낼 거야.

en: Soooo, meet Chomper. Hey, Chomps, could you stop nibbling on your paw and say hello?
ko: 자~ 촘퍼를 소개할게. 야, 촘프스, 발 좀 그만 깨물고 인사해 줄래?

en: You've got, like, a cold fire in those eyes. People shouldn't give up on you so quickly.
ko: 네 눈엔 뭐랄까, 차가운 불꽃이 있어. 사람들이 널 그렇게 빨리 포기하면 안 됐는데.

en: But I guess some people get obsessed with crushing the competition and they don't see the value of a well-rounded team.
ko: 하지만 어떤 사람들은 경쟁자를 짓밟는 데만 집착해서 균형 잡힌 팀의 가치를 못 보나 봐.

en: We can't all be speedsters or beasts. Sometimes, you need a pup who can let you know when you're steering the team into trouble... or a moose.
ko: 모두가 스피드광이나 괴물일 순 없어. 가끔은 팀을 위험으로... 아니면 무스한테로 몰고 갈 때 알려 줄 강아지가 필요하지.

en: I hear moose are more threatening than bears. Is that true?
I'm going to take that growl as a yes.
We're out here to become a real dog musher and, hopefully, one day, win a race or two.
ko: 우린 진짜 머셔가 되려고, 그리고 언젠가 경주에서 한두 번 우승하려고 여기 온 거야.

en: We've got to prove we can hack it out here.
ko: 우리가 여기서 버틸 수 있다는 걸 증명해야 해.

en: We need to find out what we're made of.
Sometimes you just need a new challenge.
Nothing is going to stop us. It's just us and the world. We own our fate here.
ko: 아무것도 우릴 막을 수 없어. 우리와 이 세상뿐이야. 우리 운명은 우리가 정해.

en: I feel like I lost myself back in the city. I need to know I can accomplish a dream.
ko: 도시에서 나 자신을 잃어버린 것 같아. 꿈을 이룰 수 있다는 걸 확인하고 싶어.

en: Yeah, you get caught up in your head about what you can and can't do. This will show us what we're really capable of.
ko: 맞아, 할 수 있는 것과 없는 것에 대해 머릿속에서만 맴돌게 되잖아. 이번 여정이 우리가 진짜 뭘 할 수 있는지 보여 줄 거야.

en: We're glad to have you, Stilton. I don't know what this ride is going to be like, but we're definitely going to have an adventure.
ko: 와 줘서 기뻐, 스틸턴. 이 여정이 어떨지는 모르겠지만, 분명 모험이 될 거야.

en: Igloo! Where are you, girl?
You know you have a house right there? You don't have to be in the snow.
ko: 바로 저기 네 집 있는 거 알지? 눈밭에 있을 필요 없잖아.

en: Right, home is where you make it, huh, Iggy?
ko: 그래, 정 붙이면 거기가 집이지, 그렇지, 이기?

en: Well aren't you just a big, ole snowball?
Big, fluffy, loud...
These are qualities we need.
I don't think you're the best fit.
ko: 넌 우리랑 잘 안 맞을 것 같아.

en: You're a lovely pup, but you seem pretty happy here. Take care, pal.
ko: 넌 사랑스러운 강아지지만, 여기서 꽤 행복해 보여. 잘 지내, 친구.

en: So your owners said you're ready for an adventure, that you love being out in the wild, but they've grown too old for the risks of what's out there.
ko: 주인분들 말로는 네가 모험할 준비가 됐고 야생을 정말 좋아하는데, 이제 본인들이 나이가 들어서 바깥의 위험을 감당하기 힘들어졌대.

en: Well, I think we can make this happen. We've got a new life to start.
ko: 음, 우리가 해낼 수 있을 것 같아. 우린 새 삶을 시작해야 하니까.

en: Can you help protect us?
We've got the risks under control.
It'll be an adventure for all of us.
You seem ready to be the wall we need if we get into trouble and we'll all have each other's backs.
ko: 문제가 생기면 우리한테 필요한 방패가 되어 줄 준비가 된 것 같네. 우린 서로를 지켜 줄 거야.

en: But if things go off plan, we might need your help.
ko: 하지만 계획대로 안 되면 네 도움이 필요할지도 몰라.

en: But everything should be, right? You only get nervous when you're doing something new. Let's awaken those nerves!
ko: 근데 원래 다 그런 거 아냐? 새로운 걸 할 때만 긴장되는 법이지. 그 긴장감을 깨워 보자고!

en: Uh, did you move your house here?
ko: 어, 너 네 집을 여기로 옮겼니?

en: I don't have any snacks, Bodega.
Why didn't I bring snacks? They said he's been eating them out of house and home.
ko: 왜 간식을 안 챙겨 왔지? 얘가 집안 살림 거덜 낼 정도로 먹어 치운다고 했는데.

en: Well...
Maybe you could help carry all the meat we'll get.
ko: 우리가 잡을 고기 나르는 걸 도와줄 수 있겠다.

en: I don't know if I can handle feeding you.
ko: 너 먹여 살릴 수 있을지 모르겠다.

en: Yeah, I think you'll be a great addition to the team.
ko: 그래, 넌 팀에 큰 보탬이 될 거야.

en: Come on. Let's go.
But, not yet. Next time.
Take care, Bodega.
Ok, I know I barely have enough food for all of us, but that's part of the adventure. We're going to find our food. We're going to live off the land!
ko: 좋아, 다 같이 먹을 식량이 빠듯하다는 거 알아. 근데 그것도 모험의 일부야. 우리 식량은 우리가 구할 거야. 자연에서 얻어서 살아가는 거지!

en: Just imagine it...
We're going to have the heaviest sled...
ko: 세상에서 제일 무거운 썰매를 끌게 될 거야...

en: We'll catch what we need, when we need it.
ko: 필요할 때 필요한 만큼 잡으면 돼.

en: We get to be part of nature!
With food spilling over the sides! We'll show everyone we can handle this and the long winter ahead. And now that we've got you, I have no doubt we can carry it all home.
ko: 양옆으로 식량이 넘쳐흐를 만큼! 우리가 이 일도, 앞으로 올 긴 겨울도 해낼 수 있다는 걸 모두에게 보여 주자. 이제 네가 있으니, 전부 집까지 실어 나를 수 있을 거라고 확신해.

en: We'll live a life that's not wasteful. We'll be in control of everything and only take what we need, when we need it; we'll keep your belly from grumbling and you can help carry us all home.
ko: 낭비 없는 삶을 살 거야. 모든 걸 우리가 통제하고, 필요할 때 필요한 만큼만 취하는 거지. 네 배가 꼬르륵거리지 않게 해 줄 테니, 넌 우리 모두를 집까지 끌어 줘.

en: Who knows what's out there! Well, besides bears & wolves & weasels & caribou & lots of creatures & soon us, but, it'll be amazing! We'll follow our hearts and stomachs to find our way home.
ko: 저기 뭐가 있을지 누가 알겠어! 뭐, 곰이랑 늑대랑 족제비랑 순록이랑 온갖 동물들, 그리고 곧 우리도 있겠지만, 정말 멋질 거야! 마음과 배가 이끄는 대로 집까지 가는 길을 찾자.

en: We only have to worry about ourselves out here. A big reset button for all of us. We get to start something new. Become someone new. I feel like I'll like wilderness me.
ko: 여기선 우리 자신만 신경 쓰면 돼. 우리 모두를 위한 거대한 리셋 버튼이지. 새로운 걸 시작하고, 새로운 사람이 되는 거야. 야생의 나도 꽤 마음에 들 것 같아.

en: She believes in herself... at least she does right now.
ko: 얘는 자기 자신을 믿어... 적어도 지금은.

en: And I believe in you, Bodega. That's why you're part of the team.
ko: 그리고 난 널 믿어, 보데가. 그래서 네가 우리 팀인 거야.

en: Hey, girl. Are you Fin?
Quite the collection you've gathered here?
Are these all things you've found?
They said you're pretty good with your nose. You tend to follow that more than anything else.
ko: 코가 꽤 좋다고 들었어. 무엇보다도 코가 이끄는 대로 따라간다고.

en: Sometimes that led you to good things, sometimes it led you to skunks.
ko: 가끔은 좋은 걸 찾아냈고, 가끔은 스컹크를 찾아냈다며.

en: Your owners got tired of skunks, huh. Well...
I might need a tracking dog.
I'm only looking for dogs that like to run.
ko: 난 달리는 걸 좋아하는 개만 찾고 있어.

en: I don't really know my way out there.
We might need some help to find more than just the trail.
ko: 길 말고도 찾아야 할 게 많을 테니 도움이 필요할지도 몰라.

en: And while you might not be the best at running, it'd be great to have some help to know what to do.
ko: 네가 달리기를 제일 잘하진 않아도, 뭘 해야 할지 알려 줄 녀석이 있으면 정말 좋겠어.

en: I'm looking to become a champion.
I know I've got to get started and learn the ways of Alaska first, but I've got long term goals to think about.
ko: 먼저 시작해서 알래스카의 방식부터 배워야 한다는 건 알지만, 장기적인 목표도 생각해야 해.

en: I don't know if I want to lose sight of them.
But, I suppose, we're not just out here to race, we're not even racing yet.
ko: 그래도 뭐, 우린 경주만 하려고 여기 온 건 아니지. 아직 경주를 시작한 것도 아니고.

en: We've got to figure out how we plan to live out here. How we plan to support ourselves.
ko: 여기서 어떻게 살아갈지, 어떻게 먹고살지 알아내야 해.

en: There's a lot I don't know about the Alaskan bush.
ko: 알래스카 오지에 대해선 모르는 게 많아.

en: It's probably important that I try to recognize that I don't know what I don't know.
ko: 내가 뭘 모르는지조차 모른다는 걸 인정하는 게 중요하겠지.

en: Ok, Fin...
You want to join our team?
You should stay here.
It seems like we could use a smart dog with a nose for the trail on our team.
ko: 길을 찾는 코를 가진 똑똑한 개가 우리 팀에 있으면 좋을 것 같아.

en: We'd love to have you, Fin.
It seems like you've got a good thing going here.
ko: 여기서 잘 지내고 있는 것 같네.

en: You can curate your collection.
ko: 네 수집품도 잘 관리할 수 있고.

en: And you still get plenty of long walks to sniff out new treasures.
ko: 새로운 보물을 찾아 냄새 맡을 긴 산책도 실컷 할 수 있잖아.

en: Enjoy it, Fin.
It was great meeting you.
Chomper, I'd like to introduce you to Fin.
Hey, team, I'd like to introduce you all to Fin.
Fin comes to us, well, from the Alaskan bush, just like many of you do.
ko: 핀은, 음, 너희 대부분처럼 알래스카 오지에서 왔어.

en: Well, except for you, Chomper.
So, Fin, you like collecting things, huh?
ko: 그래서 핀, 물건 모으는 걸 좋아한다고?

en: Chomper is the same. Every morning I wake up and he's piled up all my shoes in my bed and is using them as a pillow.
ko: 촘퍼도 똑같아. 매일 아침 일어나 보면 내 신발을 전부 침대에 쌓아 놓고 베개로 쓰고 있어.

en: It's probably not quite the same.
Your family said, you'd never come back in from walks, always yearning to discover more out there.
ko: 가족분들 말로는, 넌 산책을 나가면 들어올 생각을 안 했대. 늘 바깥에서 더 많은 걸 발견하고 싶어 했다고.

en: But you had a tendency to not know when you should stop and take a break.
ko: 그런데 언제 멈추고 쉬어야 할지 잘 모르는 경향이 있었다며.

en: You'd just push and find yourself too tired to get back easily.
ko: 계속 밀어붙이다가 너무 지쳐서 돌아오기 힘들어졌다고.

en: Sounds like we'll have the right kind of adventures, then. We're going to keep going and rest along the way to, well, wherever.
ko: 그럼 우리랑 딱 맞는 모험을 하게 되겠네. 우린 계속 나아가면서 중간중간 쉴 거야. 어디로든 말이야.

en: We're going to prove we belong out there.
ko: 우리가 저곳에 어울린다는 걸 증명할 거야.

en: We're going to find our place in nature.
ko: 자연 속에서 우리 자리를 찾을 거야.

en: We'll see what nature has in store for us.
ko: 자연이 우리에게 뭘 준비해 뒀는지 보자.

en: And it sounds like you feel the same.
We'll probably have to make some decisions we don't want to, but that's how we find out what we truly are.
ko: 원치 않는 결정을 내려야 할 때도 있겠지만, 그렇게 우리가 진짜 어떤 존재인지 알게 되는 거야.

en: I don't know what's going to be out there.
I know what I've read, and what's likely to happen.
ko: 책에서 읽은 것도 있고, 무슨 일이 일어날지 대충은 알아.

en: But if the past few years have taught me anything, it's that I can only plan to be surprised.
ko: 하지만 지난 몇 년간 배운 게 있다면, 놀랄 각오밖에 할 수 없다는 거야.

en: Chomper, you approve?
We're happy to have you, Fin.
Oh, you're right. We're nearly at the next stop.
ko: 오, 네 말이 맞아. 다음 정거장에 거의 다 왔어.

en: Thanks.
You mind if I give you a pet?
Ok, well that's pretty good.
Maybe we'll get to a pet eventually, but I'll accept a cautious sniff.
ko: 언젠간 쓰다듬게 해 주겠지. 지금은 조심스러운 킁킁 한 번으로 만족할게.

en: Hey! Chomper, you have to take it slow too. She's not ready for you and your lack of personal boundaries.
ko: 야! 촘퍼, 너도 천천히 해야지. 얘는 아직 너랑 너의 선 없는 친화력을 받아들일 준비가 안 됐어.

en: Uh... Slayer?
Move closer.
Stay back.
I'm just going to come a little closer to get a good look at you.
ko: 너를 잘 보려고 조금만 가까이 갈게.

en: Never mind. I will stay right here. How does that sound?
I'll give you your distance.
Looks like you might need some time to get to know me.
ko: 나랑 친해질 시간이 좀 필요한가 보네.

en: I get it.
Your family did say you're a bit skittish.
ko: 가족분들도 네가 좀 겁이 많다고 했어.

en: Are you really afraid of balloons?
Yeah, I've got some weird fears too. I mean, they're totally rational. I think it's just good sense to be afraid of manhole covers.
ko: 그래, 나도 이상한 공포증이 좀 있어. 아니, 완전히 합리적인 거야. 맨홀 뚜껑을 무서워하는 건 그냥 상식이라고 생각해.

en: You can fall in. Bad stuff could come out. That's clearly the beginning of the end.
ko: 빠질 수도 있잖아. 이상한 게 튀어나올 수도 있고. 그건 명백히 종말의 시작이야.

en: Ok, well, that's not exactly why I moved out here, but I don't think I have to worry about manhole covers anymore.
ko: 좋아, 그게 내가 여기로 이사 온 이유는 아니지만, 이제 맨홀 뚜껑 걱정은 안 해도 될 것 같아.

en: And it sounds like you're very fast. I suppose knowing when and how to escape when you're afraid of everything is a perfectly fine skill.
ko: 그리고 듣자 하니 넌 엄청 빠르다며. 모든 게 무서울 땐 언제 어떻게 도망칠지 아는 것도 꽤 훌륭한 재주지.

en: You have to be prepared for anything.
We'll run when we need to.
I'm not sure what's going to happen.
We're not looking to run from anything.
If we have to, we might, but we're here to face it all.
ko: 어쩔 수 없다면 도망칠 수도 있지만, 우린 모든 걸 정면으로 마주하려고 왔어.

en: To see what we're really made of.
I think it's just as important to know when to get yourself out of there as it is to know you can handle a challenge.
ko: 도전을 감당할 수 있다는 걸 아는 것만큼, 언제 빠져나와야 할지 아는 것도 중요하다고 생각해.

en: I can't say for sure I know what's going to happen on this trip to the cabin.
ko: 오두막까지 가는 이번 여정에서 무슨 일이 일어날지 확실히는 모르겠어.

en: It sounds like it should be pretty straightforward, but I know nothing is.
ko: 꽤 간단할 것 같지만, 세상에 간단한 일은 없다는 걸 알아.

en: So we'll try to just follow what we think is right.
ko: 그러니 그냥 옳다고 생각하는 대로 해 보자.

en: Well, Slayer, what do you think?
I've got a bunch of pups you might like too.
ko: 너도 좋아할 만한 강아지들이 잔뜩 있어.

en: I've got a good pup with me too. I think you'll like him.
ko: 나한테도 좋은 강아지가 하나 있어. 너도 그 녀석을 좋아할 거야.

en: Adopt Slayer.
You seem like you want to stay.
ko: 여기 있고 싶어 하는 것 같네.

en: Slayer, if you're ready, I am too.
Maybe once we're settled, I'll come back for you.
ko: 자리 잡고 나면 데리러 올지도 몰라.

en: Great meeting you, Slayer.
Welcome to the van, Slayer.
Chomper, say hi.
Team, say hi.
You're just a big sweet heart.
But with a name like Slayer, people know not to mess with you.
ko: 그래도 슬레이어 같은 이름이면 아무도 함부로 못 건드리겠지.

en: We're on our way to our new home and you look very much ready for the journey.
ko: 우린 새 보금자리로 가는 중인데, 넌 여행 준비가 완벽하게 된 것 같아.

en: You might be put in positions that are a bit scary out there.
ko: 저기선 좀 무서운 상황에 처할 수도 있어.

en: I'm not quite sure what we'll see.
ko: 우리가 뭘 보게 될지 잘 모르겠어.

en: But that's what this adventure is for me too.
ko: 하지만 그게 나한테도 이 모험의 의미야.

en: I needed to know what I was actually capable of.
ko: 내가 실제로 뭘 할 수 있는지 알아야 했어.

en: But we have to know we're ready..
ko: 하지만 우리가 준비됐다는 걸 확인해야 해.

en: But we'll manage..
But we'll find our limits.
If I can handle things out here, I'll be fine for what's back in the city.
ko: 여기서 버틸 수 있다면, 도시에서의 일도 괜찮을 거야.

en: We have to find our balance. Strike when we need to and, more importantly, know when to run.
ko: 균형을 찾아야 해. 필요할 땐 공격하고, 더 중요한 건 언제 도망칠지 아는 거야.

en: We'll see what we can truly handle and what else we might be afraid of.
ko: 우리가 진짜로 뭘 감당할 수 있는지, 또 뭘 무서워하는지 알게 되겠지.

en: I'm sure it'll put things in perspective.
Nothing is as scary as manholes.
And I think you'll find you're stronger than you expect.
ko: 그리고 넌 네 생각보다 강하다는 걸 알게 될 거야.

en: Fin is joining us from a family from way out here.
ko: 핀은 이 먼 곳에 사는 가족에게서 왔어.

en: We'll go deeper and uncover what's out there for us.
ko: 더 깊이 들어가서 우리를 기다리는 게 뭔지 알아내자.

en: If you could help make sure I don't miss anything that I can't see, that'd be great.
ko: 내가 못 보는 걸 놓치지 않게 도와주면 정말 좋겠어.

en: Are you a pup that can smell porcupines and can keep your nose out of trouble? I hope so.
ko: 넌 호저 냄새를 맡고 말썽에 코를 들이밀지 않는 강아지니? 그랬으면 좋겠다.

en: Cause I'd be happy to avoid whatever trouble I can.
ko: 피할 수 있는 말썽은 피하고 싶거든.

en: And do my best to adapt to what's in front of me.
ko: 그리고 눈앞의 상황에 최선을 다해 적응할 거야.

en: We'll follow you to find the suprises we need, cause we all know we'll need food once we set up our new spot.
ko: 우리에게 필요한 놀라운 것들을 찾도록 널 따라갈게. 새 보금자리를 차리면 다들 식량이 필요할 테니까.

en: Well, you ready?
So you decided which way to go if your driver didn't?
ko: 운전자가 길을 못 정하면 네가 정했다는 거야?

en: We need 4 more dogs to get started with our training team. We have 7 stops left. I'm sure we'll find the pups for us.
ko: 훈련 팀을 시작하려면 개가 네 마리 더 필요해. 남은 정거장은 일곱 곳. 분명 우리랑 맞는 녀석들을 찾을 거야.

en: Looks like the next kennel is just up ahead, let's see who's there, Chomper.
ko: 다음 견사가 바로 앞이야. 누가 있는지 보자, 촘퍼.

en: Just a few more miles to our next stop.
ko: 다음 정거장까지 몇 마일만 더 가면 돼.

en: We're looking for 3 more pups to fill out our team to help us get to our new home.
ko: 새 보금자리까지 데려다줄 팀을 채우려면 강아지 세 마리가 더 필요해.

en: You're right, Chomper. You can't do this on your own.
ko: 네 말이 맞아, 촘퍼. 너 혼자서는 못 해.

en: Oh, hey, our next stop is here. I'll go see who they have for us.
ko: 오, 다음 정거장에 도착했어. 어떤 녀석이 있는지 보고 올게.

en: I'm not sure if I'm picking you based on your skills or just cause I can't pass up a pup, but I am very excited about this team we've put together.
ko: 내가 실력을 보고 고르는 건지 그냥 강아지를 지나칠 수 없어서 고르는 건지 모르겠지만, 우리가 꾸린 이 팀이 정말 기대돼.

en: We have 6 stops to go and we only need to adopt 2 more dogs.
ko: 남은 정거장은 여섯 곳이고, 두 마리만 더 입양하면 돼.

en: Sometimes you just have to be patient.
We'll find you a good buddy, Chomper.
We only have 5 stops left, so if we like a pup, we should probably adopt them.
ko: 남은 정거장이 다섯 곳뿐이니, 마음에 드는 강아지가 있으면 입양하는 게 좋겠어.

en: Okay, so far so good. 2 pups out of the 3 stops is a great start.
ko: 좋아, 지금까진 순조로워. 정거장 세 곳에서 두 마리면 훌륭한 출발이야.

en: We only need to adopt 2 more dogs and we have 5 more stops.
ko: 두 마리만 더 입양하면 되고, 정거장은 다섯 곳 남았어.

en: I think we'll be ok.
This is going so well!
We've adopted every pup we've met so far... and we have 5 more stops to find our final team member.
ko: 지금까지 만난 강아지는 전부 입양했어... 그리고 마지막 팀원을 찾을 정거장이 다섯 곳 남았어.

en: I just can't decide. I'll have to leave it up to fate, Chomper.
ko: 도저히 못 고르겠어. 운명에 맡겨야겠다, 촘퍼.

en: The next 4 dogs we meet will make up our pack and our new family.
ko: 다음에 만나는 네 마리가 우리 무리이자 새 가족이 될 거야.

en: I know they'll be the right ones for us.
ko: 분명 우리에게 딱 맞는 녀석들일 거야.

en: And we've almost arrived to the trail, so we'll need to adopt 3 of the next 4 pups we meet.
ko: 이제 트레일에 거의 다 왔으니, 다음에 만날 네 마리 중 세 마리를 입양해야 해.

en: We're starting a new life and we have to be a little bit picky.
ko: 새 삶을 시작하는 거니까 조금은 까다롭게 골라야 해.

en: I want to make sure we have a well-rounded team.
So we've got 4 more stops to find our last 2 pups.
ko: 마지막 두 마리를 찾을 정거장이 네 곳 남았어.

en: That should work.
Ok, adopting dogs is so easy!
ko: 좋아, 개 입양하는 거 너무 쉽잖아!

en: I basically just love all of you.
Our team is almost complete and I've only met a few dogs.
ko: 몇 마리 만나지도 않았는데 팀이 거의 완성됐어.

en: We've got 4 more stops to find our last team member.
ko: 마지막 팀원을 찾을 정거장이 네 곳 남았어.

en: I think I fell in love with every dog I met.
ko: 만나는 개마다 다 반해 버린 것 같아.

en: I mean, who could pass up a dog that's ready for a new home?
ko: 아니, 새 집을 기다리는 개를 누가 그냥 지나칠 수 있겠어?

en: A new adventure?
I can't believe it. We are really about to do this. We've got an incredible team here and all that's left is for us to head out to our new home.
ko: 믿을 수가 없어. 우리 진짜로 이걸 하는구나. 정말 굉장한 팀이 꾸려졌고, 이제 새 보금자리로 떠나기만 하면 돼.

en: Well, you can't rush things. It took us a while to find our first pup, but I'm sure the next 3 will be perfect additions.
ko: 음, 서두를 순 없지. 첫 번째 강아지를 찾는 데 시간이 좀 걸렸지만, 다음 세 마리는 분명 완벽한 팀원이 될 거야.

en: Looks like we're nearly at the next stop.
ko: 다음 정거장에 거의 다 온 것 같아.

en: This team is really coming together.
ko: 팀이 정말 제대로 모양을 갖춰 가고 있어.

en: We have 3 more stops until we reach the trail and 2 pups to adopt.
ko: 트레일까지 정거장 세 곳이 남았고, 입양할 강아지는 두 마리야.

en: We're nearly a complete pack!
Only one more pup and the team is done and we still have 3 more to meet.
ko: 강아지 한 마리만 더 있으면 팀 완성인데, 아직 만날 녀석이 셋이나 남았어.

en: This is going to be such a hard decision.
I'm so happy you were such a good match.
ko: 너희가 이렇게 잘 맞아서 정말 기뻐.

en: I mean, we knew we'd find the right ones for us, we just had to be patient.
ko: 뭐, 우리에게 맞는 녀석들을 찾을 거란 건 알았어. 인내심이 필요했을 뿐이지.

en: Actually the right pups find you, don't they, Chomper?
ko: 사실 맞는 강아지가 우릴 찾아오는 거야, 그렇지, 촘퍼?

en: We are getting so close to a complete team!
Ok, we've got a few more stops left and we only need 1 more pup.
ko: 좋아, 정거장이 몇 곳 남았는데 강아지는 한 마리만 더 있으면 돼.

en: I know we'll find the right one.
ko: 분명 딱 맞는 녀석을 찾을 거야.

en: We're really building a great team here.
ko: 우리 정말 멋진 팀을 꾸리고 있어.

en: Alright, our final dog is just up ahead. You wait here.
ko: 좋아, 마지막 녀석이 바로 앞에 있어. 여기서 기다려.

en: I can't wait to get to know you all better and let you do the thing you love most: run.
ko: 너희를 더 잘 알게 되고, 너희가 제일 좋아하는 걸 하게 해 줄 날이 기다려져. 바로 달리기 말이야.

en: Looks like the next kennel is just up ahead. Let's see who's there, Chomper.
ko: 다음 견사가 바로 앞에 있는 것 같아. 누가 있는지 보자, 촘퍼.

en: It's time to go home, pups.
You ready to help us train?
You're in charge.
You all ready?
Everyone back in position?
You're all hooked in now, right?
Margot said to travel to the end of the road and then hop on the sled and travel a few days more.
ko: 마고가 길 끝까지 간 다음에 썰매를 타고 며칠 더 가라고 했어.

en: We'd know her cabin by the red lantern hanging by the door.
ko: 문 옆에 걸린 빨간 랜턴을 보면 그녀의 오두막인 걸 알 수 있을 거래.

en: She gave us this map...
It's, uh, not as helpful as I'd like...
But it'll get us there. We just have to pick our path.
ko: 그래도 거기까진 데려다줄 거야. 우린 길만 고르면 돼.

en: And go by some trees, and snow, and whatever else isn't drawn on here...
ko: 그리고 나무랑, 눈이랑, 여기 안 그려진 온갖 걸 지나가면 되겠지...

en: Where did she say the cabin is again?
Oh, right the cabin is supposed to be...
I can't believe we made it to Alaska, Chomper.
ko: 우리가 알래스카에 왔다니 믿기지 않아, 촘퍼.

en: So, you're going to have to take the lead. It's a lot of responsibility looking out for a team but I think you're ready for it.
ko: 그래서 네가 선두를 맡아야 해. 팀을 이끄는 건 책임이 큰 일이지만, 넌 준비가 된 것 같아.

en: Are you ready to find our new home? Yeah, me too.
ko: 우리 새 보금자리를 찾으러 갈 준비 됐어? 그래, 나도.

en: Alright… let's make sure we have what we need.
ko: 좋아... 필요한 게 다 있는지 확인해 보자.

en: We've got our team…
Barkley
Slayer
Gale
Fin
Stilton
Bodega
Iggy
Noodle
And the sled is all ready to go…
We've packed the bare essentials to get us started, but we're going to have to live off the land once we get to our cabin, so we might as well start training for that now too, right?
ko: 시작할 때 필요한 최소한의 물품은 챙겼지만, 오두막에 도착하면 자연에서 얻어서 살아야 하니까 지금부터 그 훈련도 시작하는 게 좋겠지?

en: Two pieces of raw meat.
You pups can handle the uncooked, raw, and cold food...
ko: 너희는 익히지 않은 차가운 날음식도 먹을 수 있지...

en: the kind we'll also find on the trail.
ko: 트레일에서도 구할 수 있는 그런 거 말이야.

en: But I'm going to have to cook that up if I don't want to freeze my insides.
ko: 하지만 나는 속이 얼어붙지 않으려면 익혀 먹어야 해.

en: Hypothermia is not something I'm looking to try.
We'll be able to set up camp once we get properly out on the trail.
ko: 트레일에 제대로 들어서면 야영을 할 수 있을 거야.

en: I scrounged up this old gun and a couple of bullets.
ko: 낡은 총이랑 총알 몇 발을 구해 왔어.

en: Just in case.
So we'll make do with what we have. We can use them to hunt or keep them around in case we need to protect ourselves.
ko: 있는 걸로 버텨야 해. 사냥에 쓸 수도 있고, 우릴 지켜야 할 때를 대비해 아껴 둘 수도 있어.

en: It is the wilderness, after all.
You know, bears, moose, wolves... skunks.
Oh! And most importantly we've got 1 med pack.
I should be able to bandage us up if something happens.
ko: 무슨 일이 생기면 붕대 정도는 감아 줄 수 있을 거야.

en: Ok, well, I guess we should start!
What do they say again?
Mush on!
Let's go!
On way!
That doesn't sound right, but, hey, it worked!
Let's make it our own.
Where did she say this cabin is again?
I need to keep us both fed. Food is going to be hard to come by.
ko: 우리 둘 다 배를 채워야 해. 식량 구하기가 쉽지 않을 거야.

en: We've got an axe to help get us some wood.
ko: 장작을 구하는 데 쓸 도끼가 있어.

en: The gun is all cleaned up and ready to go.
Its aim should be a little more true now.
ko: 이제 조준이 좀 더 정확해졌을 거야.

en: The dogs all have their booties. They shouldn't need as much food.
ko: 개들 모두 덧신을 신었어. 식량이 덜 필요할 거야.

en: They should be able to run a little farther.
ko: 조금 더 멀리 달릴 수 있을 거야.

en: I packed us a fishing pole so we can fish when the opportunity presents itself.
ko: 기회가 생기면 낚시할 수 있게 낚싯대를 챙겼어.

en: And a fire starter. We don't need to worry about collecting birch.
ko: 그리고 부싯돌. 자작나무를 모으는 걱정은 안 해도 돼.

en: And we've got our trap.
We can never have too many ways to get food.
We can't even fit more food on the sled.
ko: 썰매에 식량을 더 실을 자리가 없어.

en: We even stopped for some extra food.
There's extra food.
And we have even more food.
You can never have too much food.
I bought us some wood to get us started.
ko: 시작할 때 쓸 장작을 좀 샀어.

en: And plenty of wood.
And more wood.
We have all the bullets we can carry.
ko: 들 수 있는 만큼 총알을 챙겼어.

en: And we grabbed a few more bullets just to be sure.
ko: 혹시 몰라서 총알을 몇 발 더 챙겼어.

en: We have more bullets.
We managed to get some more bullets too.
I've got every med pack I could find.
ko: 찾을 수 있는 구급상자는 다 챙겼어.

en: We have more med packs.
And there's an extra med pack.
We found an extra med pack in the van to pack.
We have pretty much everything we need.
We seem well prepared for what's ahead.
ko: 앞으로 닥칠 일에 대비가 잘 된 것 같아.

en: I think this life suits us.
ko: 이 삶이 우리한테 잘 맞는 것 같아.

en: I am feeling cautiously optimistic.
Ok, I think we have everything now. It's time for us to find home.
ko: 좋아, 이제 다 챙긴 것 같아. 집을 찾으러 갈 시간이야.

en: We've packed everything we can manage to fit on this sled.
ko: 썰매에 실을 수 있는 건 다 실었어.

en: Ready to set out on our adventure to a new home?
ko: 새 보금자리를 향한 모험을 떠날 준비 됐어?

en: So I guess it's time to start, huh.
We've already lived our nightmare scenario, we're ready for this.
ko: 이미 최악의 악몽을 겪어 봤으니, 우린 준비됐어.

en: I can't believe we're finally here.
Let's go find our new home.
Are we ready for what's out there?
I think we're ready to go.
I'm feeling good about this.
Let's get out there.
Ok, so there's just a creepy abandoned cabin sitting over there. Um...
ko: 좋아, 저기 으스스한 버려진 오두막이 하나 있네. 음...

en: Hello? Is anyone in there?
Sneak up to it.
We're not taking any chances. On by!
No answer.
That probably means it's safe, right?
I doubt they can hear us.
Do we check it out?
There might be something useful in there...
ko: 안에 쓸 만한 게 있을지도 몰라...

en: I can handle whatever's in there!
ko: 안에 뭐가 있든 감당할 수 있어!

en: I don't trust it. On way!
I'm sure it'll be fine.
Do I knock? I should knock, right?
Here we go...
Ok, let's go for it...
Cool. Cool. A Table, trash, broken things, stuffed bear, snow, more broken things.
ko: 좋아. 좋아. 탁자, 쓰레기, 부서진 물건들, 곰 박제, 눈, 또 부서진 물건들.

en: Not stuffed! Not stuffed!
Ahhhh! My coat! My ARM?!
Oh. Ok... yeah, um we're good. We're ok.
ko: 아. 좋아... 그래, 음, 우린 괜찮아. 괜찮아.

en: But seriously...
A bear. In a cabin?
What kind of nursery rhyme nightmare was that?
ko: 대체 무슨 동화 같은 악몽이었던 거야?

en: What kind of nursery rhyme nightmares are these.
Ok, just keep your eyes on the road, you're nearly there.
ko: 좋아, 길만 똑바로 보자. 거의 다 왔어.

en: And we'll be sure to be wary of any cabins we see.
Anything hiding in here?
ko: 여기 뭐 숨어 있는 거 있어?

en: Oooh. Bullets!
Oh, yes a med pack! I wish I could say I probably won't need this, but... yeah,  I probably will.
ko: 오, 구급상자다! 아마 필요 없을 거라고 말하고 싶지만... 그래, 아마 쓰게 되겠지.

en: It's empty. I guess I can salvage this broken table.
ko: 비어 있네. 이 부서진 탁자라도 건져야겠다.

en: Great. I found snow.
No, no, no. One squirrel bite is enough for me.
ko: 안 돼, 안 돼, 안 돼. 다람쥐한테 물리는 건 한 번이면 충분해.

en: No... another one?!
Wow, you have a lovely home.
Let's talk this out.
Raise rifle.
We'll be on our way.
Enjoy your happy home. May we never meet again.
ko: 행복한 집에서 잘 지내. 다시는 만나지 말자.

en: Except for when Chomper is around.
I don't think this is going to go well for you.
ko: 이건 너한테 좋게 안 끝날 것 같은데.

en: Eeeew. They do say "leave no trace."
I missed? I don't even. Huh.
You know what. I'm just going to leave you on your own.
ko: 있잖아. 그냥 너 혼자 있게 둘게.

en: Yeah, so I don't know if you know who I am.
I'd really appreciate it if you all stopped harassing Chomper. It's making it hard to drive.
ko: 다들 촘퍼 좀 그만 괴롭혀 주면 정말 고맙겠어. 운전하기 힘들잖아.

en: Do you know the squirrel abundance number here? Just curious.
ko: 여기 다람쥐 개체 수가 얼마나 되는지 알아? 그냥 궁금해서.

en: Oh. Woah. Less words, more getting the hell out of here. Got it.
ko: 오. 워. 말은 줄이고 여기서 빨리 뜨자는 거지. 알겠어.

en: [anim] The squirrel runs off, but a bullet is left on the table.
ko: [anim] 다람쥐는 도망가지만, 탁자 위에 총알 한 발이 남아 있다.

en: I guess that's a no.
Is this a warning? It kinda feels like a warning.
But that's not going to stop us from taking this.
ko: 그래도 이걸 가져가는 걸 막을 순 없지.

en: Awww, thanks. I might not use this on one of you.
ko: 아이고, 고마워. 이걸 너희한테는 안 쓸지도 몰라.

en: Oh great, a squirrel.
Please don't see it, Chomper. I know you love them, but just try to ignore it...
ko: 제발 보지 마, 촘퍼. 네가 얼마나 좋아하는지 알지만, 그냥 무시해...

en: He sees it...
Fine, let's check it out.
I'm going to hunt it.
Leave it alone. On way!
We've got priorities! Let's go!
See, he's just living his life.
ko: 봐, 쟤도 그냥 자기 삶을 사는 거야.

en: No meal is too small out here.
Ok. Well, maybe I was wrong about that. You were too small for my bullet.
ko: 좋아. 음, 내가 틀렸나 봐. 넌 내 총알에 비해 너무 작았어.

en: Chomper, lick up what you can and let's hit the trail.
ko: 촘퍼, 핥아 먹을 수 있는 건 다 먹고 다시 트레일로 가자.

en: Just leave it. Maybe it will throw off a predator.
ko: 그냥 둬. 포식자를 헷갈리게 할지도 몰라.

en: That should hold you over for a bit.
ko: 이거면 당분간 버틸 수 있을 거야.

en: A healthy dose of fear. A thing we probably all need.
ko: 건강한 수준의 두려움. 우리 모두한테 필요한 거지.

en: Um, he seems unperturbed by us, pups.
ko: 음, 쟤는 우리한테 전혀 동요하지 않는 것 같아, 얘들아.

en: Chomper... you, on the other hand, seem very perturbed. Is this your nemesis?
ko: 촘퍼... 반면에 넌 엄청 동요하는 것 같은데. 쟤가 네 숙적이야?

en: Wait, did it just wink?
I'm gonna shoot it. (Use bullet)
He does look tasty, Chomper. Go for it.
ko: 맛있어 보이긴 하네, 촘퍼. 가 봐.

en: I speak wink. I'm gonna wink back.
ko: 나 윙크 언어 할 줄 알아. 나도 윙크해 줄게.

en: I don't trust it either. Let's go.
Oh. Oh no.
CHOMPER! You downed it in one gulp!
Ok, fine. I'm proud of you.
Now, let's take that full belly back on the trail.
ko: 자, 그 빵빵한 배 데리고 다시 트레일로 가자.

en: And... the squirrel runs away.
But... but why?! How?
Actually, we're good. We're gone...
You're never gonna catch one, Chomper. No dog has.
ko: 넌 절대 못 잡을 거야, 촘퍼. 잡은 개는 아무도 없어.

en: They're just meant to be your nemesis.
Since I can't speak squirrel with my mouth, I'll try with my eyes?
ko: 입으로는 다람쥐 말을 못 하니까, 눈으로 해 볼까?

en: And wink.
Did I just say that out loud?
You're really starting to lose yourself out here.
I don't think I said what I thought I said...
ko: 내가 하려던 말을 한 것 같지 않은데...

en: It seems mad.
Are you mad?
Ok, what do we have here.
A bullet?!
Thank you for helping us.
Take bullet and go.
AHHHHHHHH!
What kind of insane squirrel are you?!
Chomper, it's ok. Let's just get out of here.
Wait! I thought we were gonna be friends!
ko: 잠깐! 우리 친구가 될 줄 알았는데!

en: I wonder if a predator would smell the meat we carry too?
ko: 우리가 싣고 다니는 고기 냄새도 포식자가 맡을까?

en: Should that stop us from hunting everything?
Or is the risk too great to pass up a meal?
ko: 아니면 끼니를 포기하기엔 위험이 너무 클까?

en: Do squirrels have rabies? Do I have rabies?
ko: 다람쥐도 광견병이 있나? 나 광견병 걸렸나?

en: I think I'm foaming at the mouth.
Wait...
Nope. Just my lips freezing over.
I think I'd prefer rabies.
You're right, Chomper, that squirrel did look menacing.
ko: 네 말이 맞아, 촘퍼. 그 다람쥐 진짜 위협적으로 생겼더라.

en: Again?
I can't keep falling asleep like this.
Should I pull over?
We'll properly sleep soon, I just need to keep my eyes open for a little longer.
ko: 곧 제대로 잘 거야. 조금만 더 눈 뜨고 버티면 돼.

en: I don't even...
I'm catastrophizing about squirrels in my dreams. Cool.
ko: 꿈속에서 다람쥐 때문에 최악의 상상을 하고 있잖아. 멋지네.

en: Is this why you growl in your sleep, Chomper?
ko: 이래서 네가 자면서 으르렁거리는 거니, 촘퍼?

en: I think I get it.
We've got a bit of a drive ahead of us, but I can make.
ko: 아직 운전할 길이 좀 남았지만, 해낼 수 있어.

en: I'll try not to fall asleep again.
This is the first step to showing we're made for something more.
ko: 이게 우리가 더 큰 일을 해낼 수 있다는 걸 보여 주는 첫걸음이야.

en: I'm certain I read that owls are good omens.
Or wait...
Didn't they mean certain death?
Yeah, owl good things come to those who wait.
ko: 그래, 부엉, 기다리는 자에게 좋은 일이 온다잖아.

en: Let's not press our luck. On way.
I remember!
Silent in flight, they only bring fright. Hoo they call out to find victims til light.
ko: 소리 없이 날아와 공포만 남기네. 부엉부엉 울며 새벽까지 제물을 찾네.

en: Oh, um...
Let's follow it anyway.
I have no need to tempt death today.
Sounds pretty good to me. What do you pups think?
ko: 꽤 괜찮은 것 같은데. 얘들아, 어떻게 생각해?

en: Let's follow it.
Leave it. On by.
Wait, the omen was about victims til light...
ko: 잠깐, 그 징조가 새벽까지 제물을 찾는다는 거였지...

en: Noodle, I trust what you want to do.
ko: 누들, 네가 하고 싶은 걸 믿을게.

en: Yeah! Silent in flight, they only bring fright. Hoo they call out, to find victims til light.
ko: 맞아! 소리 없이 날아와 공포만 남기네. 부엉부엉 울며 새벽까지 제물을 찾네.

en: Ok. Well, let's follow it anyway.
Nope nope nope. Am good now. Let's leave.
ko: 싫어 싫어 싫어. 이제 됐어. 가자.

en: Follow it is. Let's go, Noodle!
A good omen. That's what we needed, team!
What do we think it'll lead us to?
ko: 이게 우릴 어디로 이끌 것 같아?

en: So we've some birch. Good start.
Watch the owl.
Maybe it wants us to eat it.
ko: 우리가 저걸 먹길 바라는 걸지도 몰라.

en: Take the bark from the birch tree.
Leave
I've never seen an owl this close before.
ko: 부엉이를 이렇게 가까이서 본 건 처음이야.

en: So... what omen do you portend?
ko: 그래서... 넌 무슨 징조를 알려 주는 거야?

en: We can't go back... we haven't done anything yet.
ko: 돌아갈 순 없어... 아직 아무것도 안 했잖아.

en: If I go back now, I'll have failed. Again.
ko: 지금 돌아가면 또 실패하는 거야. 또다시.

en: And Chomper is ready to run. He's hungry for competition among other things...
ko: 그리고 촘퍼는 달릴 준비가 됐어. 경쟁에 굶주려 있거든. 다른 것에도...

en: You're probably not going to eat through the gang line and run off into the woods.
ko: 설마 갱라인을 씹어 끊고 숲으로 도망가진 않겠지.

en: Right?
RIGHT? Stop corn cob biting the gang line!
ko: 그렇지?! 갱라인을 옥수수 먹듯 깨물지 마!

en: Are you seriously chewing the gangline again? No wonder you all keep getting out.
ko: 진짜로 또 갱라인을 씹고 있는 거야? 어쩐지 자꾸 빠져나가더라.

en: Note to self: double wrap the gang line near Chomper.
ko: 메모: 촘퍼 근처 갱라인은 두 겹으로 감을 것.

en: I hear you, Chomper. Let's get back to running!
Oh, was that a gift?!
Inspect the pellet.
Grab some birch bark
Mush on.
Bones. Bones. Bones. Right. It's just full of bones.
At least someone is eating well out here.
ko: 적어도 여기서 잘 먹고 사는 녀석이 하나는 있네.

en: If I shoot you does that change the omen?
Shoot the owl.
Leave.
You've given me a lot, good omen. Including the thing I really needed...
ko: 넌 나한테 많은 걸 줬어, 길조야. 내가 정말 필요했던 것까지...

en: I just can't pass up any chance for food, good omen or not.
ko: 길조든 아니든, 먹을 걸 구할 기회는 절대 놓칠 수 없어.

en: Why is bark so hard to rip off?!
ko: 나무껍질은 왜 이렇게 벗기기 힘든 거야?!

en: Thank you!
Thank you, person that left the axe behind. I didn't even break a sweat.
ko: 도끼를 두고 간 분, 고마워요. 땀 한 방울 안 흘렸어.

en: Omens are just luck good or bad.
Nothing we can control.
ko: 우리가 어쩔 수 있는 게 아니야.

en: I see you.
You!
Still you!
Am I seriously arguing with an owl?
ko: 내가 진짜로 부엉이랑 말싸움하고 있는 거야?

en: I'm going to shoot you now.
I'm not going to argue or tempt things. Let's go.
ko: 말싸움하거나 운을 시험하진 않을 거야. 가자.

en: I don't believe in black cats crossing my path, why would I believe in your bad omen?
ko: 검은 고양이가 앞을 지나가는 것도 안 믿는데, 네 불길한 징조를 왜 믿겠어?

en: You know you're just a fancy chicken, right? Or maybe like a sky penguin, sailing silently through the night air.
ko: 너 그냥 고급 닭인 거 알지? 아니면 밤하늘을 소리 없이 미끄러지는 하늘 펭귄 같은 거.

en: YOU! Man.
Stop responding like you understand me! It's creepy! You know what...
ko: 알아듣는 것처럼 대답하지 마! 소름 끼친다고! 있잖아...

en: Your death will be my omen.
ko: 네 죽음이 내 징조가 될 거야.

en: I don't know why I followed you. Leave.
ko: 내가 왜 널 따라왔는지 모르겠다. 떠난다.

en: Just show me your omen.
Was that hoo or you?
Yep, definitely lost my mind.
Fine, I have one last question...
Will I survive?
If I survive, will I find what I'm looking for?
ko: 살아남는다면, 내가 찾는 걸 찾게 될까?

en: Will this be worth it?
If a bad omen flies away does that mean we're going to be ok?
ko: 불길한 징조가 날아가 버리면 우린 괜찮다는 뜻일까?

en: It's not worth believing in omens. I'll believe in Noodle, instead.
ko: 징조 같은 건 믿을 가치가 없어. 대신 누들을 믿을래.

en: We've gotten this far together, Chomper. Let's finish what we started.
ko: 우리 여기까지 함께 왔잖아, 촘퍼. 시작한 걸 끝내자.

en: You know, I don't need to be afraid with Barkley at the lead. We've got this.
ko: 있잖아, 바클리가 선두에 있으면 겁낼 필요가 없어. 우린 할 수 있어.

en: I'll put my faith in me and you pups.
Ok, I really think you're saying "you" and not "hoo."
ko: 좋아, 너 진짜 '부엉'이 아니라 '너'라고 말하는 것 같아.

en: I guess that's a good thing?
Yeah, and I'm finding I'm a person who can conquer anything including what bad omens may bring.
ko: 그래, 그리고 난 불길한 징조가 몰고 올 일까지 포함해서 뭐든 이겨 낼 수 있는 사람이라는 걸 깨닫고 있어.

en: That was the hope. To find what we are capable of and what brink that'd take us to. I haven't done anything I regret... yet.
ko: 그게 바람이었어. 우리가 뭘 할 수 있는지, 그게 우릴 어느 벼랑 끝까지 데려갈지 알아내는 거. 아직 후회하는 일은 없어... 아직은.

en: And we'll discover what the world forces us to become. The world has not yet shown me I can trust it.
ko: 그리고 세상이 우리를 어떤 존재로 만들어 버릴지 알게 되겠지. 세상은 아직 믿어도 된다는 걸 보여 주지 않았어.

en: I think I would've preferred you to say "home."
Right, you're actually just an owl.
But I suppose I should question do I value this moment? This creature? This adventure?
ko: 그래도 스스로 물어봐야겠지. 난 이 순간을 소중히 여길까? 이 생명을? 이 모험을?

en: I'm here to prove I can start this new life, but haven't I already started?
ko: 새 삶을 시작할 수 있다는 걸 증명하러 왔는데, 이미 시작한 거 아닐까?

en: Haha. Right right! Time to run, huh, Stilton?
ko: 하하. 그래, 그래! 달릴 시간이지, 스틸턴?

en: Alright, Chomper, I hear your belly rumbling too.
ko: 좋아, 촘퍼, 네 배에서도 꼬르륵 소리가 들려.

en: Sounds like you pups are ready for what's next, huh?
ko: 다음 일을 할 준비가 된 것 같네, 얘들아?

en: I'm sure owl meat is tasty.
You're like a fancy chicken. I'm sure you taste similar.
ko: 넌 고급 닭 같아. 맛도 비슷하겠지.

en: Uhhh. Who said that?
Yep. Ok. I will be on my way now. I don't think I disturbed any spirits.
ko: 그래. 좋아. 이제 갈게. 혼령을 깨우진 않은 것 같아.

en: Ok, spooky ghost owl, just calm down. We're not afraid of you.
ko: 좋아, 무시무시한 유령 부엉이야, 진정해. 우린 너 안 무서워.

en: Yep. Bye. Sorry about that. Please don't hurt us.
ko: 그래. 안녕. 미안해. 제발 해치지 마.

en: Well that's disgusting...
I think I'll be on my way.
But we're hungry. (pull out rifle)
I'm just going to look in it.
So we've got some bones. A skull. More bones.
Did you eat anything useful?
ko: 쓸모 있는 거 먹은 거 있어?

en: You ate a bullet?!
It's a good thing you can pass pellets. The other method... well, um, yikes.
ko: 펠릿으로 토해 낼 수 있어서 다행이다. 다른 방법은... 음, 으악.

en: A key?! Where did you find a key? All these cabins barely have doors!
ko: 열쇠?! 열쇠를 어디서 찾았어? 이 오두막들은 문도 제대로 없는데!

en: Random key to a random who knows what. I guess I'll keep it and hope we get lucky.
ko: 뭔지도 모를 데에 맞는 아무 열쇠. 일단 챙겨 두고 운이 따르길 바라야지.

en: How far do owls travel anyway? Maybe it's close.
ko: 부엉이는 얼마나 멀리 다니지? 가까운 데일지도 몰라.

en: You're supposed to wait for my command, not gallavant into the night!
ko: 내 명령을 기다려야지, 밤중에 마구 쏘다니면 어떡해!

en: It could be evil!
Woah! Hold! Stop!
Ok, i guess we're following it. Here's hoping the omen is good...
ko: 좋아, 따라가는 수밖에. 좋은 징조이길 바라며...

en: You pups see that? It's a caribou!
Let's watch it.
Let's hunt it.
Leave it alone.
Just stay there...
Thank you, caribou. We appreciate you.
Got just what we needed.
Whew. We needed that bullet to count.
ko: 휴. 그 총알이 꼭 맞아야 했어.

en: Yes! A perfect shot.
Now for the part I like less. Meet you back at the sled, pups.
ko: 이제 내가 덜 좋아하는 부분이야. 썰매에서 보자, 얘들아.

en: Oh no.
Did you really have to run away after I hit you?
ko: 내가 맞히고 나서 꼭 도망가야 했니?

en: I could've tried again if you stayed here. You know, put you out of your misery, I guess.
ko: 네가 여기 있었으면 다시 쏠 수 있었는데. 고통을 끝내 줄 수 있었을 거야, 아마도.

en: But...
Now I have to leave this half done.
ko: 이제 반쯤 끝낸 채로 둬야 해.

en: Nature will balance this out.
I can't do anything now.
ko: 지금은 내가 할 수 있는 게 없어.

en: I'm here to finish what I started.
And if I find you again, I plan to.
ko: 다시 널 찾게 되면, 그렇게 할 거야.

en: Or maybe I'll find you again so I can balance things out on my own.
ko: 아니면 내 손으로 균형을 맞추려고 다시 찾게 될지도.

en: Not that I had a bullet to use if you stayed.
ko: 네가 그대로 있었다 해도 쏠 총알이 있었던 건 아니지만.

en: Maybe we'll run into later and I can help then.
ko: 나중에 다시 마주치면 그때 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라.

en: This is when we whisper, right?
Stay quiet and see if it stays
Try a caribou call
How did it know I was here?
ko: 내가 여기 있는 걸 어떻게 알았지?

en: Perfect.
Hunt it
Watch it
Let's just get back to the trail.
You've got this.
Seriously? I miss grocery stores.
Never pass up a meal.
I'm beginning to understand why caribou are so important up here. I can't wait to sleep under a caribou blanket.
ko: 순록이 왜 여기서 그렇게 중요한지 알 것 같아. 순록 가죽 담요 덮고 자는 날이 기다려져.

en: I don't know if I was properly prepared to face my food. Thank you, caribou, for helping all of us.
ko: 내 먹거리와 마주할 준비가 제대로 됐었는지 모르겠어. 고마워, 순록아. 우리 모두를 도와줘서.

en: I didn't expect to feel this powerful. Every aspect of my life is in my hands.
ko: 이렇게 강해진 기분일 줄은 몰랐어. 내 삶의 모든 게 내 손에 달려 있어.

en: Dinner is on the agenda!
Let's get this back to the sled.
Why couldn't that have been a perfect shot?
ko: 왜 완벽한 한 발이 될 수 없었던 거야?

en: We need to follow it. We can't leave it like that.
ko: 따라가야 해. 저렇게 둘 순 없어.

en: Something will find it. That's how nature works. And if it survives, good on it.
ko: 뭔가가 찾아내겠지. 그게 자연의 섭리야. 그리고 살아남는다면 잘된 거고.

en: We're not leaving this half done. We need to find it and finish what we started.
ko: 반쯤 끝낸 채로 두지 않을 거야. 찾아서 시작한 걸 끝내야 해.

en: I hope I just grazed it. I don't have any bullets to finish it if we find that caribou again.
ko: 그냥 스쳤길 바라. 그 순록을 다시 찾아도 끝낼 총알이 없어.

en: Oh, so just having a snack. Hmm.
ko: 오, 그냥 간식 먹는 중이구나. 흠.

en: Hunt it.
My stomach is growling too. Might be time to make a snack as well.
ko: 내 배도 꼬르륵거려. 나도 간식 먹을 때가 된 것 같아.

en: I wish I could eat brush. At least bushes don't need bullets.
ko: 나도 덤불을 먹을 수 있으면 좋겠다. 적어도 덤불엔 총알이 필요 없잖아.

en: We'll find the right snack for us too.
ko: 우리한테 맞는 간식도 찾게 될 거야.

en: Let's go.
Don't mind me.
So, yeah, they just, um...
Moo.
Grunt.
Shriek.
Hey you!
Mooooooooooo. Mooooooo. Mooo?
Whoops. I scared it.
Welp, back to the trail.
That worked?
My caribou is coming along much better than my squirrel.
ko: 내 순록 흉내가 다람쥐 흉내보다 훨씬 늘고 있어.

en: I am one with the animals now.
It's grunting. Wait... That's, that's what they do?!
What does it think I did?
Uhh...
Shoot it.
Moo again.
Run Away.
I'll try to make this not hurt.
Mooooooooooo.
Moooooooose!
Ok then.
Bye! Ignore what I said!
Grunnnnt.
Thank god I watched all those nature documentaries.
ko: 그 많은 자연 다큐멘터리를 본 게 천만다행이야.

en: I knew that would work!
Oh. That worked... Is it coming at us?
She waits and watches... what will the caribou do next?
ko: 그녀는 기다리며 지켜본다... 순록은 다음에 무엇을 할 것인가?

en: Did I just do a mating call?
ko: 내가 방금 짝짓기 울음소리를 낸 거야?

en: Does he think I'm a girl caribou?
Or does she think I'm boy caribou? They can all grow antlers...
ko: 아니면 날 수컷 순록이라고 생각하는 걸까? 걔들은 다 뿔이 자랄 수 있잖아...

en: You know... we don't need to ponder the concept of caribou identity right now...
ko: 있잖아... 지금 순록의 정체성에 대해 고민할 때가 아니야...

en: We need to...
Run away.
I didn't expect a call to work this well.
ko: 울음소리가 이렇게 잘 통할 줄은 몰랐어.

en: Yes! Nobody is starving tonight.
ko: 좋아! 오늘 밤엔 아무도 굶지 않아.

en: I knew I couldn't miss you.
Shoot again.
That was not a good use of my last bullet.
ko: 마지막 총알을 그렇게 쓰는 게 아니었는데.

en: The scavengers should just follow me if they want a meal.
ko: 청소동물들은 먹이를 원하면 그냥 날 따라오면 되겠다.

en: Ok, just stay there and I can finish this.
ko: 좋아, 그대로 있어. 그럼 끝낼 수 있어.

en: Seriously?! Don't you know we need to eat?
ko: 진짜?! 우리도 먹어야 한다는 거 몰라?

en: I really wish this was more of a sure thing.
I feel like I'm buying a candy bar out of a vending machine and it just won't fall.
ko: 자판기에서 초코바를 샀는데 안 떨어지는 기분이야.

en: Ugh.
Not sure mating calls are for me.
ko: 짝짓기 울음소리는 나랑 안 맞나 봐.

en: greeeeeeeppp!
greeeeeaaaaaap!
I should try that on a wolf.
Whoops. Scared you away.
I'll do better next time.
Ooh that worked!
Uhh, now what?
All right. Let's get you in my sights...
You were supposed to stay there!
Fine, back to the trail.
So you're just going to look at me?
ko: 그래서 그냥 날 쳐다보기만 할 거야?

en: Oh.
I should take my chances when I have them.
You're a big fella, aren't you?
It's ok, pups. I got this.
I'm going to check it out.
You're right. Let's leave.
Noodle, you really are risk averse, you know that?
Yeah, we don't need to force you into protector mode.
ko: 그래, 굳이 널 수호자 모드로 만들 필요는 없지.

en: I know you used to have antlers as treats, but we can't risk you leaping up on that elk.
ko: 예전엔 간식으로 사슴뿔을 받았던 거 알아. 그래도 네가 저 엘크한테 덤벼드는 위험은 감수 못 해.

en: I don't trust it either. Thanks for keeping watch.
ko: 나도 못 믿겠어. 망봐 줘서 고마워.

en: You do not like Elk. They freak me out too.
Yep. We'll keep running. This really is where you belong.
ko: 그래. 계속 달리자. 여기가 정말 네가 있어야 할 곳이야.

en: I know. Priorities. We don't need to weigh down the sled.
ko: 알아. 우선순위. 썰매를 무겁게 할 필요는 없지.

en: Right. Right. No crazy plans.
Oh, you're really close...
Reach out.
Pull out rifle.
Yep! Coming, Noodle!
Ok, I hear you, Stilton!
Warning heeded, Barkley!
You're making this feel really personal.
ko: 너 이거 정말 개인적인 일처럼 만드는구나.

en: Lower gun and leave.
I can't miss from here.
I know I can't only hunt when it makes me feel good, but I have enough food for now... so, I'm gonna go.
ko: 기분 좋을 때만 사냥할 순 없다는 거 알아. 그래도 지금은 식량이 충분하니까... 그냥 갈게.

en: I shouldn't have a problem with this, but I respect your lack of fear and I'm going to go.
ko: 이걸 망설일 이유는 없지만, 겁 없는 네 모습을 존중해서 그냥 갈게.

en: We'll see if I regret this decision. Staring down our next meal and then leaving it might be foolish.
ko: 이 결정을 후회할지 두고 보자. 다음 끼니를 노려보다가 그냥 떠나는 건 어리석은 짓일지도 몰라.

en: I don't know how I'm going to make it out here if I can't take the shots that will keep me alive.
ko: 살아남기 위해 필요한 한 발을 못 쏜다면, 여기서 어떻게 버틸지 모르겠어.

en: I just can't.
Well... that wasn't a great shot, but...
Always seize the opportunities when you have them. This will treat us well.
ko: 기회가 있을 땐 항상 잡아야 해. 이걸로 한동안 든든할 거야.

en: This is part of this life. Knowing what it actually takes to live... even if you have to face things you're not ready for.
ko: 이것도 이 삶의 일부야. 사는 데 실제로 뭐가 필요한지 아는 것... 준비되지 않은 것과 마주해야 하더라도.

en: This was always how this was going to have to go.
You really are majestic.
Uhhhhh. Ok.
I don't want to find out what that means.
ko: 그게 무슨 뜻인지 알고 싶지 않아.

en: Ok. Stay calm. Isn't this what I wanted?
ko: 좋아. 침착해. 이게 내가 원하던 거잖아?

en: Try to pet the elk.
Get out of there.
Too close! Too close!
Ok. ok. ok. Slow, steady movements.
You're beautiful. This was not a good idea, and should've have probably gotten me very hurt, but, uh, this is kind of life-changing.
ko: 넌 아름다워. 좋은 생각은 아니었고, 아마 크게 다쳤을 수도 있지만, 어, 이건 인생이 바뀌는 경험인데.

en: I don't know if I should do this again, though.
Oh, ok. Bye!
I am definitely putting that in my journal!
I pet an elk, pups!
Oh, you can smell it on me, can't you?
ko: 오, 내 몸에서 냄새가 나지, 그렇지?

en: Don't worry! I'd never replace you. It was a one time thing.
ko: 걱정 마! 절대 너희를 대신하진 않을 거야. 딱 한 번이었어.

en: Yeah, you're right. I owe you snacks.
ko: 그래, 네 말이 맞아. 간식 빚졌다.

en: I'm sorry, Fin! It was a terrible choice and food was definitely more important.
ko: 미안해, 핀! 최악의 선택이었고 식량이 훨씬 더 중요했어.

en: But I didn't have any bullets. What else was I supposed to do?
ko: 근데 총알이 없었다고. 그럼 어쩌라는 거야?

en: Right, not risk my life by petting a wild animal. There are signs and rules for a reason.
ko: 그래, 야생 동물을 쓰다듬다가 목숨을 걸진 말았어야지. 표지판이랑 규칙이 괜히 있는 게 아니니까.

en: Everyone likes pets.
Calm, soothing, pets.
So close! We could've been friends!
Pups! I need to use up all these unused pets!
ko: 얘들아! 못 쓴 쓰담쓰담을 너희한테 다 써야겠어!

en: Ahhh!
Ok. Yeah, should've expected that. There has never been a sign that says, 'please pet the wild animals.'
ko: 좋아. 그래, 예상했어야 했어. '야생 동물을 쓰다듬어 주세요'라는 표지판은 어디에도 없었으니까.

en: We're out of bandages, aren't we? I should've listened to you, pups. Pets for you only.
ko: 붕대 다 떨어졌지? 너희 말을 들었어야 했어, 얘들아. 쓰담쓰담은 너희한테만.

en: I'm coming pups. You were right. I might need to patch myself up soon.
ko: 지금 갈게, 얘들아. 너희 말이 맞았어. 곧 상처를 치료해야 할지도 몰라.

en: Ahh!
Owwwww. Yeah, he got me pretty good.
I might need to bandage this up so we can make it home.
But without you, I wouldn't have a chance to bandage myself up.
ko: 그래도 너희가 없었으면 붕대를 감을 기회조차 없었을 거야.

en: We've overcome enough on this. I almost pet an elk! I'm not afraid of anything.
ko: 이번 일로 충분히 많은 걸 극복했어. 엘크를 거의 쓰다듬었다고! 이제 무서운 게 없어.

en: Good thing I saved this bandage for me. I've almost made it home.
ko: 이 붕대를 날 위해 아껴 둬서 다행이야. 집에 거의 다 왔어.

en: I don't know why I expected that elk to respect me when I didn't respect it. It doesn't owe me anything, not even a pet.
ko: 내가 엘크를 존중하지 않았는데 왜 엘크가 날 존중해 주길 기대했을까. 엘크는 나한테 빚진 게 없어. 쓰다듬게 해 줄 의무조차.

en: We're nearly home. I'm a little beat up, but with you pups, I'm ready for this new life.
ko: 집에 거의 다 왔어. 좀 만신창이가 됐지만, 너희가 있으니 새 삶을 맞을 준비가 됐어.

en: Let's get out of here.
Why am I doing this?! I just got gored by an elk!
ko: 내가 왜 이러고 있지?! 방금 엘크 뿔에 찔렸는데!

en: Ok, well I didn't, but I could! And then what would happen to all of you?
ko: 좋아, 찔리진 않았지만, 찔릴 수도 있었어! 그럼 너희는 어떻게 되는 거야?

en: We're fine. That's not going to happen. (try again)
ko: 괜찮아. 그런 일은 없을 거야. (다시 시도)

en: This is a terrible idea. (quit)
Wait, is that a caribou?!...
Let's hunt.
Leave it be and continue on way.
On by!
Ok, ok. We'll keep running.
Just breathe and pull the trigger.
I hit it!
Fall! Please! That was my last bullet!
And it's still fine. Great.
Shoot again!
Leave it.
I guess someone else will get a nice meal later.
You will hit this caribou. You will kill this caribou.
ko: 넌 이 순록을 맞힐 거야. 넌 이 순록을 잡을 거야.

en: I missed? I shot right at it?!
Right, I was warned this gun was a little "off."
ko: 맞다, 이 총이 좀 '이상하다'는 경고를 들었었지.

en: I'm going to miss that bullet.
And... my dinner. Hopefully I can fix up this gun somehow.
ko: 그리고... 내 저녁도. 어떻게든 이 총을 고칠 수 있으면 좋겠는데.

en: Come on! I hit you. FALL!
Great. And now you take my last bullet? You're cruel, caribou.
ko: 좋아. 이제 내 마지막 총알까지 가져가? 잔인하구나, 순록아.

en: How are you surviving all these bullets?!
ko: 그 많은 총알을 맞고 어떻게 버티는 거야?!

en: You know what? Fine!
I'm shooting you again!
You win. I'll leave you to your fate.
No no no no! That's mine!!
ko: 안 돼 안 돼 안 돼! 그건 내 거야!!

en: Yeah, that's right! I did the work for this kill!
ko: 그래, 맞아! 이건 내가 잡은 거라고!

en: Yes! We did it! Food is ours!
We're pretty good at this.
Howl along with the dogs.
Alright, let's collect our bounty.
Awoooo!
Can you actually find food like that?
ko: 정말 그렇게 먹이를 찾을 수 있어?

en: I want to see if you can pull this off.
You're about to be my food.
ko: 넌 곧 내 먹이가 될 거야.

en: I'll leave you to your quest.
To think it just knows how to do this, knows how to survive.
ko: 이걸 본능적으로 알고 있다니. 살아남는 법을 알고 있다니.

en: We could all be so lucky.
Just pretend I'm not here. You've got this.
ko: 나 없는 셈 쳐. 넌 할 수 있어.

en: I should take lessons. I'll hunt this fox.
ko: 나도 배워야겠어. 이 여우를 사냥할 거야.

en: I'm probably disturbing what's beneath the snow. Let's go.
ko: 눈 밑에 있는 걸 방해하고 있나 봐. 가자.

en: You have some serious patience...
I believe. There's gotta be something in there.
ko: 난 믿어. 분명 저 안에 뭔가 있을 거야.

en: But, why am I wasting my time? Let's go.
ko: 근데 내가 왜 시간을 낭비하고 있지? 가자.

en: Good luck, little one.
Ok, maybe you don't have this...
But I have to know it's possible.
I'm going to starve out here too. Let's go.
Maybe I should've just hunted you...
So, you just keep going. You knew you were close and you had to push through.
ko: 그래, 넌 계속 나아가는구나. 가까이 왔다는 걸 알았고, 끝까지 밀어붙여야 했지.

en: I wonder how long it took for you to learn that?
Well that and some help from a little luck.
I can conquer this too. Thanks for the inspiration.
ko: 나도 이겨 낼 수 있어. 영감을 줘서 고마워.

en: Happy hunting, little one.
I hope that luck rubs off on me.
ko: 그 운이 나한테도 좀 묻어나면 좋겠다.

en: Just push through and do what you have to do. Got it.
ko: 그냥 밀어붙이고 해야 할 일을 하라는 거지. 알겠어.

en: Thanks, foxy.
I should've hunted you.
I need to have a killer instinct to survive. Cute be damned.
ko: 살아남으려면 냉혹한 본능이 필요해. 귀여운 건 상관없어.

en: Now do I shoot while you're halfway in the ground or while you're standing up?
ko: 땅에 반쯤 들어가 있을 때 쏠까, 일어서 있을 때 쏠까?

en: In ground.
Standing up.
A perfect shot. No misery for you and a meal for me.
ko: 완벽한 한 발. 넌 고통 없이, 난 끼니를 얻고.

en: Thanks for helping us to survive.
Hunter, meet better hunter.
ko: 사냥꾼아, 더 나은 사냥꾼을 만나 봐라.

en: Worse for the meat, but better for the shooting...
ko: 고기엔 안 좋지만, 쏘기엔 더 좋아...

en: You cannot escape me!
I'm sure we can scrape around the bad parts. We've got to eat!
ko: 나쁜 부분은 긁어내면 될 거야. 먹어야 하잖아!

en: The easiest shot I've taken.
ko: 지금까지 쏜 것 중 제일 쉬운 한 발이었어.

en: Ok, so maybe we hit an intestine and ruined all the meat. Right. Great.
ko: 좋아, 창자를 맞혀서 고기를 다 망쳤나 봐. 그래. 잘했다.

en: One less bullet, one less fox, one hungry belly, and no meals. Well done me.
ko: 총알 하나 줄고, 여우 하나 줄고, 배는 고프고, 끼니는 없고. 참 잘했다, 나.

en: Back at it, I guess.
Wait! You almost had it!
You have to be able to find food! You're built for this!
ko: 넌 먹이를 찾을 수 있어야 해! 그러라고 태어났잖아!

en: Fine! Just give up!
Ok, so maybe we shouldn't take lessons from foxes.
ko: 좋아, 여우한테 배우는 건 그만두는 게 좋겠다.

en: We can't just give up, right?
Ok, hold right there.
I said hold!
Shoot.
Lower gun.
Alright. Let's get back to the trail.
Yes! Got you!
Thanks for helping us survive.
Sorry, buddy. It's just the way it is.
Is that it? Was that my last chance?
Great. Great. Great. Out of bullets. Yep. Ok. We're fine. Just starving a little.
ko: 좋아. 좋아. 좋아. 총알이 떨어졌네. 그래. 좋아. 우린 괜찮아. 그냥 좀 굶을 뿐이야.

en: It'd be great if this gun was perfectly accurate.
ko: 이 총이 완벽하게 정확하면 정말 좋을 텐데.

en: Thank you for listening.
And that's why I kept you hooked in!
ko: 그래서 내가 너를 묶어 둔 거야!

en: Chomper...
Fine. We'll go check it out.
Wait here while I go get us a snack.
ko: 간식 구해 올 테니 여기서 기다려.

en: It's just another squirrel! Ignore! Leave it! Let's go!
ko: 그냥 또 다람쥐야! 무시해! 내버려 둬! 가자!

en: See, it's just a squirrel.
Ok, fine, it's your nemesis. Go try to eat it.
ko: 좋아, 알았어, 네 숙적이지. 가서 잡아먹어 봐.

en: I don't mind using a bullet on you.
ko: 너한테 총알 하나 쓰는 거 아깝지 않아.

en: Can we leave now?
Does it know about the other squirrel?
ko: 쟤가 다른 다람쥐 일을 알고 있을까?

en: Just hold right there.
I don't think you need to taunt my pups anymore. I'd say to tell your friends, but you won't be able to.
ko: 이제 우리 애들을 그만 놀려도 될 것 같은데. 친구들한테 전하라고 하고 싶지만, 넌 그럴 수 없겠지.

en: Oh hell no. I do not trust you and your bushy tail and your gnarly teeth.
ko: 오 절대 안 돼. 너랑 그 복슬복슬한 꼬리랑 흉측한 이빨은 못 믿어.

en: I don't have time for you to keep taking us off track.
ko: 네가 우릴 계속 길에서 벗어나게 할 시간 없어.

en: I don't have time for you to keep taking us off track, ok?
ko: 네가 우릴 계속 길에서 벗어나게 할 시간 없다고, 알았어?

en: Hahaha! The prey becomes the predator, tiny squirrel nemesis! Let's go, pups!
ko: 하하하! 먹잇감이 포식자가 되었다, 꼬마 다람쥐 숙적아! 가자, 얘들아!

en: And with that, we'll be on our way.
You know what...
I still want my revenge!
I don't know why I felt that was worth a bullet.
ko: 내가 왜 이게 총알 한 발의 가치가 있다고 생각했을까.

en: That bullet almost hit you and you're not even scared?! It's the size of your body. You are way more scary than city squirrels.
ko: 총알이 거의 맞을 뻔했는데 겁도 안 나?! 총알이 네 몸만 한데. 넌 도시 다람쥐보다 훨씬 무섭다.

en: You're right. I should let you be and you should also just let us run. I'll keep Chomper away if you stay away too. Truce?
ko: 네 말이 맞아. 난 널 내버려 두고, 너도 우리가 달리게 내버려 두면 돼. 너만 다가오지 않으면 촘퍼도 막을게. 휴전할까?

en: I should've known better than to use my last bullet on you.
ko: 마지막 총알을 너한테 쓰는 게 아니었는데.

en: Right, so word got around about us, huh?
ko: 그래, 우리 소문이 쫙 퍼졌나 보네?

en: Fine. I'll just shoot one of you too.
ko: 좋아. 너희 중 하나도 쏴 버리지 뭐.

en: Chomper, do your chomping!
Dogs, snarl at them or something.
I'm sorry about the other squirrel.
Ok, we get it. We'll be on our way.
I'm not going to waste a bullet on this.
ko: 이런 데 총알 낭비 안 할 거야.

en: The instigator is the perfect target.
You're mine!
Tell your friends what you've seen today! And just leave us alone, please!
ko: 오늘 본 걸 친구들한테 전해! 그리고 제발 우리 좀 내버려 둬!

en: I'm sorry for killing one of you.
It as a waste of a bullet.
You didn't mean us any harm.
That's just how it goes.
But for now I won't kill more of you. Let's call it a truce.
ko: 그래도 이제 더는 너희를 죽이지 않을게. 휴전하자.

en: I'll take that as a yes. Let's go.
I'm pretty certain we could be friends.
ko: 우린 분명 친구가 될 수 있을 거야.

en: Maybe once I'm home I'll build a little house for you and drop some suet outside.
ko: 집에 가면 작은 집을 지어 주고 밖에 비계 덩어리를 좀 놔둘게.

en: I don't mind if you take it from the birds.
So see you at home?
Let's go, pups.
You know, we all have to do what we need in the moment.
ko: 있잖아, 우린 모두 그 순간에 필요한 걸 해야 해.

en: I did what I needed.
ko: 난 내가 해야 할 일을 했어.

en: And you can do what you need.
ko: 그리고 너도 네가 해야 할 일을 하면 돼.

en: Yeah, we'll do the same.
Let it never be said that you're bad at chomping.
ko: 아무도 네가 깨무는 데 서툴다고 말 못 할 거야.

en: Oooh, I am thankful you're rid of those baby razor teeth.
ko: 오오, 그 아기 면도날 같은 이빨이 빠져서 정말 다행이야.

en: Let's take that full belly back on the trail.
ko: 그 빵빵한 배 데리고 다시 트레일로 가자.

en: Your prey drive is out of control.
You've really found yourself out here, huh?
ko: 너 여기서 진짜 너 자신을 찾았구나?

en: I'm happier out here too, even if I'm not sure where here is.
ko: 나도 여기가 더 행복해. 여기가 어딘지는 잘 모르겠지만.

en: Don't work up more of an appetite than you already have, buddy.
Don't worry, I'm sure we'll find something slower for you to chase.
ko: 걱정 마, 분명 네가 쫓을 만한 더 느린 걸 찾을 거야.

en: You had that planned out to a T, buddy.
You just knew you were going to catch that squirrel and you did.
ko: 그 다람쥐를 잡을 걸 알고 있었고, 진짜로 잡았네.

en: Now you've got a full belly and a happy tongue.
I need to follow your lead.
Know that we can do this and make it happen.
ko: 우리가 할 수 있고, 해낼 수 있다는 걸 알아야 해.

en: With every moment we get better at living out here. A little harder, a little kinder, but we're never sure what's coming next.
ko: 매 순간 여기서 사는 법이 늘고 있어. 조금 더 강해지고, 조금 더 다정해지지만, 다음에 뭐가 올지는 절대 모르지.

en: Oh. Belly rubs?
A quick break and then let's find home.
ko: 잠깐 쉬고 나서 집을 찾으러 가자.

en: I'm sorry, buddy. You have to make up your mind first.
ko: 미안해, 친구. 먼저 마음부터 정해야 해.

en: Know what you're going after and single in on that one thing.
ko: 뭘 노리는지 알고, 그 하나에 집중해야 해.

en: It's ok to be unsure in the moment, but when you choose to commit, commit fully.
ko: 그 순간에 망설이는 건 괜찮아. 하지만 하기로 했으면 온 힘을 다해야 해.

en: I have faith you'll get the next one.
It's why we're out here. We're committed. And we're going to do this together.
ko: 그게 우리가 여기 온 이유야. 우린 진심이야. 그리고 함께 해낼 거야.

en: I have a feeling they're not going to leave us alone.
ko: 쟤들이 우릴 가만두지 않을 것 같은 예감이 들어.

en: Harassed by squirrels: an Alaskan Adventure. I'm sure people back home will find that interesting. It will be my true achievement.
ko: 다람쥐에게 시달리다: 알래스카 모험기. 고향 사람들이 분명 재밌어할 거야. 이게 내 진정한 업적이 되겠지.

en: Let's go. We've got more to find than a bushy-tailed nemesis.
ko: 가자. 복슬꼬리 숙적 말고도 찾을 게 많아.

en: I wish I had that patience. Just wait, believing that you will succeed when given the next chance. Not letting that mistake define you.
ko: 나도 저런 인내심이 있으면 좋겠다. 다음 기회가 오면 성공할 거라 믿으며 기다리는 거. 실수 하나로 자신을 규정하지 않는 거.

en: And if I could let us all stay, I would, but I don't want to starve here. So, let's go, pal.
ko: 다 같이 여기 머물 수 있다면 그러고 싶지만, 여기서 굶어 죽고 싶진 않아. 그러니까 가자, 친구.

en: I guess that's your version of fast food. Glad you're full for the time being.
ko: 그게 네 패스트푸드인가 보네. 당분간은 배부르다니 다행이야.

en: Yeah, so...
I'm just going to let the dogs try to eat you.
ko: 그냥 개들한테 너를 잡아먹게 해 볼게.

en: Do you think it knows what we did to the last squirrel?
ko: 쟤가 우리가 저번 다람쥐한테 한 짓을 알까?

en: Ahhh! Stay back!
Hey! You're supposed to eat nuts!
Right, so we're going to starve because of carniverous squirrels?
ko: 그래, 그러니까 육식 다람쥐 때문에 우리가 굶어 죽게 생겼다고?

en: The wilderness really does find the true you.
ko: 야생은 정말 진짜 나를 찾아 주는구나.

en: Ffff. Help! Barkley!
Good boy, Barkley. I was almost a suet cake back there. They only got a couple of nibbles on me because of you.
ko: 착하지, 바클리. 하마터면 비계 덩어리가 될 뻔했어. 네 덕분에 몇 입만 물렸어.

en: I'll have to bandage this up back at the sled.
Hey there...
WHAT. THE. HELL?! I'm bleeding.
You know what, I'm not above vengeance and I still have a bullet.
ko: 있잖아, 나 복수 같은 거 마다하지 않아. 그리고 아직 총알도 한 발 있어.

en: Ok. We're out of here.
You're right, we've got more important things than to worry about than some squirrel bullies.
ko: 네 말이 맞아. 다람쥐 깡패들 걱정할 시간에 더 중요한 일이 있지.

en: What is with these squirrel nightmares?
A squirrel nightmare. I did not see that coming.
ko: 다람쥐 악몽이라니. 이건 예상 못 했다.

en: I'm pretty certain everything is going to be dangerous out there.
ko: 저기 있는 건 전부 위험할 게 분명해.

en: What's going on up there, Stilton?
Noodle, should I be scared?
Fin, what do you think?
Chomper... you look ready to chomp.
ko: 촘퍼... 너 깨물 준비가 된 얼굴인데.

en: What is that?
Let's check it out.
It's all yours, pups.
Leave it! Mush on!
Come on, Fin, we're running away. We don't have time for it.
ko: 가자, 핀, 우린 도망치는 거야. 저런 거 상대할 시간 없어.

en: Stilton, let's skip it.
Noodle, we don't care about snow geysers.
ko: 누들, 눈 간헐천 같은 건 관심 없어.

en: Oh, hello.
Talk to the fluffers.
Hunt them.
Let the dogs go for them.
So, um, any chance you're laying eggs?
ko: 그래서, 음, 혹시 알 낳고 있니?

en: And how much meat is on you? You kind of look like you're only feathers.
ko: 그리고 너 고기가 얼마나 붙어 있어? 깃털밖에 없어 보이는데.

en: I really didn't expect to have to hunt this much. I don't know what I actually expected.
ko: 이렇게 사냥을 많이 해야 할 줄은 몰랐어. 대체 뭘 기대했던 건지 모르겠다.

en: I'm going to give you a chance to leave if you want it.
No? Ok.
I guess I should do something...
I mean, you guys are just sitting there.
It's like I have to hunt you.
Thank god I still have bullets
Thank god I still have a bullet.
ko: 총알이 아직 한 발 남아서 다행이야.

en: Cause I'm starving.
Well, at least I know we'll have food tonight.
ko: 음, 적어도 오늘 밤엔 먹을 게 있겠네.

en: Yeah, I know. That could've been dinner.
ko: 그래, 알아. 저녁거리가 될 수도 있었는데.

en: This shot should be a gimme...
Ah ha! A well-balanced, yet tiny, diet.
ko: 아하! 균형 잡혔지만, 아주 작은 식단.

en: Sheesh, you're smaller than I thought.
I'm going to have to get used to eating all the parts I never wanted to.
ko: 예전엔 절대 안 먹던 부위까지 먹는 데 익숙해져야겠어.

en: Who would've thought I'd expand my palate out here.
ko: 여기서 입맛이 넓어질 줄 누가 알았겠어.

en: Well, besides the meat with a side of meat and amuse bouche of meat.
ko: 뭐, 고기에 고기를 곁들이고 애피타이저로 고기를 먹는 것만 빼면.

en: But, we'll eat what we can get.
ko: 그래도 구할 수 있는 건 다 먹을 거야.

en: And while I don't think I'll ever get used to killing my own food.
ko: 그리고 내 먹거리를 직접 죽이는 데 절대 익숙해지진 않겠지만.

en: I can do my best to make sure I make the most of each animal.
ko: 잡은 동물 하나하나를 최대한 알뜰하게 쓰도록 노력할 수는 있어.

en: On my call, you're going to try to get yourselves a meal...
ko: 내 신호에 맞춰서, 각자 끼니를 잡아 봐...

en: Chomper, stick with the pack.
Hold. Hold...
Ok... GO!
Sheesh, you are all great at catching these birds.
ko: 이런, 다들 이 새 잡는 데 선수구나.

en: Maybe we shouldn't try to have chickens at our new home...
ko: 새 보금자리에선 닭을 키우지 않는 게 좋겠다...

en: I don't need eggs.
I think I like these ptarmigans. You all look very full.
ko: 이 뇌조들 마음에 들어. 다들 배불러 보이네.

en: Fin!
You really should follow what I say, you know. But, I guess that works.
ko: 내 말을 따라야 한다고, 알지? 그래도 뭐, 결과는 괜찮네.

en: Sorry, didn't realize you were that hungry. Good job, buddy.
ko: 미안, 그렇게 배고픈 줄 몰랐어. 잘했어, 친구.

en: Stilton! What are you doing?!
Noodle! Wait! Stay!
Is that a...
skunk.
Inspect
Get this stink off us. Run away!
Stilton, what're you thinking?
I cannot believe you just did that to us.
ko: 네가 방금 우리한테 그런 짓을 했다니 믿을 수가 없어.

en: It's not like we tried to run up on you. And now here we are, and you're just wandering about.
ko: 우리가 너한테 덤벼든 것도 아니잖아. 근데 이 꼴이 됐는데, 넌 태평하게 돌아다니고 있네.

en: I suppose I don't really want to eat you now. What if that smell is a part of you?
ko: 이제 별로 먹고 싶지 않은데. 그 냄새가 몸에 배어 있으면 어떡해?

en: On second thought... Hunt it.
Let the dogs try to catch it.
You know, my eyes are still watering.
What if they freeze shut?
No matter...
I'm getting my payback.
I still need food.
This is just what we have to do.
I just can't. Leave.
Stinky meat is still meat. This will keep us going.
ko: 냄새나는 고기도 고기야. 이걸로 버틸 수 있어.

en: Any chance for meat is one worth taking. Maybe this will mask our smell.
ko: 고기를 얻을 기회라면 잡아야지. 이걸로 우리 냄새를 가릴 수 있을지도 몰라.

en: You deserved that.
Thanks for helping us out.
We're going to have to get used to this.
Some food is better than nothing.
ko: 조금이라도 먹을 게 있는 게 없는 것보다 낫지.

en: I wonder if this gets easier.
Wait, scavengers don't care about bad smells. Predators probably don't either.
ko: 잠깐, 청소동물들은 고약한 냄새 따윈 신경 안 써. 포식자들도 아마 그렇겠지.

en: I should consider using some of this or we might become a snack.
ko: 이걸 좀 써 볼까. 안 그러면 우리가 간식이 될지도 몰라.

en: Fine.
I was still willing to eat you! I didn't even mind the smell. I've learned I can't be picky now.
ko: 그래도 널 먹을 생각이었다고! 냄새도 상관없었어. 이제 가릴 처지가 아니란 걸 배웠거든.

en: And now you leave?!
Defense mechanism noted. Well played.
ko: 방어 수단 잘 봤어. 한 수 배웠네.

en: I'd be ok not meeting you again.
ko: 다시는 안 만나도 괜찮을 것 같아.

en: I don't care to know if you taste like you smell, but, I have some friends who might not mind.
ko: 네가 냄새만큼 맛도 고약한지는 알고 싶지 않지만, 개의치 않을 친구들이 좀 있어.

en: Chomper, time to do your thing!
I really feel like you're living your best life, buddy.
ko: 너 진짜 최고의 삶을 살고 있구나, 친구.

en: It's a gross life, but you're very good at this living off the land thing.
ko: 좀 지저분한 삶이지만, 자연에서 얻어 사는 건 정말 잘하네.

en: A natural, really. Though I shouldn't really be surprised.
I'm still coming to grips with what it actually takes to live out here.
ko: 난 아직도 여기서 사는 데 실제로 뭐가 필요한지 받아들이는 중이야.

en: But, things are definitely a lot more straightforward.
ko: 그래도 모든 게 훨씬 단순하긴 해.

en: No politics. No judgment. Just living. I'd probably be lonely if it wasn't for you.
ko: 정치도 없고. 평가도 없고. 그냥 사는 거야. 네가 없었으면 외로웠을 거야.

en: Ok, yeah, sorry, back to the trail.
These reveries really sneak up on you when you're on your own.
ko: 혼자 있으면 이런 공상이 슬그머니 찾아온다니까.

en: Ohhhhh. You were keeping an eye on Bodega. I should've known you're always down for a snack.
ko: 아아. 보데가를 지켜보고 있었구나. 넌 언제든 간식 먹을 준비가 돼 있다는 걸 알았어야 했는데.

en: Even the stinky ones.
Thanks, Fin.
You pups ready to get back out there?
Looks like you've got some extra zest for life now.
Let's do it.
I should listen to you more often, buddy.
ko: 네 말을 더 자주 들어야겠어, 친구.

en: Feeling a bit more energized?
Yeah, I thought so.
Let's get back out there, but save the licks for when your breath is bit better.
ko: 다시 나가자. 근데 핥는 건 입 냄새가 좀 나아지면 해 줘.

en: I'm just going to hope that stink doesn't permeate all of you.
ko: 그 냄새가 너희 모두에게 배지 않기만 바랄게.

en: A quick choice is rewarded and punished.
ko: 빠른 선택은 보상과 벌을 동시에 받는 법.

en: This stink is really getting to my eyes, but at least we won't go hungry.
ko: 냄새 때문에 눈이 따갑지만, 적어도 굶진 않겠어.

en: Chomper, speak!
Oh god. Are the animals going to smell us coming now?
ko: 세상에. 이제 동물들이 우리 냄새 맡고 다 알아채는 거 아냐?

en: How do we get rid of this smell?!
It's not like we packed tomatoes.
Fin, can you help me out?
Noodle! You gotta know what to do, buddy.
ko: 누들! 너라면 알 거 아냐, 친구.

en: Stilton, any suggestions?
What, is this, like, your 40th lifetime skunking?
ko: 뭐야, 너 평생 스컹크 냄새 뒤집어쓴 게 이번이 마흔 번째쯤 돼?

en: Ugh you guys like smelling like this, don't you?
ko: 으, 너희 이 냄새 좋아하지, 그렇지?

en: Mush on! Keep the breeze flowing, Gale.
ko: 머시 온! 바람이 계속 불게 해 줘, 게일.

en: Mush on! Let's see if we can escape this smell.
ko: 머시 온! 이 냄새에서 벗어날 수 있는지 보자.

en: I really think I could've eaten skunk.
ko: 솔직히 스컹크도 먹을 수 있었을 것 같아.

en: It's not like it has a weird texture thing.
It's just flavor, like when you get a bad mussel.
ko: 그냥 맛 문제지. 상한 홍합 먹었을 때처럼.

en: Those horrible, terrible, anxiety-inducing poop tasting mussels.
ko: 그 끔찍하고, 지독하고, 불안감을 유발하는 똥 맛 나는 홍합들.

en: But if push came to shove, I could do it. I think.
ko: 그래도 정말 어쩔 수 없으면 먹을 수 있어. 아마도.

en: I feel like the smell is sticking to me.
Stilton, why did we follow it?
Oh, you were hungry.
Feeling better?
Well, that skunk isn't. But let's get back out there.
ko: 음, 저 스컹크는 아니겠지만. 아무튼 다시 나가자.

en: Hey! Those look like birch up ahead.
ko: 야! 저 앞에 있는 거 자작나무 같아.

en: We can use those to start a fire.
Check it out.
I don't miss the days of needing fire starters. On by!
ko: 부싯돌이 필요하던 시절은 그립지 않아. 지나쳐!

en: We've got what we need. Let's go.
We don't have time for wood. We'll be ok. I hope.
ko: 장작 구할 시간 없어. 괜찮을 거야. 그러길 바라.

en: I can handle freezing for another day. It's all in my mind.
ko: 하루 더 얼어 죽을 것 같은 건 견딜 수 있어. 다 마음먹기 나름이야.

en: Let's keep going.
Are you both birch?
I did not learn the proper mnemonic devices for tree recognition.
ko: 나무 구별하는 암기법을 제대로 안 배웠어.

en: Well, Margot told me to rip off the bark from birch and only one of these looks to have rippable bark.
ko: 음, 마고가 자작나무 껍질을 벗기라고 했는데, 껍질이 벗겨질 것 같은 건 하나뿐이네.

en: And the others are supposed to be aspen. They don't burn as well but look a lot like birch from afar.
ko: 나머지는 사시나무일 거야. 불은 잘 안 붙지만 멀리서 보면 자작나무랑 많이 닮았어.

en: I'll consider myself lucky we have both here.
ko: 여기 둘 다 있는 걸 행운으로 여겨야지.

en: Dear god.
You're supposed to be like paper.
Come HERE!
Ok, so that works up an appetite.
But, hey, we're not going to freeze.
It's nice not being desperate for birch bark. I like knowing we can always start a fire.
ko: 자작나무 껍질에 목맬 필요가 없어서 좋아. 언제든 불을 피울 수 있다는 게 마음 편해.

en: Thank god. A birch grouping.
Looks like we've found some birch trees.
Go rip off some birch.
Ignore. On by.
Use axe to get birch.
Our birch hunting days are over.
We're good. We already have what we need.
Let's go, Chomper! We're making good progress!
Gale, let's keep that wind flowing! Mush on!
ko: 게일, 바람을 계속 일으켜 줘! 머시 온!

en: On by, Slayer! Let's keep going.
Noodle, keep the course!
Alright, Stilton. Mush on, buddy!
Fin, let's worry about what's next.
You don't need to carry more birch, Bodega. Let's go!
ko: 자작나무 더 안 날라도 돼, 보데가. 가자!

en: Barkley, mush on!
Iggy, let's keep going!
We're good, team. On by!
I'm not even going to break a sweat.
ko: 땀 한 방울 안 흘릴 거야.

en: Ok, that was even easier than I expected. It didn't make me ravenous either.
ko: 좋아, 생각보다 훨씬 쉬웠어. 배도 별로 안 고프고.

en: I.
Need.
You.
To.
Start.
Fires.
Ugh. Ok. That was more work than it should've been.
I can't wait to get cooking. I'm starving.
So now we just need some, you know, food.
ko: 이제, 그러니까, 먹을 것만 있으면 돼.

en: And I'm starving. I really need to eat.
ko: 그리고 배고파 죽겠어. 진짜 뭐라도 먹어야 해.

en: And... I'm hungry.
I might finally be able to get this chill from my bones.
ko: 드디어 뼛속까지 스민 이 냉기를 떨쳐 낼 수 있겠어.

en: Really hoping none of my fingers or toes are black. I haven't looked at them in forever.
ko: 손가락 발가락이 시커멓게 변하지 않았길 정말 바라. 한참 동안 안 봤거든.

en: Let's get back to it.
Did you see that?! A bald eagle!
No, Chomper, I don't think you can jump that high.
ko: 아니, 촘퍼, 넌 저렇게 높이 못 뛰어.

en: What do you pups think?
Chase it.
Noodle, your call.
Yep, let's see where it's going!
I could use a snack.
On way, pups! Ignore it.
You know these woods. Is it worth following?
ko: 넌 이 숲을 잘 알잖아. 따라갈 가치가 있을까?

en: Follow it is.
You're a lot bigger than I expected.
I heard it's illegal to shoot a bald eagle? Do you know if that's true?
ko: 흰머리수리를 쏘는 건 불법이라던데? 그거 사실인지 알아?

en: I know you used to be endangered. Hmm.
ko: 너희가 멸종 위기종이었던 건 알아. 흠.

en: Shoot it anyway.
Wait.
I don't need to set you back in your recovery.
ko: 너희 개체 수 회복을 방해할 필요는 없지.

en: Good hunting out there.
So, know any good places to eat around here?
ko: 그래서, 이 근처에 괜찮은 맛집 알아?

en: Hunt the rabbit.
Chomper, do your thing.
It's all yours.
Thanks for your help.
It's probably a good idea to follow the better hunters out here.
