ko: 여기선 더 나은 사냥꾼을 따라가는 게 좋겠어.

en: Fine. Back to the trail.
I probably shouldn't give into your prey drive, but this seriously helps our lack of bullets situation.
ko: 네 사냥 본능에 넘어가면 안 되겠지만, 이건 총알이 부족한 우리 상황에 정말 도움이 돼.

en: Though we're going to have so much future training to do, buddy.
ko: 그래도 앞으로 훈련할 게 엄청 많겠다, 친구.

en: Ok, you feeling energized? Let's get back on track.
ko: 좋아, 기운 좀 났어? 다시 길로 돌아가자.

en: Right... you know all the good hunting grounds. Good to know.
ko: 그래... 넌 좋은 사냥터를 다 알고 있구나. 알아 둘게.

en: This one is all yours. We'll leave you to it.
ko: 이건 다 네 거야. 방해하지 않을게.

en: Isn't it illegal to shoot a bald eagle?
What if someone finds out?
We can't risk our survival on a rule right now. We'll follow the rules later.
ko: 지금 규칙 때문에 생존을 걸 순 없어. 규칙은 나중에 지키자.

en: We'll apologize later, maybe. I'm worried about us.
ko: 나중에 사과하지 뭐, 아마도. 지금은 우리가 걱정이야.

en: Yep. I'm full of guilt. Hopefully a full stomach quells the guilt.
ko: 그래. 죄책감이 가득해. 배가 부르면 죄책감이 좀 가라앉겠지.

en: Yep, that's probably for the best.
Really? I'm still going to follow rules out here? I'm about to starve.
ko: 진짜? 여기서도 규칙을 지키겠다고? 곧 굶어 죽게 생겼는데.

en: I know if you don't follow the rules when no one's looking there'd be anarchy.
ko: 아무도 안 볼 때 규칙을 안 지키면 무법천지가 된다는 건 알아.

en: I can't. I'd feel too bad. You're too majestic.
ko: 못 하겠어. 너무 미안할 것 같아. 넌 너무 위풍당당하잖아.

en: I wouldn't be me, but man, this is sure going to make it harder on myself. Next time, pack sled full of granola bars.
ko: 그럼 내가 아니겠지만, 아, 이걸로 내 처지가 확실히 더 힘들어지겠어. 다음엔 썰매에 그래놀라 바를 가득 싣자.

en: I'm running away before I change my mind.
Rabbit is supposed to be a delicacy.
What do you think, pups?
Leave it be.
Hey, little bunny.
You mind being bait?
I'm going to let Chomper have you.
I'm sure something big is tracking you...
ko: 뭔가 큰 게 널 쫓고 있을 거야...

en: Hey, we needed that!
Oh come on!
I guess that's what I was asking for...
I'm getting revenge, eagle.
Yeah, yeah. Take shots when I have em.
ko: 그래, 그래. 기회 있을 때 쏴야지.

en: You can be my meal.
ko: 넌 내 끼니가 될 수 있어.

en: We'll steal your food next time!
ko: 다음엔 네 먹이를 훔쳐 갈 거야!

en: This place isn't forgiving. You don't have to ask for permission to do what you need to do.
ko: 여긴 너그러운 곳이 아니야. 필요한 일을 하는 데 허락을 구할 필요는 없어.

en: You're not very good bait.
You didn't even move. What are you even eating? It's just snow.
ko: 움직이지도 않았잖아. 대체 뭘 먹는 거야? 그냥 눈이잖아.

en: Wait, am I the bait?
Hunt the bunny and leave.
Let Chomper try his luck.
Alright, Chomper. On my call you get to...
You really have some wolf-like instincts, pal.
ko: 너 정말 늑대 같은 본능이 있구나, 친구.

en: You just needed to go after some creatures with fewer tall escape routes.
ko: 높이 도망칠 데가 별로 없는 동물을 노리기만 하면 됐던 거야.

en: Well, I'm glad your belly is full.
Let's get back out there.
Alright, leave it.
Alright, let's go.
Ok, we should be able to make this shot...
ko: 좋아, 이건 맞힐 수 있을 거야...

en: I think.
Ok... we might just survive out here.
ko: 좋아... 우리 여기서 살아남을 수도 있겠어.

en: You'll make for a good meal.
I honestly thought hunting was easier.
ko: 솔직히 사냥이 더 쉬운 줄 알았어.

en: I don't know why I packed so few bullets.
That was probably a mistake.
Oh well, Margot said there's plenty more at the cabin.
ko: 뭐, 마고가 오두막에 훨씬 많이 있다고 했으니까.

en: You do your thing, bun.
Slow down a bit, pups. What is that...
Gale, slow down there's something up there...
ko: 게일, 속도 줄여. 저 앞에 뭔가 있어...

en: I think we should...
I'm pretty sure that's a porcupine...
We don't need to mess with those spikes.
Wow, ok, Gale. I'm not even sure we should be messing with porcupines.
ko: 와, 좋아, 게일. 호저랑 엮여도 될지 모르겠는데.

en: See? They have a worse business end than skunks.
ko: 봤지? 쟤들은 스컹크보다 엉덩이 쪽이 더 고약해.

en: I don't want to mess with it.
Awww, Gale. I tried to warn you.
Hold still. I got you.
You can't just rush into things. Especially things covered in spikes.
ko: 아무 일에나 무작정 뛰어들면 안 돼. 특히 가시로 뒤덮인 거엔.

en: I'll heal you up.
Do you guys ever poke yourselves?
What if you get like a mini tumbleweed back there?
ko: 거기에 작은 회전초 같은 게 붙으면 어떡해?

en: There probably aren't tumbleweeds here.
I'm just making an observation.
I don't know what to do with you. It's not like Chomper can have at you.
ko: 널 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠다. 촘퍼가 덤빌 수 있는 것도 아니고.

en: I guess I'll hunt.
But seriously, what about a leaf just getting stabbed on one of your spikes. Then what?
ko: 근데 진짜로, 나뭇잎이 네 가시에 꽂히면 어떡해? 그럼 어떻게 되는 거야?

en: Slow, big, and close. A perfect target.
Even if I tried.
I didn't really think about how I was going to safely clean you. I should've packed leather mittens.
ko: 너를 어떻게 안전하게 손질할지는 생각도 못 했네. 가죽 장갑을 챙겼어야 했어.

en: Ok, if I can't hit you, I'm probably not going to survive out here.
ko: 좋아, 너도 못 맞히면 난 여기서 못 살아남을 거야.

en: Hey, at least I'm not completely ill-equipped for this journey.
ko: 그래도 이번 여정에 아주 무방비하진 않구나.

en: Alright, so now I just have to like clean you... I should've packed armor.
ko: 좋아, 이제 널 손질만 하면 되는데... 갑옷을 챙겼어야 했어.

en: I'm sorry, girl. I wish I could provide better warnings about porcupines.
ko: 미안해, 아가씨. 호저에 대해 더 잘 경고해 줬으면 좋았을 텐데.

en: They actually have a pointy end. I wish you didn't have to learn by doing.
ko: 쟤들은 진짜로 뾰족한 쪽이 있어. 직접 겪으면서 배우지 않아도 됐으면 좋았을 텐데.

en: I know it's bothering you.
But let's mush on.
Noodle, are you trying to bring it closer or keep it away?
ko: 누들, 저걸 가까이 데려오려는 거야, 멀리 쫓으려는 거야?

en: How close do you think that wolf is?
ko: 그 늑대가 얼마나 가까이 있을 것 같아?

en: Try to find it.
Keep running.
Should we check it out, Noodle?
Not worth the risk.
Right, it's hiding.
Or maybe it's stalking us...
Woah, Noodle. I said let's go.
Alright, fine...
Oh, you just wanted to help.
Is this wolf going to hurt us?
We could just make it a meal...
Ok, ok. Um...
Go try to set it free.
Kill it.
I'm glad you brought us out here, Noodle.
I hope that wolf makes it.
We can't let ourselves get too hardened out here. Even if it seems to literally be, “kill or be killed.” I'm not sure I'd feel ok living like that.
ko: 여기서 너무 냉혹해지면 안 돼. 말 그대로 '죽이거나 죽거나'인 것 같아도. 그렇게 사는 게 괜찮을지 모르겠어.

en: Noodle, there's nothing we can do.
ko: 누들, 우리가 할 수 있는 건 없어.

en: We can't steal things from people, even if we don't like what they've caught.
ko: 남이 잡은 게 마음에 안 든다고 해서 물건을 훔칠 순 없어.

en: Why should I value the wolf more than a bunny or a squirrel?
ko: 내가 왜 토끼나 다람쥐보다 늑대를 더 소중히 여겨야 하지?

en: I know, but we're going anyway. Come on. I'm sorry, bud.
ko: 알아. 그래도 갈 거야. 가자. 미안해, 친구.

en: Noodle, I need you to go back to the sled.
Come on, buddy. You have to go back to the sled. You can't stay here for this.
ko: 가자, 친구. 썰매로 돌아가야 해. 이걸 지켜보며 여기 있으면 안 돼.

en: We have to do things we might not like to survive out here.
ko: 여기서 살아남으려면 내키지 않는 일도 해야 해.

en: It's not as easy as just going to buy our food. I have to actually choose what lives and dies. And I don't want you or any of us to die, ok?
ko: 가서 먹을 걸 사 오는 것처럼 쉽지 않아. 뭐가 살고 죽을지 내가 직접 골라야 해. 그리고 난 너나 우리 중 누구도 죽길 원치 않아, 알았지?

en: At least you won't starve out here.
We all have to survive.
This is exactly what we need.
Looks like we've got a chance at a meal, pups.
ko: 끼니를 얻을 기회가 생긴 것 같아, 얘들아.

en: Leave it. Let's go.
Stay quiet. Just be calm. You've got this.
ko: 조용히. 침착하게. 넌 할 수 있어.

en: A perfect shot.
And now we can reward ourselves with a warm meal.
ko: 이제 따뜻한 끼니로 우리 자신에게 보상할 수 있어.

en: And one we really needed.
No one has to starve tonight.
ko: 오늘 밤엔 아무도 굶지 않아도 돼.

en: God, that's a terrible thought. Why did I want this to be my reality? Well, at least, I feel properly alive, and I'm getting kind of good at this.
ko: 세상에, 끔찍한 생각이야. 내가 왜 이런 현실을 원했을까? 그래도 적어도 제대로 살아 있다는 느낌이 들고, 이 일에 꽤 능숙해지고 있어.

en: Oh god I only injured it.
Um.
I have to leave it... I hope something finds it quickly.
ko: 두고 가야 해... 뭔가가 빨리 찾아내길 바라.

en: One more should do the trick... as long as I don't miss.
ko: 한 발만 더 쏘면 될 거야... 빗나가지만 않으면.

en: Oh god we really need this.
We can't miss again.
Don't miss again. Missing isn't an option.
ko: 또 빗나가지 마. 빗나가는 건 선택지에 없어.

en: You can't leave it injured. You can do this.
ko: 다친 채로 둘 순 없어. 넌 할 수 있어.

en: That's what we needed.
And just in time to keep us alive.
ko: 딱 맞춰서 우리 목숨을 이어 주네.

en: I'll collect what I can and get back to the sled.
ko: 챙길 수 있는 건 챙겨서 썰매로 돌아갈게.

en: Well, at least we aren't starving yet.
No bullets, no food, and grumbling stomach. We might have a problem.
ko: 총알도 없고, 식량도 없고, 배는 꼬르륵거리고. 문제가 생길지도 몰라.

en: I'm sorry, little deer. I needed you but I wasn't a good enough shot. I hope you'll be ok.
ko: 미안해, 꼬마 사슴아. 네가 필요했는데 내 사격 실력이 부족했어. 괜찮길 바라.

en: That's not good.
This is harder than I thought it would be.
Not feeling great about that.
I should've packed more bullets.
I need another way to find food.
Well that's just great.
We need to find some food to salvage soon.
ko: 곧 건질 만한 식량을 찾아야 해.

en: Well, that's going to be a problem.
Ok, it's just a miss. You have to try again if you want to succeed, right?
ko: 좋아, 그냥 빗나간 것뿐이야. 성공하려면 다시 시도해야지, 그렇지?

en: This running out of bullets thing is going to be a problem.
ko: 총알이 떨어지는 이 상황은 문제가 될 거야.

en: You just have to make it count when it really matters.
ko: 정말 중요한 순간에 제대로 해내기만 하면 돼.

en: We'll all have some food tonight.
ko: 오늘 밤엔 다들 먹을 게 있을 거야.

en: Which is good cause I'm getting light headed.
And the pups really need the energy. They've worked hard.
ko: 그리고 애들도 정말 기운이 필요해. 열심히 일했으니까.

en: Is that a squirrel up there?
Why's it running so... oh it's a weasel.
Where did it go? I can only see a tree?
Ah. There you are.
You're not very good at hiding.
I'll leave you to your tree.
My pups haven't learned to climb yet. You're safe up there.
ko: 우리 애들은 아직 나무 타는 법을 못 배웠어. 거기선 안전해.

en: Though Slayer thinks she can reach owls, so maybe one day far in the future that'll be a problem for you.
ko: 그래도 슬레이어는 부엉이까지 닿을 수 있다고 생각하니까, 먼 훗날 언젠간 너한테 문제가 될지도 몰라.

en: You're perfect just as you are...
Gotcha!
No meal is too small.
Or too cute.
You did that on purpose.
Fin, what do you smell, girl?
Something worth checking out up there?
ko: 저기 가 볼 만한 게 있어?

en: Follow Fin.
Another time, Fin.
Fine, it's your call.
Ok, I took too long, you're right.
ko: 좋아, 내가 너무 오래 망설였어. 네 말이 맞아.

en: Whatcha tracking, girl?
Fin, get out of there!
[Big Sigh]
It's ok. It was bound to happen.
I don't know why I trusted you.
Your previous owners warned us. But hey, you followed your nose and it could've been something amazing.
ko: 예전 주인분들이 경고했었지. 그래도 뭐, 넌 코를 따라갔고 굉장한 걸 찾을 수도 있었어.

en: We'll try again sometime.
I can't be taking risks like that.
I have to know I know what's best for the team.
ko: 팀에 뭐가 최선인지는 내가 알아야 해.

en: What'd you find, Fin?
Hey, a bullet.
Good tracking, girl
What'd you sniff out for us?
A med pack?
Good work!
Alright, let's go, Fin.
I know it didn't work out this time, Fin, but I trust what you can find.
ko: 이번엔 잘 안 됐지만, 핀, 네가 찾아낼 수 있는 걸 믿어.

en: You've got a nose that shows you far more than I can see.
ko: 네 코는 내 눈보다 훨씬 많은 걸 보여 주니까.

en: And you're probably used to smelling like skunk by now.
ko: 그리고 넌 이제 스컹크 냄새에 익숙해졌겠지.

en: I knew I could trust you, Fin.
ko: 널 믿어도 될 줄 알았어, 핀.

en: You always keep your nose to the ground and your thoughts to the team.
ko: 넌 늘 코는 땅에, 생각은 팀에 두잖아.

en: Oh would you look at that... an elk!
It's so majestic.
You ok, Slayer? You're looking a little more skittish than normal...
ko: 괜찮아, 슬레이어? 평소보다 좀 더 겁먹은 것 같은데...

en: It's ok, we'll leave.
Wait, I said I was going to check it out!
Slayer! You can't just run from it.
ko: 슬레이어! 그렇게 도망치기만 하면 안 돼.

en: Ok, fine, we'll leave this one, but you have to face your fears some time.
ko: 좋아, 알았어, 이번엔 그냥 두자. 그래도 언젠간 두려움과 마주해야 해.

en: Don't worry, Slayer. We don't need to face our fears yet.
ko: 걱정 마, 슬레이어. 아직 두려움과 마주할 필요는 없어.

en: We're just getting started.
No need to rip the bandage off immediately.
ko: 반창고를 한 번에 확 뗄 필요는 없어.

en: We're still getting to know each other.
ko: 우린 아직 서로를 알아 가는 중이야.

en: Woah, Slayer! I hadn't made up my mind yet.
ko: 워, 슬레이어! 아직 결정 안 했어.

en: You can't just runaway!
Though I guess you already did... Ok, fine. We won't check out that elk.
ko: 뭐, 이미 도망쳤구나... 좋아, 알았어. 저 엘크는 안 보러 갈게.

en: Huh? Would you look at that...
Follow them.
Let's leave them alone.
Where'd your buddy go?
Uhhh... I guess their distraction didn't work.
ko: 어어... 주의 돌리기 작전이 실패했나 보네.

en: You're far too food territorial to allow a weasel to steal something from you.
ko: 넌 먹을 것에 대한 영역 의식이 너무 강해서 족제비한테 뭘 뺏기게 두지 않지.

en: You want a treat?
Go ahead and chow down on that piece of meat.
I'll pack up the weasel.
Good job, Bodega. I appreciate you looking out for us.
ko: 잘했어, 보데가. 우리를 지켜 줘서 고마워.

en: I guess let's take that too and get back to the trail.
It's far away, but it's here.
What should we do?
You're right, it's too far. Let's go!
ko: 네 말이 맞아, 너무 멀어. 가자!

en: Pups, stay nice and quiet. Let's see if it will come closer.
ko: 얘들아, 조용히 있어. 가까이 오는지 보자.

en: Nope. That's the opposite of what I wanted.
Fine, let's leave.
Here, little caribou.
Step into my hunting range.
That's better.
You're too cute to eat.
I can't. You just live your life.
ko: 못 하겠어. 그냥 네 삶을 살아.

en: Just a simple shot now.
We really appreciate this.
This is a good shooting distance. Thanks.
Alright, let's just get this rifle ready...
I don't think I'm cut out for this.
ko: 난 이 일에 맞지 않는 것 같아.

en: We're going to need to find food without the help of bullets.
ko: 총알 없이 식량을 구할 방법을 찾아야 해.

en: This doesn't get easier.
It's great being at the top of the food chain.
ko: 먹이 사슬 꼭대기에 있는 건 정말 좋아.

en: Well, we won't starve tonight.
But I have a definite appreciation for my food. It has to come from somewhere... some thing.
ko: 그래도 내 먹거리에 대한 감사함은 분명히 생겼어. 어딘가에서... 어떤 생명에게서 오는 거니까.

en: I'm finally feeling like I have control over my life.
ko: 드디어 내 삶을 내가 통제하고 있다는 느낌이 들어.

en: Let's take this meat back to the sled.
Aw, come on. I don't know if I can get a good shot from here.
ko: 아, 제발. 여기서 제대로 맞힐 수 있을지 모르겠어.

en: But we need food. I don't think I have a choice.
ko: 그래도 식량이 필요해. 선택의 여지가 없는 것 같아.

en: Is my last bullet worth this gamble?
ko: 마지막 총알을 이 도박에 걸 가치가 있을까?

en: Let's try to hunt.
Well, I guess there's nothing to do but leave.
Just have to, you know, adjust for wind, distance, that physics arcing thing.
ko: 그냥, 그러니까, 바람이랑 거리랑, 그 물리학적 곡선 같은 걸 계산하면 돼.

en: What was that?
A parabola?
Huh? Is that right?
Come on. Back to present. Ok, it's just a little further away. Time to take our chance...
ko: 정신 차려. 현재로 돌아와. 좋아, 조금 더 멀 뿐이야. 기회를 잡을 시간이야...

en: Holy hell! I made that shot?!
But of course I did.
I'm going to pretend that wasn't just luck. It's definitely my innate abilities coming to the surface.
ko: 그냥 운이 아니었던 걸로 할래. 분명 타고난 재능이 드러난 거야.

en: We all have to find our true selves. Mine just happens to be one with the wilderness.
ko: 우린 모두 진짜 자신을 찾아야 해. 내 경우엔 야생과 하나가 되는 거고.

en: I'm comfortable out here. Even when I'm scared out of my mind.
ko: 여기가 편해. 무서워서 정신이 나갈 것 같을 때조차.

en: And now to get that bounty! Pups, we're in for a treat!
ko: 이제 전리품을 챙기러! 얘들아, 오늘 포식하겠다!

en: I mean, we didn't really have a choice. Chomper, this might not have been my best decision.
ko: 뭐, 사실 선택의 여지가 없었잖아. 촘퍼, 이건 최선의 결정이 아니었을지도 몰라.

en: Great. Just great.
Yeah, you're right. I can't dwell. I can't feel sorry for myself. I did this and we have to keep going.
ko: 그래, 네 말이 맞아. 연연하면 안 돼. 자기 연민에 빠지면 안 돼. 내가 한 일이고, 우린 계속 가야 해.

en: Oh god! That could've smashed the river wide open!
I bet there's a good spot to fish over there. Too bad we did not grab our fishing pole.
ko: 저기 낚시하기 좋은 데가 있을 것 같아. 낚싯대를 안 챙겨 온 게 아쉽다.

en: Could be an ok spot to fish if the beavers like it.
ko: 비버들이 좋아하는 곳이면 낚시하기 괜찮을지도 몰라.

en: Either way, might be a good spot for a meal.
Check out the fishing hole.
Hunt the beaver.
Seems like the perfect time to fish.
ko: 낚시하기 딱 좋은 때인 것 같아.

en: We might not be able to catch anything but we can still check it out.
ko: 아무것도 못 잡을 수도 있지만 그래도 가 볼 수는 있지.

en: I'll be right back, pups!
Maybe we'll find a fishing pole we can borrow for a bit.
ko: 잠깐 빌릴 수 있는 낚싯대가 있을지도 몰라.

en: It'd be nice to worry a little less about bullets.
ko: 총알 걱정을 좀 덜 수 있으면 좋겠다.

en: There are probably still fish under here, right?
Try fishing.
Look for the beaver.
Go back to the dogs.
Seems like it's worth a try.
Maybe that beaver is still around.
ko: 그 비버가 아직 근처에 있을지도 몰라.

en: I don't feel comfortable with the dogs on the ice.
ko: 개들을 얼음 위에 두는 건 불안해.

en: Here, little fish. I only need one of you.
ko: 이리 와, 물고기야. 딱 한 마리만 있으면 돼.

en: This fishing pole is a life saver.
Is this how I finally learn patience?
Just sitting out here, waiting for food to hopefully arrive.
ko: 그냥 여기 앉아서, 먹을 게 오길 기다리는 거야.

en: And here it is.
I think I like fishing.
This fish just might be the reason we all make it home. I shouldn't risk staying on this water.
ko: 이 물고기 덕분에 우리 모두 집에 갈 수 있을지도 몰라. 이 물 위에 계속 있는 위험은 감수하지 말아야지.

en: Home doesn't get closer if we don't get a move on.
Maybe I should just keep sitting here.
Try Again.
Or not.
I'm coming! I know, we gotta keep moving.
We're so close to home, we need to just get there.
ko: 집이 코앞이야, 그냥 도착하기만 하면 돼.

en: Gah! You almost hit me!
I can't believe you almost hit me with that tree. I feel less bad about hunting you now.
ko: 그 나무로 날 칠 뻔했다니 믿을 수가 없어. 이제 널 사냥하는 게 덜 미안하네.

en: Hopefully I hit you.
I have better aim than you do.
Yes!
Just what we needed.
I bet the pups will be happy about this.
Beaver hunting seems easy enough. It's not like they run. It's more of a meander.
ko: 비버 사냥은 꽤 쉬워 보여. 달리는 게 아니라 어슬렁거리는 수준이잖아.

en: I know you'll provide the food we need.
ko: 네가 우리에게 필요한 식량이 되어 줄 거라는 걸 알아.

en: Now where'd you go?
Gah!
Oh, there you are.
And I should probably ready my rifle.
I don't think I want to kill a beaver with my bare hands.
If you don't mind just staying right there...
I shouldn't have wasted my time out here. I need to find some bullets.
ko: 여기서 시간 낭비하지 말았어야 했어. 총알을 찾아야 해.

en: I hear you, Chomper! I'm coming.
Dinner time.
We all gotta eat, buddy.
Slow moving food is the best food sometimes.
ko: 가끔은 느리게 움직이는 먹거리가 최고의 먹거리지.

en: I suppose we should get back to it.
No. no. no. no. no.
ko: 안 돼. 안 돼. 안 돼. 안 돼. 안 돼.

en: Ah!
What the?!
Ok. ok. We're ok?
No beavers. No trees.
My head is good, right?
Yeah, ok. I'm ok.
Chomper. You good, buddy?
It's ok. Shake it off. It was just a really bad dream.
ko: 괜찮아. 털어 버려. 그냥 정말 나쁜 꿈이었어.

en: We're all ok.
Yeah, there's a chance we won't be ok. But there's a chance of that in everything.
ko: 그래, 우리가 괜찮지 않을 가능성도 있지. 근데 그건 무슨 일에나 있는 거야.

en: It doesn't mean you don't do it.
ko: 그렇다고 안 할 이유는 안 되지.

en: But maybe we should stay away from beavers dropping trees.
ko: 그래도 나무를 쓰러뜨리는 비버는 피하는 게 좋겠어.

en: No need to risk it.
Unless absolutely necessary.
Aaaaah!
Oh god. Oh god. oh god.
There's a med pack still on the sled.
You'll be ok.
Barely.
A beaver.
I almost died from a beaver.
No wonder people go missing up here.
EVERYTHING IS TRYING TO KILL YOU.
We just have to be careful. VERY VERY careful.
ko: 그냥 조심하면 돼. 아주 아주 조심.

en: I'm not ready to leave you, Chomper. We've got so much more to do up here.
ko: 아직 널 두고 떠날 준비가 안 됐어, 촘퍼. 여기서 할 일이 훨씬 많이 남았어.

en: But this is the most hardcore, thrown into the deep end, situation possible.
ko: 그래도 이건 깊은 물에 내던져진, 최고로 하드코어한 상황이야.

en: AAAAAH!
Seriously?
Hi, I'm the person who had a beaver drop a log on her head. Would you like to hear the story?
ko: 안녕하세요, 비버가 떨어뜨린 통나무에 머리를 맞은 사람입니다. 이야기 들어 보실래요?

en: That's it. That's the whole story.
Ugh. My head is killing me.
I need to get back to the pups.
How long was I out?
Shit. I should get back to the pups.
Beavers aren't full of wood chips or sawdust, right?
ko: 비버 속이 나무 부스러기나 톱밥으로 차 있진 않겠지?

en: Do they actually ingest the tree when they chomp it down?
ko: 나무를 갉아 쓰러뜨릴 때 진짜로 삼키는 건가?

en: Chomper ingests everything he chews on. So much fluff.
ko: 촘퍼는 씹는 건 다 삼키는데. 솜털 같은 거 엄청나게.

en: No matter.
We don't get to be picky.
I'll hope it's like when you use a cedar plank on salmon or in a smoker.
ko: 연어를 삼나무 판에 굽거나 훈제기에 넣을 때처럼 되길 바라야지.

en: Looks like there's a good fishing spot up there.
ko: 저기 낚시하기 좋은 곳이 있는 것 같아.

en: Try to fish.
Skip it.
Chomper, you want to come keep me company?
They say you're supposed to have patience to fish.
It was something I was always terrible at. My mind would wander... the fish would hit...
ko: 난 늘 그게 젬병이었어. 딴생각을 하다 보면... 물고기가 물고...

en: And I lost my fishing pole to the river.
I still feel bad about what propbably happened to that fish.
ko: 그 물고기가 어떻게 됐을지 생각하면 아직도 미안해.

en: Ah. You're right! We've got one!
ko: 아. 네 말이 맞아! 하나 물었어!

en: Thanks, buddy. I wasn't paying attention.
I needed you back when I was a kid.
Give the pup some pets.
So yeah, this is just how fishing goes, huh?
Thanks for coming out here with me.
I know it's a long way from home and we've got fewer soft beds to use.
ko: 집에서 멀리 떠나왔고, 푹신한 침대도 줄어들었지.

en: But I needed a change.
I was feeling stuck and lost.
Though, I'm feeling actually lost now.
ko: 뭐, 지금은 진짜로 길을 잃은 기분이지만.

en: But, I'm not worried about what anyone else thinks...
ko: 그래도 남들이 어떻게 생각하든 걱정 안 해...

en: We don't have time to worry about that, buddy. It's just about us getting home. About us taking care of each other.
ko: 그런 거 걱정할 시간 없어, 친구. 중요한 건 집에 가는 거야. 서로를 돌보는 거고.

en: And right now, that's what I need.
ko: 그리고 지금 내게 필요한 건 그거야.

en: To know I can get through this pain. This challenge. One that was a little harder than I planned for.
ko: 이 고통을 이겨 낼 수 있다는 걸 아는 것. 이 도전을. 계획했던 것보다 조금 더 힘든 도전을.

en: Cause if we can handle this, we'll be fine.
ko: 이걸 감당할 수 있다면, 우린 괜찮을 거니까.

en: I couldn't do this without you. Hell, I wouldn't have thought to do this without you.
ko: 너 없이는 못 했을 거야. 아니, 너 없었으면 이런 생각조차 안 했을 거야.

en: Here, take the fish.
Alright, they're waiting for us, buddy.
I appreciate you joining this journey, Stilton.
ko: 이 여정에 함께해 줘서 고마워, 스틸턴.

en: It's a little more of a trial than I originally expected.
ko: 처음 예상했던 것보다는 좀 더 시련이네.

en: I knew I wanted a challenge. A big reset to figure out what I actually wanted.
ko: 도전을 원한다는 건 알고 있었어. 내가 진짜로 원하는 게 뭔지 알아내기 위한 큰 리셋을.

en: And as much as I miss a warm bed, I'm happy to be here with you and the rest of the team.
ko: 따뜻한 침대가 그립긴 하지만, 너랑 나머지 팀이랑 여기 있어서 행복해.

en: Scared shitless sometimes. Pretty much feeling like I've made every possible wrong decision.
ko: 가끔은 무서워 죽겠어. 가능한 모든 잘못된 결정을 다 내린 기분이야.

en: But each time you pups look at me, each time you leap at the end of the line, ready to run, I feel that energy for life.
ko: 그래도 너희가 날 바라볼 때마다, 줄 끝에서 달릴 준비를 하고 뛰어오를 때마다, 삶의 에너지를 느껴.

en: That energy to just take the next step.
ko: 그냥 다음 한 걸음을 내디딜 에너지 말이야.

en: And worry about that step alone. Cause there will be more ahead of it, but we can't get there until we just take that next one.
ko: 그리고 그 한 걸음만 걱정하는 거야. 그 뒤로도 걸음이 이어지겠지만, 다음 걸음을 내딛지 않으면 거기까지 갈 수 없으니까.

en: Thanks, Stilton.
Let's get back to the others.
anim: She hands the fish to Stilton.
Here you go, Stilton. You earned this.
ko: 자, 스틸턴. 넌 이걸 받을 자격이 있어.

en: I wouldn't have caught it without you.
Yeah, I'm a big fan of fish, too.
Let's get back to everyone.
Great catch, Chomper!
You earned it.
I probably would've lost our fishing pole without you.
Feeling good?
Alright, let's get back to the others.
I can't believe the ice can just control a river of this size.
ko: 얼음이 이렇게 큰 강을 덮어 버릴 수 있다니 믿기지 않아.

en: How much food is just traveling beneath us?
ko: 우리 발밑으로 얼마나 많은 먹거리가 지나다니고 있을까?

en: Looks like there's an opening up ahead.
ko: 저 앞에 구멍이 있는 것 같아.

en: It looks solid enough to hold us.
ko: 우리가 올라가도 버틸 만큼 단단해 보여.

en: Let's see what we can catch.
There's nothing for us here except the chance for an icy end.
ko: 여긴 얼음 속 최후를 맞을 가능성 말고는 아무것도 없어.

en: And now we wait.
You sit here... hang with your thoughts?
Definitely what I need... more time with my thoughts.
ko: 딱 내가 필요한 거네... 생각할 시간이 더 생기는 거.

en: Oh hey a bite!
I didn't even get to think about how bears get to fish yet.
ko: 곰은 어떻게 낚시하는지 생각할 틈도 없었네.

en: Well, back at it.
You know, we're actually doing pretty well!
I mean, we're still alive. And we're getting closer to our new home.
ko: 아니, 아직 살아 있잖아. 그리고 새 보금자리에 점점 가까워지고 있어.

en: You know... just have to make it past some more trees... and snow... probably some more snow... and then we'll be there.
ko: 그러니까... 나무를 좀 더 지나고... 눈도... 아마 눈을 좀 더 지나면... 도착할 거야.

en: But you pups look like an incredible team. You even move as one.
ko: 그래도 너희는 정말 대단한 팀 같아. 한 몸처럼 움직이잖아.

en: I'm very impressed with your sled dog instincts.
You've pulled us faster than I ever could've imagined, Gale.
ko: 네가 상상도 못 할 만큼 빨리 우릴 끌어 줬어, 게일.

en: Bodega, there's not a meal you won't protect.
ko: 보데가, 넌 지키지 않는 끼니가 없구나.

en: You're on the greatest treasure hunt ever, Fin.
ko: 넌 역대 최고의 보물찾기를 하고 있어, 핀.

en: You've kept your eyes on the trail so we don't miss anything, Stilton.
ko: 넌 우리가 아무것도 놓치지 않게 트레일을 계속 지켜봐 줬어, 스틸턴.

en: You've had my back since the beginning. I hope you find your voice, too, Barkley. I'd like to start scaring off creatures.
ko: 넌 처음부터 내 편이 되어 줬어. 너도 네 목소리를 찾길 바라, 바클리. 동물들을 겁줘서 쫓아내고 싶거든.

en: You're keeping us out of trouble, and far away from elk, Slayer.
ko: 넌 우리를 말썽에서, 그리고 엘크에게서 멀리 떨어뜨려 주고 있어, 슬레이어.

en: Igloo, you are always ready to protect the team.
ko: 이글루, 넌 언제나 팀을 지킬 준비가 돼 있구나.

en: Noodle, you seem to be finding the new challenges you needed.
ko: 누들, 네가 원하던 새로운 도전을 찾고 있는 것 같네.

en: Chomper, you've truly unlocked your prey drive.
ko: 촘퍼, 넌 진짜로 사냥 본능을 깨웠구나.

en: Even if you went nose first into a fluffy ball of spikes. But I think you've learned your lesson... right?
ko: 가시투성이 털뭉치에 코부터 들이밀긴 했지만. 그래도 교훈은 얻었겠지... 그렇지?

en: I mean we might already be out of food, but I'm sure we'll be fine.
ko: 아니, 벌써 식량이 떨어졌을 수도 있지만, 분명 괜찮을 거야.

en: And we probably don't need any more bullets.
ko: 그리고 총알도 더는 필요 없을 거야.

en: Somebody, hid some bullets out here, right?
ko: 누군가 여기에 총알을 숨겨 뒀겠지, 그렇지?

en: And it's been really nice not seeing any other people. It's just us and the world.
ko: 그리고 다른 사람을 아무도 안 만나니까 정말 좋아. 우리와 이 세상뿐이야.

en: A world that seems ready to kill us.
ko: 우릴 죽일 준비가 된 것 같은 세상이지만.

en: I didn't expect to talk out loud this much, but we're really doing this. We're, well, I'm, becoming a musher. Like a real one.
ko: 이렇게 소리 내서 혼잣말을 많이 할 줄은 몰랐는데, 우리 진짜로 해내고 있어. 우리가, 아니, 내가 머셔가 되어 가고 있어. 진짜 머셔.

en: I think Margot would be proud.
I still can't believe she gave us her old cabin... and gear.
ko: 마고가 자기 옛 오두막이랑... 장비를 우리한테 줬다는 게 아직도 믿기지 않아.

en: We're making progress. We should be there soon enough.
ko: 잘 나아가고 있어. 곧 도착할 거야.

en: But we're making our way.
Oh hey... you're not that wolf that was howling at us before, are you?
ko: 오 이런... 너 아까 우리한테 울부짖던 그 늑대는 아니지?

en: Oh hey... a little wolf friend.
It's ok, you can stay over there, we don't mind.
ko: 괜찮아, 거기 있어도 돼. 우린 상관없어.

en: Mush, mush!
Barkley! We've got to do something.
Just stay back, Barkley. It's ok, we've got this...
ko: 물러서 있어, 바클리. 괜찮아, 우리가 할게...

en: Shoot at wolf.
Throw food at wolf.
Swing rifle at wolf.
Steady steady. You have to help Barkley.
Yeah, you did real good, buddy.
I need to patch you up, Barkley.
Ok, fine, belly rubs first.
Come on, back to the sled.
That wolf shouldn't have messed with us. And definitely shouldn't have hurt you.
ko: 그 늑대는 우릴 건드리지 말았어야 했어. 그리고 절대 널 다치게 하지 말았어야 했어.

en: I'm not hurting you, right buddy?
You did good, Barkley. Really good.
But let's get back to the sled, ok? I need to try to heal you up.
ko: 그래도 썰매로 돌아가자, 알았지? 치료해 줘야 해.

en: Barkley, leave it! You've done enough.
Yeah, ok, you did great, buddy. You alright?
ko: 그래, 좋아, 정말 잘했어, 친구. 괜찮아?

en: I need to patch you up, Barkley...
Ok, fine. You deserve belly rubs.
ko: 좋아, 알았어. 넌 배 쓰다듬을 받을 자격이 있어.

en: Let's heal you up as soon as we can.
You should think about trying to scare things away before you have to use your teeth sometime. You're pretty intimidating.
ko: 언젠간 이빨을 쓰기 전에 겁줘서 쫓아내는 것도 생각해 봐. 너 꽤 위압적이거든.

en: You tell em, Barkley! Take that snack and go! Leave us alone!
ko: 본때를 보여 줘, 바클리! 그 간식 가지고 꺼져! 우릴 내버려 둬!

en: Are you ok, buddy. He got you pretty good.
I guess you're doing ok enough for belly rubs...
ko: 배 쓰다듬을 받을 정도로는 괜찮은가 보네...

en: Give belly rubs.
Get back to the sled.
Let's get you patched up.
Good boy, Barkley. We did it.
Are you ok? He got you pretty good.
Belly rubs first?
Ok, belly rubs.
Back to the sled.
We gotta take care of you. Come on, let's go.
Ahh. Let go!
Ok, just a scratch. A scratch from a giant wolf mouth...
ko: 좋아, 그냥 긁힌 거야. 거대한 늑대 입에 긁힌 거...

en: We can patch this up. We know how to do this.
ko: 치료할 수 있어. 어떻게 하는지 알잖아.

en: Gah. Those were bigger teeth then I expected.
Are we really sure about this?
Having death nightmares about the creatures that might kill me isn't exactly building confidence.
ko: 날 죽일지도 모르는 동물들한테 죽는 악몽을 꾸는 건 자신감에 별로 도움이 안 돼.

en: There's an owl nearby somewhere.
I'm not sure I actually believe in your curse.
Let's go look for the owl
Owls take revenge seriously.
So just a run by moose smacking to make sure I know where I am, huh.
ko: 그러니까 내가 어디 있는지 확인시켜 주려고 무스가 지나가면서 한 대 치고 간 거구나.

en: Hoo! Hoo!
Not an owl.
Well played.
I don't think I like moose. Or owls.
I'm not sure I actually like traveling on this ice.
ko: 이 얼음 위로 다니는 건 영 마음에 안 들어.

en: Noodle, did you hear something?
I think I'd like to get off the ice now.
Bodega?
How'd you get us out of here, boy?
ko: 어떻게 우릴 꺼내 준 거야, 녀석아?

en: Yeah, that would've worked up an appetite.
I've never been so grateful for a food motivated pup.
ko: 먹을 거에 동기 부여되는 강아지가 이렇게 고마웠던 적은 없어.

en: Ok, just need to pick myself up and get off this ice and get us a camp, huh, pups.
ko: 좋아, 정신 차리고 이 얼음에서 벗어나서 야영지를 차리자, 얘들아.

en: Fair warning, we won't be able to start a fire. So we're going to have to figure out how to warm ourselves up soon.
ko: 미리 말해 두는데, 불은 못 피울 거야. 그러니까 곧 몸을 녹일 방법을 찾아야 해.

en: Good work, Bodega. Finish that up and let's go.
ko: 잘했어, 보데가. 그거 다 먹고 가자.

en: I know, Bodega. You did real good and I owe you a treat. I just don't have one to give right now.
ko: 알아, 보데가. 정말 잘했고 간식 빚진 것도 알아. 지금 줄 게 없을 뿐이야.

en: But we'll get one soon.
Let's just set up a camp and we'll make a plan from there.
ko: 일단 야영지를 차리고 거기서 계획을 세우자.

en: Anywhere that's not on this ice.
And a fire would be nice right about now. I'm freezing. Not that you pups aren't too.
ko: 지금 불이 있으면 정말 좋겠다. 얼어 죽겠어. 너희도 마찬가지겠지만.

en: Look out!
Stay back!
Keep yelling.
Stay away from them!
I can't shoot now...
Iggy!
I said stay back!
I hit it! I don't know how, but I did!
Oh god! You ok, girl?
You're a little hurt, girl...
But we can fix that up.
Just ride in the sled for a bit, the team will be ok.
ko: 잠깐 썰매에 타고 있어. 팀은 괜찮을 거야.

en: Get out of here!
Leave them!
Why don't you try that on me!
Don't hurt them.
You don't want to do this.
You're not that big!
We didn't do anything to you.
ko: 우린 너한테 아무 짓도 안 했어.

en: We outnumber you by a lot.
Maybe not in pounds, though.
That worked?!
Are you all ok?
Iggy, did you protect all of us?
ko: 이기, 네가 우리 모두를 지켜 준 거야?

en: Oh god, girl, are you hurt?
Ok, you just get in the sled. We'll be ok. We'll get you taken care of.
ko: 좋아, 썰매에 타. 우린 괜찮을 거야. 널 잘 돌봐 줄게.

en: I don't know how we'd do this without you, Igloo.
ko: 너 없이 우리가 어떻게 했을지 모르겠어, 이글루.

en: You put the team before yourself every time.
ko: 넌 매번 너보다 팀을 먼저 생각하는구나.

en: I'm going to try to be as good as you.
Ok. You're all ok. You're all in here.
ko: 좋아. 다들 괜찮아. 다들 여기 있어.

en: I thought things were going to plan.
ko: 모든 게 계획대로 가고 있다고 생각했어.

en: I really did.
But now, I'm not so sure...
The bears seem to think that we're here to provide them snacks.
ko: 곰들은 우리가 간식을 대 주러 온 줄 아나 봐.

en: Wolves are following us around.
And wolverine keep trying to get at you pups and the sled.
A moose rushed right at us. We only barely made it out ok.
ko: 무스가 우리한테 곧장 돌진했어. 간신히 무사히 빠져나왔지.

en: I knew the ice could break, I just never thought it actually would.
ko: 얼음이 깨질 수 있다는 건 알았지만, 진짜로 깨질 줄은 몰랐어.

en: I didn't even know that musk ox were out here and they don't care about what happens to us at all.
ko: 사향소가 여기 사는 줄도 몰랐는데, 걔들은 우리가 어떻게 되든 전혀 신경 안 써.

en: This might be too much for us.
But how do you know when something is actually is for you?
ko: 그런데 어떤 일이 진짜로 나한테 맞는 건지 어떻게 알 수 있지?

en: We can conquer whatever is out here.
ko: 여기 뭐가 있든 우린 이겨 낼 수 있어.

en: We'll find our way.
What's meant to be will be...
And we'll prove we can handle anything.
ko: 그리고 우리가 뭐든 감당할 수 있다는 걸 증명할 거야.

en: Look at what we've already done...
Our instincts have gotten us this far.
We've found the test we wanted.
And we've made it through.
So, if this is for us, it'll work.
ko: 그러니까, 이게 우리를 위한 거라면, 잘될 거야.

en: It has to.
We're alive, we're together.
That's what I wanted, right?
To feel alive? To figure out what I could actually handle?
ko: 살아 있다고 느끼는 것? 내가 실제로 뭘 감당할 수 있는지 알아내는 것?

en: I think there's something in that tree...
ko: 저 나무에 뭔가 있는 것 같아...

en: Gale, you seem intrigued.
Yeah let's ignore it.
Yeah, I thought you were too big to be a squirrel.
Do you pluck porcupines? Is that how that works?
ko: 호저 털은 뽑는 거야? 그렇게 하는 건가?

en: Watch it.
That sounds like too much work.
ko: 너무 손이 많이 갈 것 같아.

en: No, Gale! It's fine it's in the tree. It can't get you.
ko: 안 돼, 게일! 괜찮아, 나무 위에 있잖아. 널 못 건드려.

en: Gale! It's not the same one. It's probably not even related.
ko: 게일! 그때 그 녀석이 아니야. 아마 친척도 아닐 거야.

en: Come on! Let's go.
Shoot the porcupine.
Attempt to drag Gale away.
Ok, just please don't land on Gale...
ko: 좋아, 제발 게일 위로만 떨어지지 마...

en: Well at least that got your attention, girl.
ko: 음, 적어도 네 관심은 끌었네, 아가씨.

en: Unfortunately, it didn't get us a snack...
Come on, Gale. Let's leave it. Your nose is safe today and I'd like to keep it that way.
ko: 가자, 게일. 그냥 두자. 오늘 네 코는 무사하고, 계속 그랬으면 좋겠어.

en: Gale!
Not again!
Oh, girl. I'm sorry. I was trying to protect you from those quills.
ko: 오, 아가씨. 미안해. 그 가시에서 널 지키려고 했는데.

en: And you can eat some of this for revenge.
I know you wanted vengeance, but you can't just try to bite them!
ko: 복수하고 싶었던 건 알지만, 그렇다고 그냥 물려고 하면 안 돼!

en: Ok, I know you didn't actually get to bite it, but I was trying to protect you. It just didn't work very well.
ko: 좋아, 실제로 물진 못했다는 거 알아. 그래도 널 지키려고 했어. 잘 안 됐을 뿐이지.

en: I'm sorry. But next time, please don't rush the porcupine. Remember? Quills.
ko: 미안해. 그래도 다음엔 제발 호저한테 달려들지 마. 기억나? 가시.

en: I hope you don't have to keep learning this lesson.
ko: 이 교훈을 계속 배우지 않아도 되면 좋겠다.

en: Perfect!
Ok, Gale, the belly side is safe, just stay away from its back.
ko: 좋아, 게일, 배 쪽은 안전해. 등 쪽만 피해.

en: Maybe you can have a nibble of porcupine meat to sate your hunger for vengeance.
ko: 복수에 굶주린 마음을 달래려면 호저 고기를 좀 뜯어 먹어도 돼.

en: Gale. Come!
Good, girl!
Pet Gale.
Get back to sled.
Don't you remember?
You gotta stay away from porcupines. They're dangerous.
I'm just trying to protect you.
Yeah, you listened really well, Gale.
ko: 그래, 정말 말 잘 들었어, 게일.

en: You didn't need a nose full of quills.
ko: 코에 가시 가득 박힐 필요는 없었지.

en: This is a test, isn't it?
Ok, just stay there for a second.
Bye, porcupine.
Just think of it as practice.
You can't always be great at something the second you start.
But maybe I should just...
Move closer and try again
I mean, there's no reason not to make it a little easier.
ko: 아니, 조금 더 쉽게 만들지 않을 이유는 없지.

en: Ok, I really hope I can't miss from here.
ko: 좋아, 여기서는 진짜 빗나갈 수 없길 바라.

en: Ok (laughing) I really thought I was about to miss that.
I guess I really couldn't miss from here.
ko: 여기서는 정말 빗나갈 수가 없었나 보네.

en: Thank you, porcupine...
I did not think about the amount of work it was going to be to prep you...
ko: 널 손질하는 게 얼마나 일일지는 생각도 못 했네...

en: Yes! But seriously, do I have to pluck out all those quills?
ko: 좋아! 근데 진짜로, 그 가시를 다 뽑아야 해?

en: I wonder what I could make from all those quills?
ko: 그 가시들로 뭘 만들 수 있을까?

en: Spike collars. Yeah, those wouldn't be dangerous at all.
ko: 가시 목걸이. 그래, 그건 전혀 위험하지 않겠지.

en: Chomper, it's not a long squirrel. It's a weasel.
ko: 촘퍼, 저건 길쭉한 다람쥐가 아니야. 족제비야.

en: Fine. We can check it out.
No, leave it.
Come on, Chomper, let's go.
See, it got away.
Come on, buddy, you gotta believe me.
ko: 제발, 친구, 내 말 좀 믿어.

en: Ok then. I didn't realize one squirrel hunt was going to release such a single-minded creature.
ko: 그래 그럼. 다람쥐 사냥 한 번으로 이렇게 외곬수인 녀석이 깨어날 줄은 몰랐네.

en: You're really good at this but also, you don't have to go after everything.
ko: 너 정말 잘하긴 하는데, 모든 걸 다 쫓을 필요는 없어.

en: Come on, let's get back to the others.
Also, could you stop chewing the line all the time, bud? You can't all keep escaping to check out whatever you want.
ko: 그리고 줄 좀 그만 씹어 줄래, 친구? 다들 보고 싶은 걸 보러 계속 빠져나갈 순 없잖아.

en: There's nothing here, buddy. You can't take us to chase down whatever you want.
ko: 여긴 아무것도 없어, 친구. 네가 원하는 걸 쫓으러 우릴 끌고 다닐 순 없어.

en: Leaders have to think about what's best for everyone not just themselves.
ko: 리더는 자기만이 아니라 모두에게 뭐가 최선인지 생각해야 해.

en: I knew coming to the forest would pay off!
Looks like we have a lone birch tree up ahead, pups.
ko: 저 앞에 자작나무가 한 그루 있는 것 같아, 얘들아.

en: Nothing to waste time or hunger on right now. Let's keep going.
ko: 지금 시간이나 허기를 낭비할 만한 건 없어. 계속 가자.

en: Time to make quick work of you...
So much easier than ripping this off by hand.
Looks like we're done here.
Maybe I've gained some muscle since last time.
I did not anticipate this being such a pain.
I'll be able to have a hot meal tonight.
ko: 오늘 밤엔 따뜻한 밥을 먹을 수 있겠어.

en: Here's hoping I can find food to make the most of this.
ko: 이걸 최대한 활용할 식량을 찾을 수 있길 바라.

en: Well at least I won't freeze to death.
Aww, a little bear cub!
And where are you off to?
Let's follow it and see.
Uh, let's run away.
I'm not sure this was the best idea.
Are you all alone?
I probably shouldn't risk this. Let's go.
ko: 이런 위험은 감수하지 않는 게 좋겠어. 가자.

en: Let's watch and see what happens.
Seems like time to hunt.
You really are alone, huh?
I'd be lonely out here if I didn't have this pack of dogs to keep me busy.
ko: 이 개 무리가 정신없게 해 주지 않았으면 나도 여기서 외로웠을 거야.

en: Though I have really taken to this talking to myself thing.
ko: 혼잣말하는 데 완전히 맛 들이긴 했지만.

en: Do bears talk to themselves? What are you thinking about all the time?
ko: 곰도 혼잣말을 할까? 넌 늘 무슨 생각을 해?

en: Like, man, can't wait to catch those salmon. Wonder if I can get one hundred this year.
ko: 이를테면, 아, 빨리 연어 잡고 싶다. 올해는 백 마리 잡을 수 있을까.

en: Or, like, my back itches. Anyone know of a good scratching tree?
ko: 아니면, 등이 가렵다. 등 긁기 좋은 나무 아는 사람?

en: I bet my dreams would be crazy if I slept for months.
ko: 몇 달씩 자면 꿈이 엄청 기괴하겠다.

en: Chomper... You just chewing on sticks, boy?
ko: 촘퍼... 너 그냥 나뭇가지 씹고 있는 거야, 녀석아?

en: Barkley, was that you?
Am I being lured into a trap?
I don't think you're actually alone, little bear cub.
ko: 넌 사실 혼자가 아닌 것 같은데, 아기 곰아.

en: I didn't come out here to be a snack. Time to get back to business.
ko: 간식이 되려고 여기 온 건 아니야. 다시 일해야지.

en: So... I'm just gonna go.
No way. That's the tree!
Wait, don't lots of bears congregate at the same tree?
ko: 잠깐, 곰들이 같은 나무에 잔뜩 모이지 않던가?

en: I saw that somewhere.
One cub is fine. But if another shows up... Less so. Oh god, where's the mother? Time to leave. Probably past time to leave.
ko: 새끼 하나는 괜찮아. 근데 또 나타나면... 덜 괜찮지. 세상에, 어미는 어디 있지? 떠날 시간이야. 아마 진작 떠났어야 했고.

en: Is that another cub out there?
ko: 저기 또 다른 새끼가 있는 거야?

en: It's like the same size as this one.
But, much further away.
That's not a cub, is it?
Yep. Ok. As close as I want to be. Second thought, closer than I'd like to be.
ko: 그래. 좋아. 여기까지가 내가 원하는 거리야. 다시 생각해 보니, 원하는 것보다 가까워.

en: Time to go.
I'm kinda glad I missed that shot.
ko: 그 한 발이 빗나가서 좀 다행이야.

en: I did not realize cubs were going to be this cute.
ko: 아기 곰이 이렇게 귀여울 줄은 몰랐어.

en: I probably should've packed a camera.
I don't need to "capture" these moments. I'm living them.
ko: 이 순간들을 '담을' 필요는 없어. 난 지금 이 순간을 살고 있으니까.

en: Wait, is that the mother?
Time to run away now.
Just one more second.
Yep. All done here. No need to get closer to that really big face... full of teeth.
ko: 그래. 여기선 다 끝났어. 저 이빨 가득한... 정말 큰 얼굴에 더 가까이 갈 필요는 없지.

en: She just eskimo kissed the cub.
I bet that's how it looks when I boop Chomper.
ko: 내가 촘퍼 코를 콕 찌를 때도 저렇게 보이겠지.

en: Am dead. Though I probably will be if I stay any longer.
ko: 심장 녹아 죽겠다. 근데 더 있다간 진짜로 죽을지도.

en: I know you're just a kid, but we need food.
ko: 너 아직 새끼인 거 알지만, 우린 식량이 필요해.

en: I'm sorry, but we're starving.
It's not personal. It's hunger.
Am I really doing this?
I guess I am.
I missed. Huh. Maybe that was my subconscious.
I knew I shouldn't have shot at a cub! It's like the universe wanted me to be out of bullets.
ko: 새끼를 쏘면 안 된다는 걸 알았어야 했어! 우주가 내 총알이 떨어지길 바라는 것 같아.

en: Great. I missed.
And it ran away.
We were born for this. We are unstoppable!
ko: 우린 이러려고 태어났어. 아무도 우릴 못 막아!

en: Desperate times require desperate kills.
ko: 절박한 때엔 절박한 사냥이 필요한 법.

en: Thank you.
You think maybe...
It was looking around for its...
ko: 그 녀석이 뭔가를 찾고 있던 건...

en: Nah, it was on its own. It was just wandering off.
What if...
Did I kill its mother?
Oh god. I can't kill this one too, can I?
ko: 세상에. 얘까지 죽일 순 없잖아, 그렇지?

en: We have to be strong. Sometimes being strong, well, you don't always do things you like.
ko: 강해져야 해. 강하다는 건, 음, 원하는 일만 할 수는 없다는 거야.

en: You have to keep your values even when there's no one to hold you accountable. You have to know what's right.
ko: 아무도 책임을 묻지 않을 때도 가치관을 지켜야 해. 뭐가 옳은지 알아야 해.

en: Shoot at the mother.
Try to leave.
You're right. I should not have followed your kid.
ko: 네 말이 맞아. 네 새끼를 따라가지 말았어야 했어.

en: I don't even know what I thought I was going to do.
ko: 내가 뭘 하려고 했던 건지도 모르겠어.

en: I'm sorry. We'll just be on our way.
I will get my revenge.
Why didn't I assume the mother was nearby?
ko: 왜 어미가 근처에 있을 거라고 생각 못 했지?

en: Oh come on. I hit you!
That had to have hurt!
Fire again.
Try to run.
Please, please, please. You can't keep surviving these.
ko: 제발, 제발, 제발. 이걸 계속 버틸 순 없잖아.

en: Just one more. One more...
I don't have one more...
No! Don't jam now!
ko: 안 돼! 지금 걸리면 안 돼!

en: See! You can't mess with me!
That was for Chomper!
Ok, wow, so we just killed a bear.
ko: 좋아, 와, 우리가 방금 곰을 잡았어.

en: We're a little torn up but we are most definitely alive.
ko: 좀 찢기고 다쳤지만 확실히 살아 있어.

en: I don't know if I've ever felt this alive.
ko: 이렇게 살아 있다고 느낀 적이 있었나 싶어.

en: And small.
She could've wiped us out with a single paw.
ko: 앞발 한 번이면 우릴 다 쓸어버릴 수 있었을 텐데.

en: Stop! I'm not food! I'm big! Grr!!
ko: 그만! 난 먹이가 아니야! 난 크다고! 으르렁!!

en: I didn't mean it any harm.
Uhhh, what was that?
Chomper, was that you?
Slayer, it's ok. I'm sure it's nothing.
ko: 슬레이어, 괜찮아. 분명 아무것도 아닐 거야.

en: Ok, I heard it again.
Yep, you're right, Slayer. Time to go.
ko: 그래, 네 말이 맞아, 슬레이어. 갈 시간이야.

en: I'm good. I don't need to meet a demon.
Was that you?
Slayer, it's just an elk. It's ok.
I've got you.
I'll scare it away.
I'll shoot it.
Let's leave.
We don't need to face any more fears right now than we already have. Let's go, buddy.
ko: 지금 이미 마주한 것보다 더 많은 두려움과 마주할 필요는 없어. 가자, 친구.

en: We're not afraid of you! Get out of here!
Slayer is a strong, independent woman who fears no elk!
ko: 슬레이어는 엘크 따윈 두려워하지 않는 강하고 독립적인 여성이라고!

en: Ready, Slayer. Help me out here.
Grrrrrrrrr.
Be gone!
See, girl! You've got this!
ko: 봤지, 아가씨! 넌 할 수 있어!

en: You're the top of the food chain.
Confidence doesn't have to be intimidation
You have to remember you're the descendant of a wolf
ko: 네가 늑대의 후손이라는 걸 기억해야 해

en: Never back down. They can tell you're ready for them. They can't intimidate you.
ko: 절대 물러서지 마. 쟤들은 네가 맞설 준비가 됐다는 걸 알아. 쟤들은 널 겁줄 수 없어.

en: Find that balance between trying to eat everything in the world, and chasing down only what you need.
ko: 세상 모든 걸 먹으려 드는 것과 필요한 것만 쫓는 것 사이의 균형을 찾아.

en: More often than not, they're food for us.
Just remember this for the future elk we encounter. No need to be afraid.
ko: 앞으로 만날 엘크들한테도 이걸 기억해. 무서워할 필요 없어.

en: I wonder if I do.
Maybe it's you, Slayer.
Who am I kidding, it's Chomper.
I don't appreciate you spooking my dogs with your menacing silhouette and gore-ready horns.
ko: 그 위협적인 실루엣이랑 찌를 준비가 된 뿔로 우리 개들을 겁주는 건 달갑지 않아.

en: But I do appreciate a good meal... and hopefully you're it.
ko: 그래도 맛있는 끼니는 언제나 환영이지... 네가 그게 되면 좋겠다.

en: I told you I had your back... and your stomach.
ko: 내가 지켜 준다고 했잖아... 네 배도 말이야.

en: You want a treat for being so brave?
Give Slayer a treat.
Actually maybe later.
Yeah, you deserve part of the bounty. Let's go get it.
ko: 그래, 넌 전리품을 나눠 가질 자격이 있어. 가서 챙기자.

en: I'll go collect our hunt. Thanks for your help, Slayer.
ko: 사냥한 걸 챙기러 갈게. 도와줘서 고마워, 슬레이어.

en: You like that fresh snack, Slayer?
Looks like you have some extra pep in your step.
And we've got plenty for later.
Maybe next time you hear that shriek you'll think of a tasty meat snack.
ko: 다음에 그 비명을 들으면 맛있는 고기 간식이 떠오를지도 몰라.

en: Slayer, I think we might've made it mad.
ko: 슬레이어, 우리가 쟤를 화나게 한 것 같아.

en: You might be right about being afraid of these creatures.
ko: 이 동물들을 무서워하는 게 맞을지도 모르겠다.

en: What you don't want to test our luck?
I hear you. Let's...
Yeah, I don't want to meet the pointy end of your friend over there, Slayer.
ko: 그래, 저기 네 친구의 뾰족한 쪽이랑 만나고 싶진 않아, 슬레이어.

en: Running away is a valiant plan.
Wait, where are you going?!
Slayer, did you have to howl?
Fine, let's go.
I was going to get us dinner. Why'd you scare it away?
ko: 저녁거리를 구하려던 참이었는데. 왜 쫓아 버렸어?

en: Yeah, yeah, you're scared, but we've got to eat.
ko: 그래, 그래, 무서운 건 알지만, 우리도 먹어야 해.

en: I know. I shouldn't have forced you into this.
ko: 알아. 너한테 억지로 시키지 말았어야 했어.

en: You can't run from things anymore, Slayer. You showed it you can handle yourself.
ko: 더는 도망만 칠 순 없어, 슬레이어. 넌 네가 스스로를 지킬 수 있다는 걸 보여 줬어.

en: Come on. Let's get ourselves home.
But! You showed it you're not afraid!
ko: 그래도! 넌 두려워하지 않는다는 걸 보여 줬잖아!

en: I think that's a win. Don't you?
ko: 그 정도면 이긴 거야. 안 그래?

en: Yep. Yep. Back to the sled.
We're almost home. No need to risk things. You're right.
ko: 거의 집이야. 위험을 감수할 필요 없어. 네 말이 맞아.

en: Did you make that sound?
Right, then.
So... what does that mean exactly?
Are we going to be friends?
You know I'm not a deer, right?
Is that my hunting call?
Fine. I'll leave.
This is not a mystery I need to uncover right now.
ko: 지금 당장 풀어야 할 수수께끼는 아니야.

en: Good luck to you.
I don't know if I can get my voice to do that.
ko: 내 목소리로 그런 소리를 낼 수 있을지 모르겠어.

en: Just gotta make like two sounds at once. Sounds easy enough.
ko: 그냥 소리 두 개를 동시에 내면 돼. 쉬워 보이는데.

en: Uhhh.
This talking to animals thing is not going well for me.
ko: 동물이랑 대화하는 건 나한테 영 안 맞네.

en: It worked with a squirrel!
I'm friends with the owls! Or an owl!
ko: 난 부엉이들이랑 친구라고! 아니면 부엉이 한 마리랑!

en: One day I will speak with one of you.
ko: 언젠가는 너희 중 하나랑 대화하고 말 거야.

en: At least my dogs listen to me.
ko: 적어도 우리 개들은 내 말을 듣잖아.

en: Isn't that right, Chomper?
Chomper! What are you chewing on now?
ko: 촘퍼! 이번엔 또 뭘 씹고 있어?

en: I pretty much assume all animal calls are either warnings or mating calls.
ko: 동물 울음소리는 다 경고 아니면 짝짓기 신호라고 생각하고 있어.

en: Considering I'm not a deer, are you warning me or others?
ko: 난 사슴이 아니니까, 나한테 경고하는 거야, 다른 애들한테 경고하는 거야?

en: Or is this a warning of self?
Pull out gun to hunt.
I'm going to heed whatever warning this is and go.
You're right. I have become the danger for you.
ko: 네 말이 맞아. 내가 너한테 위험한 존재가 됐구나.

en: I'm ok with that.
Is that what I want?
The world makes you what you are.
ko: 세상이 우리를 지금의 모습으로 만드는 거야.

en: I didn't push hard enough back home.
I'm not going to do the same here. Doing that here means death.
ko: 여기선 그러지 않을 거야. 여기서 그러면 죽음이니까.

en: I've been so focused on not failing, I'm not sure if I've kept sight of what I want.
ko: 실패하지 않는 데만 너무 집중해서, 내가 원하는 게 뭔지 계속 보고 있었는지 모르겠어.

en: If I get to the end but I've given up everything about who I thought I was... then what?
ko: 끝까지 갔는데 내가 생각하던 나 자신을 전부 포기했다면... 그다음은?

en: You can only make the decisions put in front of you.
ko: 눈앞에 놓인 결정만 내릴 수 있을 뿐이야.

en: What is right is always changing.
And the battles I expected to fight aren't the ones that matter now.
ko: 그리고 내가 싸우게 될 거라 예상했던 싸움들은 이제 중요하지 않아.

en: I should get back to the pups.
I guess that shriek was for me.
ko: 그 비명은 나를 향한 거였나 봐.

en: Looks like I've become a thing to fear.
ko: 내가 두려움의 대상이 된 것 같아.

en: That seems like the best way to survive.
It's a lot easier when your food doesn't run away from you. It used to only happen with bunless hotdogs. Now... everything.
ko: 먹거리가 도망가지 않으면 훨씬 쉬워. 예전엔 빵 없는 핫도그만 그랬는데. 이젠... 전부 다.

en: Once we find home, we'll be able to set up a proper long term storage.
ko: 집을 찾으면 제대로 된 장기 저장고를 만들 수 있을 거야.

en: That'll be nice.
All right. Let's go.
Just like we planned it.
Let's pack up what we can and get back out there.
ko: 챙길 수 있는 건 챙겨서 다시 나가자.

en: What a waste of a bullet!
Wait, are you warning us now?
Oh, ok then.
Is there something up there?
Hi there?
Chomper, why are your hackles up?
Inspect it.
Nope. We don't need to figure out what this is.
ko: 아니. 이게 뭔지 알아낼 필요 없어.

en: Uhh. You ok, whatever you are?
You are really still. You're kinda freaking me out here.
ko: 너 정말 꼼짝도 안 하는구나. 좀 소름 끼치는데.

en: Approach it.
This is close enough for me... so i'm going to go.
ko: 나한텐 이 정도 거리면 충분해... 그러니까 갈게.

en: Ok, hold still.
You've got this. It's not even moving. Whatever it is...
ko: 넌 할 수 있어. 움직이지도 않잖아. 저게 뭐든 간에...

en: Um... I missed, right?
Why are you just standing there?
Nope. I do not like whatever this is.
ko: 싫어. 이게 뭐든 마음에 안 들어.

en: You can just stay there... which it seems like you will.
ko: 그냥 거기 있어도 돼... 그럴 것 같긴 하지만.

en: That hit, right?
I heard it hit. But it's not moving. Not dying. Not running. Not even a cry was made.
ko: 맞는 소리를 들었어. 근데 움직이질 않아. 죽지도 않아. 도망가지도 않아. 비명 한 번 안 질렀어.

en: Am I hallucinating?
I'm gonna go now.
What happened to you? How did this happen?
ko: 너 무슨 일이 있었던 거야? 어쩌다 이렇게 된 거야?

en: It's ok. It's just... frozen.
Try to salvage meat with axe.
I really hope someone doesn't find me like this.
ko: 누가 날 이런 모습으로 발견하지 않길 정말 바라.

en: Just gotta keep moving.
We'll get there. One step at a time.
At least it's preserved.
You need food.
You're saving bullets. This is how you survive.
ko: 총알을 아끼는 거야. 이게 살아남는 방법이야.

en: Med school did not prepare me for this.
ko: 의대에서는 이런 걸 안 가르쳐 줬는데.

en: Ok, well that was exhausting and a bit horrible. But, we got some extra food.
ko: 좋아, 음, 지치고 좀 끔찍했어. 그래도 식량을 좀 더 얻었어.

en: We've still got a lot of unknown to deal with, but I don't think I was actually prepared for what would be out here.
ko: 아직 모르는 게 잔뜩 남았지만, 여기 뭐가 있을지 제대로 각오가 돼 있진 않았던 것 같아.

en: I just kind of figured it'd be beautiful and cold.
But out here, you realize just how small you are. How the world is ready to wipe away your footsteps as quickly as you make them.
ko: 하지만 여기선 내가 얼마나 작은 존재인지 깨닫게 돼. 세상은 내가 발자국을 남기는 속도만큼 빠르게 그걸 지워 버릴 준비가 돼 있어.

en: Oh ah! Turn coming up. Sorry, pups.
ko: 오 아! 곧 커브야. 미안, 얘들아.

en: You're the only ones I have to talk to and clearly I'm working through some stuff.
ko: 내가 말할 상대가 너희뿐이라서, 그리고 보다시피 정리할 생각이 좀 많아서.

en: There's another thing with antlers out there!
ko: 저기 뿔 달린 녀석이 또 있어!

en: That's gotta be an elk, right? You can't be that big and that far away without being a sizeable creature.
ko: 저거 엘크 맞지? 저렇게 멀리 있는데도 저만큼 크면 덩치가 상당한 동물일 거야.

en: It's too far to be worth anything. Let's go.
ko: 너무 멀어서 쏠 가치가 없어. 가자.

en: I knew it! It's an elk.
It's so far away though.
Isn't that why we fixed up this gun? To take these kinds of shots?
ko: 이런 한 발을 쏘려고 총을 고친 거 아니었어?

en: I'm not sure if our gun is accurate enough for this shot.
ko: 우리 총이 이 거리를 맞힐 만큼 정확한지 모르겠어.

en: Shoot anyway.
Now is not the time.
Steady. And...
I can't pass up a chance for food. Though, can I fit more on my sled?
ko: 식량을 구할 기회는 놓칠 수 없어. 근데 썰매에 더 실을 수 있을까?

en: Please little bullet, find us a meal.
ko: 제발, 작은 총알아, 우리 끼니를 찾아 줘.

en: Ok. Line it up. Accomodate for distance and... this gun... and...
ko: 좋아. 조준하고. 거리를 감안하고... 이 총도 감안하고... 그리고...

en: My last bullet for multiple meals. I think that's a pretty good trade.
ko: 마지막 총알로 여러 끼니를 얻는다면. 꽤 괜찮은 거래인 것 같아.

en: Bring the best you can and the results will follow! For us, that means dinner!
ko: 최선을 다하면 결과는 따라오는 법! 우리한텐 그게 저녁이지!

en: No matter the distance or creature, we can get ourselves a meal.
ko: 거리가 얼마든 무슨 동물이든, 우린 끼니를 구할 수 있어.

en: We all have to serve our part. Thank you.
ko: 우린 모두 각자 몫을 해야 해. 고마워.

en: Bodega! You ready for snacks!
Don't worry, Slayer. I'll protect us!
ko: 걱정 마, 슬레이어. 내가 지켜 줄게!

en: Antler chews for everyone! They won't fill you up, but they'll keep your teeth clean.
ko: 모두에게 뿔 껌을! 배는 안 부르겠지만, 이빨은 깨끗해질 거야.

en: Let's get back to the trail.
Nooo! We were so close.
I really hoped this was a sure thing, but it was so far away.
ko: 확실한 한 발이길 정말 바랐는데, 너무 멀었어.

en: Maybe we'll meet again.
I shouldn't take shots that I can't make. I'm sorry you have to suffer now.
ko: 맞힐 수 없는 한 발은 쏘지 말았어야 했어. 이제 고통받게 해서 미안해.

en: It would be nice if something was easy. Just once, you know?
ko: 뭔가 하나쯤은 쉬우면 좋겠어. 딱 한 번만이라도, 알지?

en: Ugh. I should know better than to gamble like that.
ko: 으. 그런 도박은 하면 안 된다는 걸 알았어야 했는데.

en: All right! I'm coming, pups.
We had to take the risk... but now what?
ko: 위험을 감수해야 했어... 그런데 이제 어쩌지?

en: I suppose that's a risky shot no matter the gun you have.
ko: 어떤 총을 갖고 있든 위험한 한 발이었겠지.

en: That wasn't supposed to happen.
Yeah, that wasn't the best shot to take.
Oh well. Onward we go, I guess.
ko: 뭐, 어쩔 수 없지. 앞으로 가자.

en: Oh no. Not you again.
Chomper, don't get any bad ideas.
You already have one, don't you.
What in the?!
Run little skunk!
Get it, sky penguin!
Get it, owl!
Follow them
I'm really thankful you're not hunting me right now.
ko: 네가 지금 날 사냥하지 않아서 정말 다행이야.

en: You gotta get out of here, little skunk!
Or at least put up fight!
You almost had it!
You look very ready for this next attempt.
ko: 다음 시도를 할 준비가 단단히 된 것 같네.

en: Watch and see what happens.
Hunt the skunk.
Hunt the owl.
Try to talk it out.
Good riddance!
Oh no! Wow, owls are aggressive.
ko: 오 안 돼! 와, 부엉이 진짜 공격적이네.

en: Holy hell. That was incredible.
Did you guys see that?
Chomper, did you take notes?!
Ok, well, I guess we should get back to it now, huh.
ko: 좋아, 음, 이제 다시 하던 일로 돌아가야겠네.

en: Get him!
That was an amazing shot!
Your self defense mechanism is more powerful than I thought.
[starts gagging]
Ugh. I can taste it.
I'm going to puke.
Chomper, get me out of here!
Fin, cover your nose!
Get me out of here, pups!
Who's going to make the first move?!
I don't even know what I want to have happen.
ko: 내가 무슨 일이 일어나길 원하는지도 모르겠어.

en: No! Bodega, wait!
I wish you could run downwind from us, buddy.
ko: 네가 우리 바람 아래쪽으로 달려 주면 좋겠다, 친구.

en: But at least you're full.
Chomper it's not a squirrel! Leave it.
ko: 촘퍼, 그거 다람쥐 아니야! 내버려 둬.

en: Buddy, you've been sprayed before. Remember the park.
ko: 친구, 너 전에도 뒤집어쓴 적 있잖아. 공원 기억나?

en: And the tomato juice? And the vinegar?
We had to take like 20 baths and you wouldn't look at me for a week.
ko: 목욕을 스무 번은 했고 넌 일주일 동안 날 쳐다보지도 않았어.

en: You're just so proud of your stinky self.
ko: 넌 그냥 냄새나는 네 모습이 그렇게 자랑스럽구나.

en: It's how you've always wanted to smell, isn't it.
ko: 늘 이런 냄새가 나길 바랐던 거지, 그렇지?

en: Fine. At least you're full.
I hope my nostrils freeze over.
Slayer! No! The skunk it'll...
Uh. You can't jump that high, girl.
ko: 어. 넌 그렇게 높이 못 뛰어, 아가씨.

en: Though I can't blame you. Skunk meat is awful.
Though I totally understand. I wouldn't want to eat skunk either.
ko: 그래도 완전히 이해해. 나도 스컹크는 먹고 싶지 않아.

en: I'll find you something better to snack on, girl.
ko: 더 맛있는 간식을 찾아 줄게, 아가씨.

en: These owls keep taunting us.
Whoever said "owl good things come to those who wait" was a crazy person.
ko: 부엉, 기다리는 자에게 좋은 일이 온다고 한 사람은 미친 사람이었어.

en: I can't believe you almost hit Slayer with your pellet.
ko: 펠릿으로 슬레이어를 맞힐 뻔했다니 믿을 수가 없어.

en: Come on, Slayer. We don't need shrew bones.
ko: 가자, 슬레이어. 뒤쥐 뼈는 필요 없어.

en: Where the hell did you get a bullet? Did you eat an animal that already ate a bullet?
ko: 대체 총알을 어디서 구한 거야? 총알을 먹은 동물을 먹은 거야?

en: Is that possible?
You know what, Slayer, you did great.
You turned this owl into the best wilderness vending machine I've ever used.
ko: 넌 이 부엉이를 내가 써 본 최고의 야생 자판기로 만들었어.

en: Let's get back to the others, girl.
Don't worry, owl, this isn't for you.
ko: 걱정 마, 부엉이야. 이건 네 거 아니야.

en: Though it's a little creepy that you're just going to sit there and watch me.
ko: 그래도 거기 앉아서 날 계속 지켜보는 건 좀 소름 끼치는데.

en: Are you going to try to steal this from me?
I don't even know if I like skunk meat.
I don't even want to eat this. It'll probably go to the dogs.
ko: 이거 먹고 싶지도 않아. 아마 개들 차지가 되겠지.

en: I know. I know. I'm working on getting you a meal.
ko: 알아. 알아. 끼니를 구하려고 노력 중이야.

en: Oh no. I didn't mean it!
ko: 오 안 돼. 일부러 그런 거 아니야!

en: [slight dry heave]
Oh god. Oh god.
Breathe.
Nope. [gulps]
[pukes]
At least there wasn't much to lose.
Perfect. I lose my last dinner and today's.
ko: 완벽해. 어젯밤 저녁이랑 오늘 저녁을 다 날렸어.

en: I think I hate skunks.
I shouldn't have tried to kill you.
Next time I'm sending the pups after you.
I didn't even want to eat you. Some how you knew that.
ko: 널 먹고 싶지도 않았어. 어떻게 알았는지 모르겠지만.

en: But out here, food is food. Even if I really don't like the flavor.
ko: 그래도 여기선 먹을 거면 다 먹을 거야. 맛이 정말 별로여도.

en: Thanks for staying out of our way.
Thanks for helping us find a meal.
I appreciate your supervision.
Are we ok now? I didn't shoot you!
ko: 이제 우리 괜찮은 거지? 난 널 안 쐈다고!

en: I'm going to pretend we're good now.
I am definitely going to follow all owls.
Skunk meat is on the menu for someone!
I know you're supposed to be majestic, but you've always freaked me out.
ko: 너희가 위풍당당해야 한다는 건 알지만, 난 늘 너희가 무서웠어.

en: I used to worry about looking out the window and just seeing the moon reflect off you in the tree... staring at me.
ko: 창밖을 내다보면 나무 위에서 달빛에 비친 네가... 날 쳐다보고 있을까 봐 걱정하곤 했어.

en: And I know they say it's bad luck to kill an owl, but...
ko: 부엉이를 죽이면 재수가 없다고들 하는 건 알지만...

en: Consider this...
Payback for my nightmares.
A moment of desperation.
The food chain.
Me changing my mind.
I know you can't do anything to me now, besides help keep us alive.
ko: 이제 넌 나한테 아무것도 못 해. 우릴 살려 주는 것 말고는.

en: I'm not even afraid of the omen that says it's bad luck to kill an owl.
ko: 부엉이를 죽이면 재수 없다는 징조도 이제 안 무서워.

en: It's not that I actually want to kill you, even if I find you a little creepy.
ko: 좀 소름 끼치긴 해도, 진짜로 널 죽이고 싶은 건 아니야.

en: You just don't really move. I don't know if I can pass you up.
ko: 근데 넌 진짜 움직이질 않잖아. 그냥 지나칠 수 있을지 모르겠어.

en: We all have to kill the things that help keep us alive.
ko: 우린 모두 우릴 살려 주는 것들을 죽여야 해.

en: You have no problem risking the stench of a skunk for a good meal.
ko: 넌 맛있는 끼니를 위해서라면 스컹크 냄새쯤은 아무렇지도 않게 감수하지.

en: So I can't risk missing out on a meal even if it means we might have some bad luck.
ko: 그러니 나도 재수가 좀 없더라도 끼니를 놓치는 위험은 감수할 수 없어.

en: You know, as much as I like the idea of a bird in the hand, I'd rather not bring bad luck to this situation.
ko: 손안의 새 한 마리가 좋긴 하지만, 이 상황에 불운까지 끌어들이고 싶진 않아.

en: I'll take a caribou or a bunny or literally anything else in the bush if it means we might not have it worse than we already do.
ko: 지금보다 더 나빠지지 않는다면, 순록이든 토끼든 오지에 있는 다른 무엇이든 잡을게.

en: But, like, it's not actually bad luck to kill you, right?
ko: 근데, 널 죽인다고 진짜 재수가 없는 건 아니지?

en: That's just a made up thing?
I guess it's too late now.
Um. Coming, pups. Be right there.
I know this is a way of life out here, but maybe we could all work together.
ko: 이게 여기 삶의 방식이란 건 알지만, 우리 다 같이 힘을 합칠 수도 있지 않을까.

en: You could help me find some bunnies or something that tastes a little better?
ko: 토끼나, 좀 더 맛있는 걸 찾는 걸 도와줄 수 있잖아?

en: Skunk, you'll get to live.
Owl, you and I can go and hunt together.
ko: 부엉이, 너랑 나랑 같이 사냥하러 가자.

en: I was trying to help! I thought this would work for all of us.
ko: 도우려고 한 거야! 우리 모두한테 좋을 줄 알았어.

en: I'm sorry for getting in the way.
I should've shot you both.
ko: 둘 다 쏴 버릴 걸 그랬어.

en: I don't know why I keep talking to animals.
ko: 내가 왜 자꾸 동물한테 말을 거는지 모르겠어.

en: Yeah, I should let the natural order take over.
I probably scare both of you.
ko: 아마 내가 둘 다 겁주고 있겠지.

en: Understandable, I haven't showered in days.
I don't even want to know what I look like right now.
ko: 지금 내 몰골이 어떤지 알고 싶지도 않아.

en: My breath is probably as bad as your stink, skunk.
ko: 내 입 냄새도 아마 네 냄새만큼 지독할 거야, 스컹크야.

en: Well if it wasn't before, it is now. It feels like it's stuck to my tongue.
ko: 음, 전엔 안 그랬어도 이젠 그래. 혀에 달라붙은 것 같아.

en: Lesson learned. I'll leave you to both of your fates.
ko: 교훈을 얻었어. 둘 다 각자 운명에 맡길게.

en: I don't know why I keep trying to talk to animals.
ko: 내가 왜 자꾸 동물한테 말을 걸려고 하는지 모르겠어.

en: One day I will have a meaningful conversation with an animal.
ko: 언젠가는 동물이랑 의미 있는 대화를 나누고 말 거야.

en: You're the only ones I have to talk to. And I'm fairly certain my pups are getting sick of me.
ko: 내가 말할 상대는 너희뿐이야. 그리고 우리 애들이 나한테 질려 가는 게 분명해.

en: Ok, well Chomper isn't. He knows all my secrets. He's seen me at my worst and still sticks with me.
ko: 좋아, 촘퍼는 아니지. 내 비밀을 다 알잖아. 내 최악의 모습을 보고도 늘 곁에 있어 줘.

en: Dontcha, buddy? You're my best friend.
I can see you don't care... wait, you're gone. Ah. Ok, well, fine. Let's go guys.
ko: 신경 안 쓰는 거 다 보여... 잠깐, 가 버렸네. 아. 그래, 좋아. 가자, 얘들아.

en: What's that out there?
Is that the caribou I shot?
We don't have any bullets.
Let's leave it.
I guess we were meant to find you.
ko: 우리가 널 찾게 될 운명이었나 봐.

en: I did say we would finish this. I don't want to leave anything half done.
ko: 이걸 끝내겠다고 했잖아. 반쯤 하다 만 채로 두고 싶지 않아.

en: You shouldn't have to suffer. We can help.
ko: 넌 고통받을 필요 없어. 우리가 도와줄 수 있어.

en: I can't leave you like this.
ko: 널 이렇게 두고 갈 순 없어.

en: Sorry I didn't do a great job to start.
It's over now.
I wasn't suppose to fail at this.
Oh god. I don't have a way to help you.
I suppose we were both meant to experience this.
ko: 우리 둘 다 이걸 겪을 운명이었나 봐.

en: I don't know what to do.
I wish I could help you.
Something will finish the job.
You can survive this, I think.
ko: 넌 이겨 낼 수 있을 거야, 아마도.

en: But there's nothing I can do. I'm sorry.
ko: 그래도 내가 할 수 있는 건 없어. 미안해.

en: I've sped up the food chain, I suppose. It was bound to happen.
ko: 먹이 사슬을 좀 앞당긴 거겠지. 언젠간 일어날 일이었어.

en: If you're meant to pull through, you will.
ko: 이겨 낼 운명이라면, 그렇게 될 거야.

en: I was hoping I wouldn't see you again.
Out of sight, out of mind, right?
But here we are...
I don't regret it.
This is just what happens.
I'm sorry it ended up like this.
You're on your own. We all have to find our way no matter what happens to us.
ko: 이제 너 혼자야. 무슨 일이 일어나든 우린 모두 각자의 길을 찾아야 해.

en: We all end up where we're meant to be.
ko: 우린 모두 있어야 할 곳에 결국 닿게 돼.

en: This is just a part of nature, even if it is a little influenced.
ko: 약간 영향을 받긴 했어도, 이것도 자연의 일부야.

en: Good luck out there. We all need it sometimes, though wouldn't mind it at all times.
ko: 행운을 빌어. 누구나 가끔은 행운이 필요하지. 늘 있으면 더 좋겠지만.

en: Hey, a bunny!
Come on, Chomper. You don't need to go after more prey.
ko: 가자, 촘퍼. 사냥감을 더 쫓을 필요 없어.

en: Uh, hello...
It wasn't personal. I had to kill it. I'm not just going to let us all starve.
ko: 악감정이 있었던 건 아니야. 죽여야만 했어. 우리 모두를 굶게 둘 순 없잖아.

en: Have you seen how much food Bodega needs?
So, like, you all family?
Right. You have no idea what I'm saying.
ko: 그래. 내가 무슨 말 하는지 전혀 모르겠지.

en: It kind of feels like you're judging me.
ko: 왠지 날 평가하는 것 같은 기분인데.

en: Shoot at them.
One day one of you will understand me.
ko: 언젠가는 너희 중 하나가 날 이해해 줄 거야.

en: Or I'll pretend you do.
We all gotta eat.
This was not my best plan.
Is that an answer to my question or some kind of cuteness defense mechanism?
ko: 그게 내 질문에 대한 대답이야, 아니면 귀여움으로 하는 방어 수단이야?

en: I'm still going to shoot you.
Fine. We'll leave.
I really need to develop more of a killer instinct.
ko: 냉혹한 본능을 좀 더 길러야 해.

en: If I die out here cause I couldn't manage to eat some cute bunnies, well... That'll just be who I am... was.
ko: 귀여운 토끼를 못 잡아먹어서 여기서 죽는다면, 뭐... 그게 나인 거지... 나였던 거고.

en: I've wasted enough time here.
It's food. Cute food, but still just food.
ko: 이건 식량이야. 귀여운 식량이지만, 그래도 식량일 뿐이야.

en: It's not like you named them or anything.
Well, that one's Fluffington. Wait. Stop it. Also, that's a terrible name. That's a 5 year old's name.
ko: 음, 저 녀석은 복슬턴이야. 잠깐. 그만해. 게다가 끔찍한 이름이잖아. 다섯 살짜리가 지을 이름이야.

en: I can't kill Fluffington. Leave
Get it together. Hunt Fluffington.
Think about the lucky rabbit's foot you could have. We could use that.
ko: 행운의 토끼 발을 생각해 봐. 우리한테 필요할 수도 있잖아.

en: Think rabbit confit.
I'm too soft to be out here!
You have to harden. You have to conquer what's in your path.
ko: 강해져야 해. 앞길을 막는 건 정복해야 해.

en: No one survives out here without killing a few fluffingtons.
ko: 복슬턴 몇 마리쯤 안 죽이고 여기서 살아남는 사람은 없어.

en: Next time you have to be ready.
That's not even its real name.
It's furry food.
And fluffington will make a great meal. Thanks, buddy.
ko: 그리고 복슬턴은 훌륭한 끼니가 될 거야. 고마워, 친구.

en: Yeah, my heart wasn't in that shot.
ko: 그래, 그 한 발엔 마음이 담기지 않았어.

en: I have to build up a killer instinct out here if I want to make it.
ko: 여기서 살아남으려면 냉혹한 본능을 길러야 해.

en: No, I don't. i kill when I need to and I thank nature for what she gives me. I don't want to lose sight of how we're connected.
ko: 아니, 안 그래도 돼. 필요할 때 사냥하고 자연이 주는 것에 감사하면 돼. 우리가 서로 연결되어 있다는 걸 잊고 싶지 않아.

en: I'm sure my trap will catch one of his cousins later.
ko: 분명 내 덫이 나중에 저 녀석 사촌을 잡을 거야.

en: You can't see anything out there.
What do you pups see?
Is it over there?
Check out.
It's probably just the wind.
Woah.
You're not a ghost, right?
Am I dreaming?
I wonder how many of you there are?
ko: 너 같은 애가 몇 마리나 있을까?

en: I'm not here to kill the only albino moose.
ko: 하나뿐인 알비노 무스를 죽이러 온 건 아니야.

en: Squirrels, sure. Rare moose, no thanks.
Wait. No. No. Stop.
ko: 잠깐. 안 돼. 안 돼. 멈춰.

en: Yep, that didn't feel great.
But I'm going to have to use that last med pack.
Good thing we've got some med packs.
Thank god we found that med pack.
Ok, I'm coming pups... just a bit slowly.
I'm sorry, but we can't leave a meal right now, no matter how rare.
ko: 미안하지만, 아무리 희귀해도 지금은 끼니를 포기할 수 없어.

en: We have to keep ourselves removed. It's just meat. Same as the others.
ko: 감정을 섞으면 안 돼. 그냥 고기야. 다른 것들과 똑같아.

en: I mean, it was bound to happen whether by our hand or something else's teeth.
ko: 아니, 우리 손에 의해서든 다른 녀석의 이빨에 의해서든 언젠간 일어날 일이었어.

en: Well, at least we have a meal.
I probably deserved that.
Animals don't seem quite as majestic when they're getting their revenge.
ko: 동물들이 복수할 땐 별로 위풍당당해 보이지 않네.

en: Can't say I blame them for chasing me down.
ko: 날 쫓아오는 걸 탓할 수는 없지.

en: Can you be a snowy vegetarian? The deer seem to manage. Hmm.
ko: 눈 덮인 채식주의자가 될 수 있을까? 사슴들은 잘 지내는 것 같은데. 흠.

en: Hooo. Ok.
Just a dream.
Just another dream.
Yeah, that seems like it would hurt. Oh, thank goodness that wasn't real.
ko: 그래, 그거 엄청 아플 것 같았어. 오, 진짜가 아니어서 천만다행이야.

en: A whole pile of anxiety just lifted off my heart.
But, I mean, that could happen, couldn't it?
ko: 그래도, 그런 일이 일어날 수도 있잖아, 그렇지?

en: Yeah, of course it could. But we're prepared if that situation presents itself, right, pups?
ko: 그래, 당연히 그럴 수 있지. 그래도 그런 상황이 오면 우린 대비가 돼 있어, 그렇지, 얘들아?

en: Sometimes you have to visualize both your successes and failures.
ko: 가끔은 성공과 실패를 둘 다 그려 봐야 해.

en: I'm sure you don't catch every squirrel you dream about, Chomper.
ko: 너도 꿈에서 본 다람쥐를 다 잡진 못하잖아, 촘퍼.

en: Ok, I'm sorry. I shouldn't have questioned your squirrel catching prowess, but to be fair, you never caught a city squirrel.
ko: 좋아, 미안해. 네 다람쥐 사냥 실력을 의심하면 안 됐는데, 공정하게 말하자면, 넌 도시 다람쥐를 한 마리도 못 잡았잖아.

en: Yeah, judging by this dream, you're very much ready for the wild.
ko: 그래, 이 꿈을 보니 넌 야생에 완전히 준비가 됐구나.

en: There's something out there...
Yep...
That sounds like it could be a big meal.
I'm going after it.
We've got better things to do.
So definitely still here...
Ok, potentially a very big meal.
ko: 좋아, 엄청 큰 끼니가 될지도 몰라.

en: I probably should have more than my bare hands to take on a moose.
ko: 무스를 상대하려면 맨손 이상의 무언가가 필요하겠지.

en: We need this.
You know you can do this.
ko: 넌 할 수 있다는 거 알잖아.

en: Now if only we could actually pack all this meat.
ko: 이 고기를 전부 실을 수만 있다면 좋을 텐데.

en: We'll take what we can. I'm sure someone else will get the rest.
ko: 가져갈 수 있는 만큼 가져가자. 나머지는 분명 누군가 챙기겠지.

en: Really, one isn't enough?
And, we're out of bullets.
Please distract some predators for us.
ko: 제발 포식자들 주의 좀 끌어 줘.

en: There we go.
Well that's not good.
Yeah, just stay like that...
This is more frustrating than fishing. At least that just takes patience.
ko: 낚시보다 더 답답하네. 낚시는 인내심만 있으면 되는데.

en: Good luck to you out there.
We're probably going to need it.
Oh, come on!
Fine. We'll leave too.
I really need to get better at this. Or at least luckier.
ko: 정말 실력을 키워야겠어. 아니면 적어도 운이라도 좋아지든가.

en: Looks like we've found a moose...
We could use a few good meals.
I'd prefer to stay away from moose.
Don't mind us.
Wait to see if it gets closer.
Owww. Ugh. Yeah, he, uh, he got me pretty good.
ko: 아야아. 으. 그래, 걔가, 어, 제대로 한 방 먹였어.

en: I hate moose.
We should be more careful.
Another nightmare.
A nightmare. Ok, well, at lest I have an idea what could happen to me out there.
ko: 악몽이네. 좋아, 음, 적어도 여기서 나한테 무슨 일이 일어날 수 있는지 감은 잡았어.

en: I wish I was better at imagining all the good things that could happen instead of, you know, being smacked by a moose.
ko: 무스한테 얻어맞는 거 말고, 일어날 수 있는 좋은 일들을 상상하는 데 더 능숙하면 좋겠다.

en: You did warn me about the moose, Stilton.
It's not exactly the showing up for a meeting naked nightmare, but, seeing as I don't have meetings, or classes, this is basically the same.
ko: 회의에 알몸으로 나타나는 악몽은 아니지만, 난 회의도 수업도 없으니까, 이게 사실상 같은 거지.

en: Just with a wilderness flair.
I would've preferred the naked nightmare.
That was our last bullet.
Looks like we've found someone's dinner.
ko: 누군가의 저녁 식사를 찾은 것 같아.

en: Nothing for you to chase this time, Chomper.
Bodega, might be time to grab a snack.
ko: 보데가, 간식 먹을 때가 된 것 같아.

en: I don't want to risk what might show up.
ko: 뭐가 나타날지 모르는 위험은 감수하고 싶지 않아.

en: This looks pretty fresh.
We should be quick if we're going to do anything...
Quickly take 1 meat
Salvage 2 meat with axe.
Let Bodega get a snack.
I know the rules of nature say we can scavenge, but I don't want to tempt the fates.
ko: 자연의 법칙상 남은 걸 주워 먹어도 된다는 건 알지만, 운명을 시험하고 싶진 않아.

en: I'll just quickly grab some meat and rush back to the sled.
It'll be fine.
All done.
We just have to be quick. We don't have to be precise.
ko: 빨리만 하면 돼. 꼼꼼할 필요는 없어.

en: Sometimes you gotta learn from the hunters and scavengers.
Go on. It's ok.
Ok, you good?
Oh hey there, wolverine. It's ok, we're done. The rest is all yours.
ko: 오 안녕, 울버린. 괜찮아, 우린 다 했어. 나머지는 다 네 거야.

en: A big meal just for you.
Please don't follow us.
That wolverine probably stayed behind, right?
ko: 그 울버린은 거기 남아 있겠지, 그렇지?

en: Bodega, if something wants to take the food, just leave it. I'm more worried about you than the meat.
ko: 보데가, 뭔가 식량을 가져가려 하면 그냥 둬. 고기보다 네가 더 걱정이야.

en: I don't want you to feel like you have to protect the team, Igloo.
ko: 팀을 지켜야 한다는 부담은 안 느꼈으면 좋겠어, 이글루.

en: It's my job to protect you.
We'll deal with whatever comes our way.
You pups see that?
I think it might be time to get us some food.
ko: 식량을 구할 때가 된 것 같아.

en: Follow it.
You're right. We have more important things to do.
ko: 네 말이 맞아. 우린 더 중요한 일이 있어.

en: Chomper come look at this.
We'll wait for a better shot.
Good boy.
Can you believe it? A herd of caribou.
A week ago we had to be impressed by a flock of pigeons, and now, look.
ko: 일주일 전만 해도 비둘기 떼에 감탄해야 했는데, 지금은 이것 좀 봐.

en: I know this has been hard on us. Hell, I'm not sure I can handle this mentally, let alone physically. We're both going to have some pretty cool new scars, but when we have moments like this you have to sit and watch. We're a part of this world. A very, very small part of it. And while the snow will erase our tracks soon enough, we were here. We are here. Giving what we can and taking only what we need.
ko: 이 여정이 우리한테 힘들었다는 거 알아. 솔직히 육체는 고사하고 정신적으로 버틸 수 있을지도 모르겠어. 우리 둘 다 꽤 멋진 흉터가 새로 생기겠지만, 이런 순간이 오면 앉아서 바라봐야 해. 우린 이 세상의 일부야. 아주, 아주 작은 일부. 눈이 곧 우리 발자국을 지우겠지만, 우린 여기 있었어. 지금 여기 있어. 줄 수 있는 걸 주고, 필요한 것만 취하면서.

en: What do you say, buddy, time to get back on the trail.
ko: 어때, 친구, 다시 트레일로 돌아갈 시간이야.

en: Hunt caribou
Yeah, let's go.
This is going to be a tough shot.
You know how to do this.
Every shot is a new chance.
Just breathe.
It's all just practice.
Sheesh, I've got a hike ahead of me...
They're too far for another shot.
ko: 너무 멀어서 한 발 더 쏠 수가 없어.

en: Something is watching us...
Ok...
You mind not staring at me like that?
Are you going to attack me?
I'm just going to leave you all to whatever this is.
ko: 너희가 뭘 하든 그냥 내버려 두고 갈게.

en: So not as sneaky as I thought.
Take aim.
Put down gun. Leave.
I'm just going to shoot at the closest one of you.
You're closest, so I'm going to go with you...
I really feel like I'm growing into this.
ko: 정말 이 삶에 익숙해져 가는 기분이야.

en: Thanks, deer, for helping us out.
We'll continue to prove this is where we belong.
ko: 여기가 우리가 있을 곳이라는 걸 계속 증명할 거야.

en: Sometimes it feels like the right life finds you.
ko: 가끔은 맞는 삶이 나를 찾아오는 것 같아.

en: Ok, that was not what I was going for.
ko: 좋아, 그건 내가 노린 게 아니었는데.

en: It was probably the wind.
But who am I to complain about some good luck.
ko: 그래도 행운을 두고 불평할 내가 아니지.

en: We'll accept this meal too. Thank you, deer. And lady luck.
ko: 이 끼니도 감사히 받을게. 고마워, 사슴아. 그리고 행운의 여신님.

en: They do say luck is just opportunity and timing. We knew this was a shot worth taking.
ko: 운이란 기회와 타이밍일 뿐이라고들 하잖아. 우린 이게 쏠 가치가 있는 한 발이라는 걸 알았어.

en: They all just left you.
I suppose it is every creature for itself.
I'm going to try again.
I'm out of bullets.
I need to do what's best for me and my team.
ko: 나와 우리 팀에 최선인 걸 해야 해.

en: I'm sorry but I have to leave you.
Maybe you'll find you way to survive this.
ko: 이걸 이겨 낼 방법을 찾을 수 있을지도 몰라.

en: This is how things go. It can't always be perfect. Sometimes, it just... hurts.
ko: 원래 이런 거야. 항상 완벽할 순 없어. 가끔은 그냥... 아파.

en: It's just us now.
I do not think this bodes well for me.
ko: 이거 나한테 좋은 징조는 아닌 것 같은데.

en: What's out there?
You see something, Stilton?
You think it's worth checking out.
ko: 가 볼 가치가 있을 것 같아?

en: Ignore it. Let's go.
Listen to Stilton.
Ok, Stilton, let's see what's out there.
ko: 좋아, 스틸턴, 저기 뭐가 있는지 보자.

en: Yeah, why not.
Come on, Stilton. Another time.
Lots more ground to cover, team.
Good looking out, buddy!
No Camoflage can trick you.
ko: 어떤 위장도 널 속일 순 없구나.

en: Ok, now what should we do.
Shoot the ptarmigan in the tree.
Let Stilton go for his.
Thanks for helping us find what is hopefully our dinner, Stilton.
ko: 저녁거리가 될 것 같은 걸 찾아 줘서 고마워, 스틸턴.

en: Good catch, Stilton!
Looks like we both might get to eat.
ko: 우리 둘 다 먹을 수 있겠다.

en: Thanks for looking out for us.
Let's go check on the others.
At least one of us won't go hungry.
ko: 적어도 우리 중 하나는 굶지 않겠네.

en: And wipe those feathers from your lips.
ko: 그리고 입가에 묻은 깃털 좀 닦아.

en: Chomper might get jealous.
Alright, Stilton, you saw it, you catch it.
ko: 좋아, 스틸턴, 네가 봤으니 네가 잡아.

en: On my call...
Ok!
Hello?!
Huh, I wonder what the pups thought was out here?
ko: 흠, 애들이 여기서 뭘 봤던 걸까?

en: Oh there you are.
Hmm...
You know, that was a pretty good hiding spot. I'll leave you to it.
ko: 있잖아, 꽤 좋은 은신처였어. 방해하지 않을게.

en: Ok, just stay right there...
Perfect. I'll never say no to a meal out here.
ko: 완벽해. 여기선 끼니를 절대 마다하지 않을 거야.

en: Thanks, little ptarmigan.
That's probably going to be a problem.
Not exactly how I wanted that to go.
There's always another day, I think.
ko: 내일은 또 내일의 태양이 뜨겠지, 아마도.

en: I guess it already left.
Another one?!
Don't worry about it, Chomper.
I'll make the decision. You just wait for what I decide...
ko: 결정은 내가 할 거야. 넌 내가 정할 때까지 기다려...

en: You're not going to wait, are you?
Come on, squirrel. You can't win this; just get out of here.
ko: 이봐, 다람쥐야. 넌 못 이겨. 그냥 도망가.

en: Hey. We don't mean you any harm. Just leave it alone, Chomper.
ko: 야. 우린 해칠 생각 없어. 그냥 내버려 둬, 촘퍼.

en: Wait? Ah!
Woah, Barkley!
You know, you don't have to protect me from everything. I could probably handle a squirrel bite.
ko: 있잖아, 모든 것에서 날 지켜 줄 필요는 없어. 다람쥐한테 물리는 정도는 감당할 수 있을 거야.

en: I can't have you endangering yourself to save me.
ko: 날 구하려고 네가 위험해지는 건 안 돼.

en: And yeah, I know that was just a squirrel, but they're not always going to be squirrels.
ko: 그래, 그냥 다람쥐였다는 거 알아. 그래도 늘 다람쥐만 있는 건 아니야.

en: Remember the wolf? He almost got you, buddy.
ko: 늑대 기억나? 하마터면 당할 뻔했잖아, 친구.

en: You're quick to jump into a fight no matter the odds.
ko: 넌 승산이 있든 없든 싸움에 바로 뛰어들어.

en: But you've got a bark that just might be meaner than your bite. You might try using that first someday.
ko: 그래도 네 짖는 소리가 무는 것보다 더 무서울지도 몰라. 언젠간 그걸 먼저 써 봐.

en: You wanna practice?
Ok, let's go.
Alright, you gotta stand up.
We gotta get this in from our gut.
ko: 배 속 깊은 데서부터 끌어올려야 해.

en: Up.
Good boy. Now...
Speak!
Ok, how bout...
(the musher barks)
Yes! See you've got it.
Let's try it again.
Bark!
Yes! Good boy, Barkley.
I think you've got this.
ko: 이제 할 수 있을 것 같아.

en: I know you don't like to use it.
ko: 별로 쓰고 싶지 않은 거 알아.

en: But trust me, it'll come in handy.
ko: 그래도 날 믿어, 쓸모가 있을 거야.

en: Hey, where'd that squirrel go?
You ate it, didn't you, Chomper?
Alright, you heathen. Let's get back to the trail, pups.
ko: 좋아, 이 야만인아. 트레일로 돌아가자, 얘들아.

en: Woahh!
Go after the beaver.
Looks like you've done all the hard work.
ko: 힘든 일은 네가 다 해 놨구나.

en: Take the birch bark.
Fish
Didn't even have to break a sweat for these.
ko: 땀 한 방울 안 흘리고 얻었네.

en: Dinner is coming right up.
I bet we can get a fish out of there.
ko: 저기서 물고기 한 마리는 잡을 수 있을 거야.

en: Now, let's fish.
Bob lure.
Come on, fish.
There's gotta be something in here.
Fishing is just about patience right?
There's plenty of fish in the sea. How bout this river?
ko: 바다엔 물고기가 넘쳐 난다던데. 이 강은 어때?

en: I know you're under there. You're always under there.
ko: 거기 있는 거 알아. 넌 늘 거기 있잖아.

en: I can do this forever.
I'm not getting cold at all.
I am made of patience.
I'm not tired of this at all.
I can keep going.
You know this looks natural. It's real food, fish!
ko: 이거 자연스러워 보이잖아. 진짜 먹이라고, 물고기야!

en: I believe.
Just keep bobbing.
Ok, maybe I should give up.
I will defeat you.
A salmon would be great.
Seriously, how do people do this?
ko: 진짜, 사람들은 이걸 어떻게 하는 거야?

en: Is this supposed to be relaxing?
Keep it together.
Finally!
Fish meat, regular meat, it's all protein to us.
ko: 물고기 고기든 보통 고기든, 우리한텐 다 단백질이야.

en: Bob lure
I'm not going to bother right now.
I give up.
Just keep chewing over there. Take your time!
No need to rush chewing down that tree.
ko: 그 나무 서둘러 갉아 쓰러뜨릴 필요 없어.

en: Was that?
These are the strangest nightmares.
That couldn't actually happen, right?
ko: 실제로 그런 일이 일어날 리는 없지, 그렇지?

en: Thanks for your vote of confidence, Fin.
Ok, well that hurt.
Didn't even catch anything.
You know what, I'll take it.
It looks like there's something out there.
On by.
Are you ok?
You don't look ok.
Approach it
Run away
We'll just be on our way.
This isn't a zombie thing, right?
I don't want to be undead.
Well, good luck to you out there.
Noodle, is that?
Should we go over there?
Ok, come with me.
We don't have time, Noodle.
Did you kill this for us?
I think you made a friend, Noodle.
I'm going to collect some of this caribou. I'll see you at the sled.
ko: 이 순록 고기를 좀 챙길게. 썰매에서 보자.

en: You were right, Noodle. We should still try to help the animals we can.
ko: 네 말이 맞았어, 누들. 그래도 도울 수 있는 동물은 도와야 해.

en: It's hard enough out here. Nothing needs to suffer more.
ko: 여긴 그렇지 않아도 힘든 곳이야. 더 고통받을 필요는 없어.

en: Thanks for making sure I remember that
ko: 그걸 잊지 않게 해 줘서 고마워

en: Please be full.
1 bullet.
You know what, better than nothing.
2 bullets.
We're good, team. On by.
I don't want to find out who this belonged to.
ko: 이게 누구 거였는지 알고 싶지 않아.

en: But we'll take what we can find.
ko: 그래도 찾을 수 있는 건 가져갈 거야.

en: A bullet will do just fine.
Ok, what do we have here?
We definitely needed some more bandages.
Something is over there.
What do we have here?
Oh...
Bullets?!
That's just what we needed.
I actually feel like we might survive out here.
ko: 이제 진짜 여기서 살아남을 수 있을 것 같아.

en: Well I guess there's nothing to do but leave.
Fine. Let's leave.
Is that a pile of birch shavings?
I wonder how long they've been here?
We'll take a couple. We don't need all of it.
ko: 몇 개만 가져가자. 다 필요하진 않아.

en: What do you smell?
Continue on, pups!
Ok, so we've got someone's meal.
Go get it.
Wait and see.
Yeah...
It's mine now!
We shouldn't let it go to waste.
Sometimes you need luck.
Let's just wait...
We can kill whatever shows up.
We shouldn't take another's meal.
And see what happens.
I can't take another's kill.
ko: 남이 잡은 걸 가져갈 순 없어.

en: You killed it, you eat it.
I don't trust we're alone.
It seems pretty quiet.
I shouldn't press my luck anymore than I already have. Let's collect the meat and get back to the sled.
ko: 이미 운을 충분히 시험했으니 더는 무리하지 말자. 고기를 챙겨서 썰매로 돌아가자.

en: Looks pretty safe.
AAH!
This is probably a good lesson in patience, huh.
Something I've never had much of.
