Well, no time like the infinite isolation of the wilderness to work on that, right?
ko: 뭐, 야생의 끝없는 고립 속만큼 그걸 연습하기 좋은 때도 없겠지?

en: Ok, ok. It's all yours, just take it.
ko: 좋아, 좋아. 다 네 거야, 그냥 가져가.

en: I brought my rifle.
We've got one last med pack on the sled. I just have to make it there.
ko: 썰매에 마지막 구급상자가 하나 있어. 거기까지만 가면 돼.

en: We'll be ok. We can patch this up.
That was almost the end for us. If we didn't have that med pack, I don't know what I'd do.
ko: 하마터면 끝장날 뻔했어. 그 구급상자가 없었으면 어떻게 했을지 모르겠어.

en: I had a feeling some of med school would pay off.
ko: 의대에서 배운 게 쓸모 있을 줄 알았어.

en: We're ok. We've got one last med pack on the sled and now, plenty of meat for all of us.
ko: 우린 괜찮아. 썰매에 마지막 구급상자가 있고, 이제 다 같이 먹을 고기도 넉넉해.

en: Hnnnnngh. Ok, at least we can patch ourselves up and we've got plenty of food for all of us.
ko: 흐으으읍. 좋아, 적어도 치료할 수 있고 다 같이 먹을 식량도 넉넉해.

en: It just cost me a chunk of my arm.
ko: 내 팔 한 덩어리를 대가로 치렀지만.

en: But you have to make sacrifices sometimes.
Sometimes things are just really hard and you have to fight through the pain to know it was worth it.
ko: 정말 힘든 일도 있고, 그만한 가치가 있었다는 걸 알려면 고통을 이겨 내야 할 때도 있어.

en: I know I'm stronger now than I've ever been. I've survived a wolf attack. That's more than most can say.
ko: 지금의 내가 그 어느 때보다 강하다는 걸 알아. 늑대의 공격에서도 살아남았어. 그런 말 할 수 있는 사람이 몇이나 되겠어.

en: I don't need to be afraid anymore.
I'm finding my way to the top of the food chain.
ko: 먹이 사슬의 꼭대기로 가는 길을 찾고 있어.

en: It's nice to feel good at something. To feel like it's a natural fit.
ko: 뭔가를 잘한다고 느끼는 건 좋아. 천생연분처럼 잘 맞는다고 느끼는 것도.

en: Though I suppose I've really had to work to make this fit.
ko: 뭐, 잘 맞게 만들려고 정말 고생하긴 했지만.

en: We might get our two kills, one bullet.
ko: 총알 한 발로 두 마리를 잡을 수도 있겠어.

en: We'll just give the other animal a chance to collect its meal.
ko: 다른 동물에게 자기 끼니를 챙길 기회를 주자.

en: It's worth the risk. We might get a free meal.
ko: 위험을 감수할 가치가 있어. 공짜 끼니를 얻을 수도 있잖아.

en: When you can't hunt, gather. Hopefully we're all alone.
ko: 사냥할 수 없을 땐, 줍는 거야. 우리만 있길 바라.

en: We sit and wait. I knew I'd develop patience one day.
ko: 앉아서 기다리자. 언젠가 인내심이 생길 줄 알았어.

en: I guess it's just me out here.
Collect meat.
And tonight's meal.
Take as much as you can.
Leave some for the predator.
Pretty sure finders keepers applies out here.
ko: 여기선 먼저 찾은 사람이 임자라는 법칙이 통할 거야.

en: You have to take whatever meals you can find.
ko: 찾을 수 있는 끼니는 다 챙겨야 해.

en: I know the pups desperately need meal.
I'm starving. We need all we can carry.
ko: 배고파 죽겠어. 들 수 있는 만큼 다 필요해.

en: Thank you, caribou, and whatever took you down. We'll leave some to share.
ko: 고마워, 순록아. 그리고 널 쓰러뜨린 누군가도. 나눠 먹을 몫은 남겨 둘게.

en: It's not like I can carry all of it.
ko: 어차피 다 들고 갈 수도 없어.

en: Hopefully this will keep some predator occupied.
ko: 이걸로 포식자 하나쯤은 바쁘게 만들 수 있으면 좋겠다.

en: Keep waiting.
I think it's time to go.
ko: 이제 갈 때가 된 것 같아.

en: We couldn't let you take that.
ko: 네가 그걸 가져가게 둘 순 없었어.

en: This is just how it is.
I'm sorry.
It's all yours, buddy. (Leave)
Go scavenge the caribou.
Um, why would someone just put a door out here?
ko: 음, 누가 왜 여기에 문을 덩그러니 세워 놨지?

en: Can I open it?
Snow. Yep.
Ok, bear, just move along. We'd like to come through here...
ko: 좋아, 곰아, 그냥 지나가. 우리 여기 좀 지나가고 싶은데...

en: Woah, pups! Just stay right there.
I'll shoot him.
Let me distract him.
Run?
Let's give him some space.
We just need to be sure you'll leave us alone.
ko: 우릴 내버려 둘 거라는 확신만 있으면 돼.

en: I never thought I would actually find a bear out here and now...
ko: 여기서 진짜로 곰을 만날 줄은 몰랐는데, 이제는...

en: I can't seem to get away from them.
I had to kill one.
But I don't think we had a choice.
ko: 그래도 선택의 여지가 없었던 것 같아.

en: Run, pups!
Pups, just leave it alone. I'll be right there!
ko: 얘들아, 그냥 내버려 둬. 금방 갈게!

en: Don't make it angry!
Well at least it didn't eat us.
Though we're now the ones about to starve.
Let's get out of here before it realizes we're also made of meat.
ko: 우리도 고기로 만들어졌다는 걸 눈치채기 전에 여기서 나가자.

en: No. Leave it! Not for chomping!
ko: 안 돼. 내버려 둬! 깨물면 안 돼!

en: Chomper!
Stay there, play dead.... Please don't be dead.
ko: 거기 있어, 죽은 척해.... 제발 진짜 죽진 마.

en: Hey bear! I'm made of food.
ko: 야, 곰! 난 먹을 걸로 만들어졌다고.

en: You shouldn't have done that, bear!
I'm pretty sure I can take you!
ko: 내가 너쯤은 이길 수 있을 것 같은데!

en: And my axe.
Yeah! I don't even have as much fur!
I'm a delicacy!
Wait, no, no, no, no!
ko: 잠깐, 안 돼, 안 돼, 안 돼, 안 돼!

en: Yeah! Chase that thing!
Chomp... oh chomp, what'd you do?
ko: 촘프... 아 촘프, 무슨 짓을 한 거야?

en: You're ok, right? Please be ok.
I can't do this without you.
I don't WANT to do this without you.
Come on, buddy. I can patch you up.
ko: 힘내, 친구. 내가 치료해 줄 수 있어.

en: We just have to find another med pack.
ko: 구급상자를 하나 더 찾기만 하면 돼.

en: I'm trained for this.
Chomper! Oh, chomps, I was so scared.
No more protecting. Only squirrel chasing... ok?
ko: 이제 지키는 건 그만. 다람쥐 쫓기만 하는 거야... 알았지?

en: Ok.
I'm going to put you on the sled until we can get you patched up.
ko: 치료할 수 있을 때까지 썰매에 태워 둘게.

en: I don't have any more room on the sled...
I can't just leave one of you...
ko: 너희 중 누구도 그냥 두고 갈 순 없어...

en: Hey... bear.
You hungry?
Oh, you are hungry. Ok... um, this is all yours.
ko: 아, 배고프구나. 좋아... 음, 이거 다 네 거야.

en: I'm just going to place it over here...
(throwing exertion)
Go go go! That's only going to last one bite pups.
ko: 가 가 가! 한 입이면 끝날 거야, 얘들아.

en: Go, Chomper, go! Get them out of here!
ko: 가, 촘퍼, 가! 애들을 여기서 데리고 나가!

en: Keep going, Chomper!
Ohhhh. Ok. Just a nightmare.
Everything is fine.
Chomper, you ok over there?
You're asleep.
Well, yeah, you should get your rest. Our journey starts bright and early.
ko: 그래, 푹 쉬어야지. 내일 아침 일찍 여정이 시작되니까.

en: Hopefully dream bears are the only ones I encounter.
Is that?
No. Claws. Chomper!
Iggy, you did it. You fought off a bear and you're all ok.
ko: 이기, 해냈어. 곰을 물리쳤고 다들 무사해.

en: Chomper! You did it. Oh god. Are you ok?
I'm not great, but everyone is ok enough.
We should probably get out of here, pups.
ko: 여기서 빨리 나가는 게 좋겠어, 얘들아.

en: One bear attack is plenty.
I was hoping this sled would work like a bear bell, that does not seem to be the case.
ko: 이 썰매가 곰 쫓는 방울 역할을 해 주길 바랐는데, 그렇진 않은가 봐.

en: Didn't need to check bear attack off my bucket list, but here we are.
ko: 버킷 리스트에서 곰 습격을 지울 필요는 없었는데, 이렇게 됐네.

en: BARKLEY!!!!
You did it!
Yeah, you get belly rubs.
You found your voice, buddy! He didn't even want to mess with you.
ko: 목소리를 찾았구나, 친구! 걔가 너랑은 엮이고 싶지도 않아 했어.

en: Thanks. That was almost the end for us. It would've been without you.
ko: 고마워. 하마터면 끝장날 뻔했어. 네가 없었으면 그랬을 거야.

en: You think we can find home now?
ko: 이제 집을 찾을 수 있을 것 같아?

en: Ok, buddy, inside voice for a bit. But yeah, let's get home.
ko: 좋아, 친구, 잠깐만 목소리 좀 낮추자. 그래도 그래, 집에 가자.

en: We'll have all the time we need for belly rubs back at the camp.
ko: 야영지로 돌아가면 배 쓰다듬을 시간은 얼마든지 있어.

en: Barkley, no! Just get out of there.
ko: 바클리, 안 돼! 그냥 거기서 빠져나와.

en: Try to hit the moose.
Jump in front of Barkley.
Come on, please.
Get off him!
Get off!
STOP!
I'M RIGHT HERE!
Grab the rifle.
Grab the axe.
That's enough. You've done ENOUGH!
Fire.
Try to hit it with your rifle.
Barkley!
Come on, boy. I've got lots of belly scratches for you.
ko: 힘내, 녀석아. 배 긁어 줄 게 잔뜩 남았어.

en: Come on, Barkley.
Barkley...
It's ok.
You did good. You did really good, buddy. You protected us all.
ko: 잘했어. 정말 잘했어, 친구. 넌 우리 모두를 지켜 줬어.

en: You did more than you ever needed to.
ko: 넌 해야 할 것 이상을 해냈어.

en: More than I could.
ko: 내가 할 수 있었던 것보다 더.

en: I'm sorry I couldn't get you to your new home.
We'll return you to the land.
We got our vengeance.
Oh god.
Barkley! Come on, buddy! He's gone. I got em. I got you.
ko: 바클리! 힘내, 친구! 그 녀석은 사라졌어. 내가 해치웠어. 내가 있잖아.

en: I'm here. Come on, Barkley.
It's not too late, right.
It can't be too late...
It can't be.
I should've been there faster. I shouldn't have let you try to protect us.
ko: 더 빨리 갔어야 했어. 네가 우릴 지키려고 나서게 두지 말았어야 했어.

en: You did good. You did really good. You protected us all.
ko: 잘했어. 정말 잘했어. 넌 우리 모두를 지켜 줬어.

en: Without you, we wouldn't be all standing here.
ko: 네가 없었으면 우리 모두 여기 서 있지 못했을 거야.

en: You didn't fear what might happen.
ko: 넌 무슨 일이 일어날지 두려워하지 않았어.

en: You did what you had to do for us.
ko: 우리를 위해 해야 할 일을 했어.

en: I wish I could've done more for you.
ko: 널 위해 더 많은 걸 해 줄 수 있었다면 좋았을 텐데.

en: But, you can rest now, Barkley.
I love you, buddy.
We'll miss you.
We got him for you, Barkley.
ko: 널 위해 그 녀석을 해치웠어, 바클리.

en: You saved all of us.
I'm sorry I couldn't stop him first.
I'm sorry I couldn't protect you.
But we won't stop now. We'll get home.
ko: 그래도 이제 멈추지 않을 거야. 집에 갈 거야.

en: Love you, buddy. You were the bravest pup I've ever met.
ko: 사랑해, 친구. 넌 내가 만난 강아지 중 가장 용감했어.

en: You gave us everything so we could have the life we needed.
ko: 우리가 필요한 삶을 살 수 있도록 넌 모든 걸 내줬어.

en: I wish I could've given you more.
ko: 더 많은 걸 줄 수 있었다면 좋았을 텐데.

en: You deserved more.
ko: 넌 더 많은 걸 누릴 자격이 있었어.

en: You were a good dog, Barkley. You were a great friend and our hero.
ko: 넌 좋은 개였어, 바클리. 훌륭한 친구였고 우리의 영웅이었어.

en: Love you, buddy.
We didn't do anything to you!
ko: 우린 너한테 아무 짓도 안 했잖아!

en: Run, pups! Run!!!
Mush! Get out of here!
Barkley. You ok. You good, buddy?
Everyone else accounted for?
Yeah, looks like it, huh, Chomper?
ko: 그래, 그런 것 같네, 그렇지, 촘퍼?

en: I'd do anything for you guys, you know that, right?
ko: 너희를 위해서라면 뭐든 할 거야, 알지?

en: It's not worth getting to this new home without all of you.
ko: 너희 모두가 없으면 새 보금자리에 가도 아무 의미 없어.

en: We're a family. A pack. We look out for one another.
ko: 우린 가족이야. 무리야. 서로를 지켜 주는.

en: I know we'll get there ok. We have to.
ko: 우린 무사히 도착할 거야. 그래야만 해.

en: And if we can steer clear of moose, let's do that.
ko: 그리고 무스는 피할 수 있으면 피하자.

en: Barkley, you ready to get out there and show them what you've got?
ko: 바클리, 나가서 네 실력을 보여 줄 준비 됐어?

en: Ooh another owl!
I just want to talk about what happened with the other owl.
ko: 그냥 다른 부엉이랑 있었던 일에 대해 얘기하고 싶어.

en: Is this like a blood moon thing?
Curses are imaginary.
And so, apparently, were you.
Our fate is in our own hands.
Ok, curses might be real.
That makes us even, right?
Oh come on.
That owl cursed me for real?!
ko: 그 부엉이가 진짜로 날 저주한 거야?!

en: Yeah, you're right it's just a coincidence.
ko: 그래, 네 말이 맞아. 그냥 우연이야.

en: A really unfortunate coincidence.
I don't know why my brain is dreaming up all these scenarios.
ko: 왜 내 머리가 이런 상황들을 꿈꾸는지 모르겠어.

en: This couldn't actually happen to us out there, could it?
ko: 실제로 우리한테 이런 일이 일어날 리는 없지, 그렇지?

en: Yeah, expect the unexpected and what not.
ko: 그래, 예상치 못한 걸 예상하라는 둥 그런 거지.

en: But you have to admit, a moose and owl team up would be pretty amazing to see.
ko: 그래도 인정해야 해. 무스랑 부엉이가 한 팀이 되는 건 꽤 볼 만할 거야.

en: I really do think this might be the place for us.
ko: 정말로 여기가 우리가 있을 곳일지도 몰라.

en: Margot was never the best racer, but she did it because it's what she loved... and it was who she was. She never came in first, more often than not, she came in last.
ko: 마고는 최고의 레이서는 아니었어. 그래도 그게 그녀가 사랑하는 일이었고... 그게 그녀 자체였기에 계속했어. 1등을 한 적은 없었고, 꼴찌로 들어온 적이 더 많았지.

en: And she knew she was never going to win, nor was she going to keep her pinky finger.
ko: 이길 수 없다는 것도, 새끼손가락을 지키지 못할 거라는 것도 알고 있었어.

en: But she kept going, and her dogs kept going, because they wanted to.
ko: 그래도 그녀는 계속 달렸고, 그녀의 개들도 계속 달렸어. 그러고 싶었으니까.

en: They could conquer whatever was in front of them. Nothing could stop them from finishing.
ko: 그들은 앞에 놓인 무엇이든 이겨 낼 수 있었어. 그 무엇도 결승선을 막을 수 없었지.

en: It didn't matter what they came across.
They were going to look it in the face and defeat it.
As will we. We've handled everything this mad world has thrown at us and we're too close to stop.
ko: 우리도 그럴 거야. 이 미친 세상이 던진 모든 걸 견뎌 냈고, 이제 멈추기엔 너무 가까이 왔어.

en: Whatever dares to come next better be ready, cause we're going home.
ko: 다음에 감히 덤빌 녀석은 각오하는 게 좋을 거야. 우린 집에 갈 거니까.

en: They had become one with each other and with nature.
ko: 그들은 서로와, 그리고 자연과 하나가 되었어.

en: Taking things as they came and not sacrificing what they wanted to accomplish and who they wanted to be.
ko: 닥치는 일을 받아들이며, 이루고 싶은 것과 되고 싶은 모습을 희생하지 않았지.

en: They took some knocks, we all do, but they persevered.
ko: 몇 번 넘어지기도 했어. 누구나 그렇듯. 하지만 그들은 견뎌 냈어.

en: And we will too.
We'll find our way, as a team.
And she didn't know what was going to come next.
ko: 그리고 그녀는 다음에 무슨 일이 일어날지 몰랐어.

en: But she knew if she was supposed to make it, she would.
ko: 하지만 해낼 운명이라면 해낼 거라는 걸 알았지.

en: So she had to just let the pups put one paw in front of the other and trust them to get her to the end.
ko: 그래서 개들이 한 발 한 발 나아가게 두고, 끝까지 데려다줄 거라고 믿어야 했어.

en: And Barkley made it so we could keep going too.
ko: 그리고 바클리 덕분에 우리도 계속 나아갈 수 있게 됐어.

en: I'm not going to let his sacrifice be in vain.
ko: 그의 희생을 헛되게 하지 않을 거야.

en: He's the reason we'll have a new life to start and if he thought we were worth protecting...
ko: 그 덕분에 우리가 새 삶을 시작할 수 있는 거야. 그가 우리를 지킬 가치가 있다고 생각했다면...

en: We better make sure that's true.
We'll find home, buddy, and we'll turn the lantern on for you.
ko: 집을 찾을게, 친구. 그리고 널 위해 랜턴을 켜 둘게.

en: So you can find it too.
You pick up the scent of something?
It's not a skunk, is it?
Ok, Fin. Let's check it out.
What'd you find, girl?
A med pack?!
Ok, I don't know how you knew what we needed, but I am thankful for that treasure-hunting nose of yours.
ko: 좋아, 우리한테 뭐가 필요한지 어떻게 알았는지 모르겠지만, 네 보물찾기 코에 감사할게.

en: Even if you sometimes find a skunk.
Oh, nevermind.
This is so much better than a skunk, girl. You did real good.
ko: 스컹크보다 훨씬 낫네, 아가씨. 정말 잘했어.

en: This might be the thing that gets us home.
You know what, you head back to the sled. We'll get what we need from this.
ko: 있잖아, 넌 썰매로 돌아가 있어. 필요한 건 우리가 챙길게.

en: Good girl, Fin.
See, I trust you.
It's a bit damp, but we'll get it to burn.
ko: 좀 축축하지만, 불은 붙일 수 있을 거야.

en: Pet Fin
You're warming up to me, huh?
I like you too, buddy.
Thanks for dragging us out here.
With you, nothing can defeat us.
ko: 너만 있으면 아무것도 우릴 꺾을 수 없어.

en: You're one with this world out here.
See, I trust you, Fin.
You can trust me too.
I'm looking out for you. All of you.
ko: 난 너를 지켜보고 있어. 너희 모두를.

en: I knew you were right for this team, girl.
ko: 네가 이 팀에 딱 맞는다는 걸 알았어, 아가씨.

en: I can't believe you've let me pet you again!
ko: 또 쓰다듬게 해 주다니 믿기지 않아!

en: We're definitely becoming friends, aren't we?
ko: 우리 확실히 친구가 되어 가고 있지, 그렇지?

en: Looks like we've got another elk watching us.
ko: 또 다른 엘크가 우릴 지켜보고 있는 것 같아.

en: It's ok, Slayer, you know how to handle them now.
ko: 괜찮아, 슬레이어. 이제 어떻게 대처하는지 알잖아.

en: Yeah, that's right.
Wait, slayer!
Ok, yeah, you did good.
I'm glad you're ready to face your fears, Slayer, but just because you're not afraid, doesn't mean you have to take risks.
ko: 두려움과 마주할 준비가 돼서 기뻐, 슬레이어. 그래도 두렵지 않다고 해서 위험을 무릅써야 하는 건 아니야.

en: It's so you can take risks when you need to, but you don't need to seek them out.
ko: 필요할 때 위험을 감수할 수 있도록 하는 거지, 일부러 찾아다닐 필요는 없어.

en: I should've probably given myself that advice before we came out here, but if I had, I wouldn't have met you.
ko: 여기 오기 전에 나 자신한테 그 조언을 해 줬어야 했는데, 그랬다면 널 만나지 못했겠지.

en: I wouldn't have known that I might actually be able to do this.
ko: 내가 정말 이걸 해낼 수 있을지도 모른다는 걸 몰랐을 거야.

en: And if I can do this, what can't I do?
ko: 그리고 이걸 해낼 수 있다면, 내가 못 할 게 뭐가 있겠어?

en: I can conquer anything.
ko: 난 뭐든 이겨 낼 수 있어.

en: Sometimes you have to trust you're capable of more than you think you are.
ko: 가끔은 생각보다 더 많은 걸 해낼 수 있다고 믿어야 해.

en: Sometimes you have to know the right path will find you.
ko: 가끔은 올바른 길이 나를 찾아올 거라고 믿어야 해.

en: Yeah, you get it, Slayer.
Slayer will enjoy her next meal.
Feel free to stay over there. We don't mind.
No need to come any closer.
Try to scare it off.
Come on, pups, let's go!
No need to tempt fate or wolverines today.
ko: 오늘은 운명도 울버린도 시험할 필요 없어.

en: Hey! Stay back!
Get out of here! Don't you see how many of us there are!
We're scary! You should be scared!
Why did I try to negotiate with a predator?
ko: 내가 왜 포식자랑 협상을 하려 했을까?

en: Squirrels only. Maybe a bunny. Only things with less teeth.
ko: 다람쥐만. 토끼 정도. 이빨이 적은 녀석들만.

en: Ok, ok.
Fine...
It's ok, Bodega, we can find more food!
ko: 괜찮아, 보데가, 식량은 더 찾을 수 있어!

en: You really don't like people messing with your food, do ya, boy?
ko: 누가 네 먹이 건드리는 거 진짜 싫어하는구나, 그렇지, 녀석아?

en: I don't want you risking your life for our food, Bodega. Food doesn't matter if you're not around to eat it...
ko: 우리 식량 때문에 목숨 걸지 마, 보데가. 네가 없으면 식량이 무슨 소용이야...

en: But this will make it much easier to get home.
ko: 그래도 이걸로 집에 가는 게 훨씬 수월해질 거야.

en: I even have a treat to spare.
You'll have plenty of treats at home.
ko: 집에 가면 간식 실컷 먹을 거야.

en: Here ya go, buddy.
If there's a meal to be had, you can conquer everything.
ko: 먹을 게 걸려 있으면, 넌 뭐든 이겨 낼 수 있구나.

en: Your destiny is driven by your stomach.
I'd give you something now, but we can't spare it just yet.
ko: 지금 뭐라도 주고 싶지만, 아직은 여유가 없어.

en: I promise you'll get a treat when we get home.
ko: 집에 가면 간식 꼭 줄게. 약속해.

en: I'm coming, Iggy. Try to keep him back from the team.
ko: 간다, 이기. 그 녀석이 팀에 못 오게 막아 줘.

en: Woah, Iggy!
Make sure she knows we love her, Chomper.
ko: 우리가 얘를 사랑한다는 걸 꼭 알려 줘, 촘퍼.

en: Iggy, you really know how to take care of your team.
ko: 이기, 넌 정말 팀을 잘 돌보는구나.

en: We're a pack, we all watch out for each other.
Let's get home, huh, girl? You can curl up and get comfortable soon.
ko: 집에 가자, 아가씨? 곧 몸 웅크리고 편히 쉴 수 있을 거야.

en: I hope.
Wait a minute, you're not supposed to be out here.
ko: 잠깐만, 넌 여기 있으면 안 되잖아.

en: Holes in the ice, sure, but you?
Ok, cool. I'm just seeing things now. That's great.
ko: 좋아, 멋지네. 이제 헛것이 보이는구나. 잘됐다.

en: Gale, just leave it. You know what happens.
ko: 게일, 그냥 내버려 둬. 어떻게 되는지 알잖아.

en: They take so much work to clean.
We're almost home, team.
I don't know why I'm pressing my luck with another porcupine.
ko: 내가 왜 또 호저한테 운을 시험하고 있는지 모르겠어.

en: I guess I should just hunt you?
Good luck to you, porcupine. Thanks for leaving the trail.
ko: 잘 지내, 호저야. 길을 비켜 줘서 고마워.

en: Never look a gift porcupine in the quill.
ko: 선물로 받은 호저의 가시는 따지지 마라.

en: At least you're an easy shot. It almost makes up for how painful it is to prep you.
ko: 적어도 넌 쉬운 표적이야. 손질하는 고통이 조금은 상쇄되지.

en: At least I can't miss from here. It almost makes up for how painful it is to prep you.
ko: 적어도 여기선 빗나갈 수가 없어. 손질하는 고통이 조금은 상쇄되지.

en: I really appreciate when things are just easy. Sometimes you need that.
ko: 일이 그냥 쉽게 풀릴 때가 정말 고마워. 가끔은 그런 게 필요해.

en: Gale, come on. You can't get your nose poked again.
ko: 게일, 가자. 또 코를 찔리면 안 돼.

en: Gale, wait!
Oh. Good girl, Gale.
See you can't always rush into everything at full force.
ko: 봐, 항상 전력으로 돌진할 순 없어.

en: Sometimes you have to be patient.
But I get the feeling, you're never going to try to eat this porcupine are you?
ko: 근데 넌 이 호저를 먹으려고 할 생각은 절대 없는 것 같은 기분이 드는데?

en: You just want to hang out and stare...
ko: 그냥 같이 어울려서 쳐다보고 싶은 거지...

en: Forever...
Ok. Stare away.
Come on, Gale. Time to go.
I'm going to kill it now.
Ok, I thought I could stay here, but we have things to do.
ko: 좋아, 여기 있어도 될 줄 알았는데, 할 일이 있어.

en: My stomach is growling.
And I'm pretty certain we're really close to our new home.
ko: 그리고 새 보금자리에 정말 가까이 왔다고 확신해.

en: Can we go now?
I'm really proud of you.
Come on, pack it up.
We've got to go, girl.
But just so you know, I'm really proud of you.
Oh, come on, Gale. We have to eat...
ko: 아, 제발, 게일. 우리도 먹어야 해...

en: Fine. That works.
You know we're out of food.
And you barely have the energy to keep running.
ko: 그리고 넌 계속 달릴 기운도 거의 없어.

en: My stomach is basically eating itself right now.
ko: 지금 내 배는 거의 자기 자신을 소화하고 있어.

en: Ok, I'll meet you back at the sled.
Come on, Chomper, it's just another squirrel.
You've seen tons of them.
Even a few out here.
You don't have to follow it.
You choose, Chomper.
Wait, you want to keep running?
Awww, my boy is really growing up out here.
ko: 아이고, 우리 애가 여기서 정말 많이 컸구나.

en: You're becoming a real leader. Choosing others over yourself.
ko: 진짜 리더가 되어 가고 있어. 자기보다 남을 먼저 생각하고.

en: I'm proud of you, Chomper.
Wow, you didn't get very far.
Alright, Chomper, a promise is a promise.
Ok! Get em!
I'm going to have to take you on squirrel hunts, aren't I?
Alright, let's go you, squirrel snack fiend.
ko: 좋아, 가자, 이 다람쥐 간식 중독자야.

en: Look at you! Waiting for a command and everything.
Ok, boy, go get em!
Shhh. I've heard bad things about these guys.
ko: 쉿. 얘네 평판이 별로 안 좋다던데.

en: On by! Let's go!
Ohhh. Kay.
We'll stay over here.
Igloo...
Continue watching.
Barkley, speak.
Ok, ok...
We'll leave.
GAH!
And now a musk ox...
HOW MANY ANTLERED CREATURES ARE OUT HERE?!
ko: 여기 뿔 달린 동물이 대체 몇이나 있는 거야?!

en: I feel like i've imagined the pain of every conceivable type of antler smacking me.
ko: 상상할 수 있는 온갖 종류의 뿔에 얻어맞는 고통을 다 상상해 본 것 같아.

en: But, I guess we're prepared... though I'd be very happy to never actually experience antlers to the gut.
ko: 그래도 대비는 된 셈이겠지... 실제로 뿔에 배를 찔리는 일은 절대 겪고 싶지 않지만.

en: Yeah, you're right, no use dwelling on what bad could happen...
ko: 그래, 네 말이 맞아, 일어날 수 있는 나쁜 일에 연연해 봤자 소용없지...

en: We have to respect the creatures out there that are also trying to survive.
ko: 여기서 살아남으려 애쓰는 동물들도 존중해야 해.

en: Yep! That's it!
Belly rubs?
Let's go
Try again, Barkley.
I'm proud of you.
Ah, is that the spot?
Alright, Barkley, let's get back to it.
Oh thank god.
I'm not sure about this.
Looks like we've found a meal.
Noodle, your friend is back!
Ok, go play...
We don't have time.
I'm sorry, Noodle, we just can't right now.
I know, it's not what you want, but thank you for still listening to me.
ko: 네가 원하는 게 아니란 거 알아. 그래도 내 말 들어 줘서 고마워.

en: Maybe we'll find them again later?
ko: 나중에 다시 만날 수 있을지도 몰라.

en: Ok, Noodle time to go.
You can play a little more.
You all done now?
I hope you saved some energy for the trail.
ko: 트레일 달릴 힘은 남겨 뒀길 바라.

en: But seems like we're nearly there, huh.
ko: 그래도 거의 다 온 것 같아.

en: Say bye to your friend.
Come on, Noodle.
Alright, you can't be tiring yourself out.
Let's go, buddy.
You know, I think that wolf has been following us ever since we helped it out.
ko: 있잖아, 우리가 도와준 뒤로 그 늑대가 계속 우릴 따라오는 것 같아.

en: I'm sure we'll see it again someday.
Yawwnnnn.
Hello?
Stilton, are you seeing this?
Um, do you mind moving?
Uh, Stilton. Why did that caribou teleport?
ko: 어, 스틸턴. 저 순록 왜 순간 이동했어?

en: Ok, but is it actually on that rock?
ko: 좋아, 근데 진짜로 저 바위 위에 있는 거야?

en: Got it. Let's...
Ok, you're not that tired... you can make this shot.
ko: 좋아, 그렇게 피곤하지 않아... 이 한 발 맞힐 수 있어.

en: We need to eat.
Well, that's disappointing.
Thanks for making sure I knew if what I saw was real.
ko: 내가 본 게 진짜인지 확인해 줘서 고마워.

en: I like having you look out for us.
ko: 네가 우릴 지켜 주는 게 좋아.

en: Uh, please?
Walk toward it.
We should probably sleep sometime, huh?
Thanks for looking out for us, Stilton.
Cool, having caribou hallucinations now. I'm sure that won't cause us any problems.
ko: 멋지네, 이제 순록 환각까지 보여. 분명 아무 문제 없을 거야.

en: That was a bad idea.
Uh, how'd you get up there?
More like caribooooo, am I right? Stilton?
ko: 이게 바로 순록이 아니라 순~~록이지, 그렇지? 스틸턴?

en: Ok, then.
We should probably get some sleep, huh?
Good thing I've got you looking out for us.
I can't tell what's real anymore.
I think it's real, buddy.
But seriously, how did you get up there?
ko: 근데 진짜, 거기 어떻게 올라간 거야?

en: Oh, nevermind... it's not like you could tell me.
ko: 아, 됐어... 네가 말해 줄 수 있는 것도 아니고.

en: I'll keep my bullet.
I don't trust you.
Great. Having caribou hallucinations now...
I read the highest achievers basically don't sleep. Seems like we're doing it right.
ko: 가장 성공한 사람들은 거의 안 잔다고 읽었어. 우리가 잘하고 있나 봐.

en: I think it might be time to camp and have a snack.
ko: 야영하고 간식 먹을 때가 된 것 같아.

en: You know, walking up on wild creatures wasn't a good idea in a national park, why would I think it's ok here.
ko: 있잖아, 국립공원에서도 야생 동물한테 다가가는 건 좋은 생각이 아니었는데, 여기선 괜찮을 거라고 왜 생각했을까.

en: At least it's just a dream.
We can make friends later, but we have to make it home first.
ko: 친구는 나중에 사귀면 돼. 일단 집에 가야 해.

en: I knew it!
I knew we could make it.
They tried to stop us, but we wouldn't accept defeat.
ko: 다들 우릴 막으려 했지만, 우린 패배를 받아들이지 않았어.

en: Not this time.
We just had to keep pushing. Even when it didn't come easy.
ko: 계속 밀어붙이기만 하면 됐어. 쉽지 않을 때조차도.

en: Know that we could conquer anything that stood in front of us and we did.
ko: 앞을 가로막는 건 뭐든 이겨 낼 수 있다는 걸 알았고, 정말 그렇게 했어.

en: We did it.
I did it.
Did we actually make it?
I knew all we had to do was move our feet.
ko: 그냥 발만 움직이면 된다는 걸 알았어.

en: If we were meant to find this place we would.
ko: 이곳을 찾을 운명이라면 찾게 될 거라고.

en: We had to persevere. We'd find our way.
ko: 견뎌 내야 했어. 그러면 길을 찾을 수 있을 거라고.

en: And now, her red lantern hangs for us, calling us to our new home.
ko: 그리고 이제, 그녀의 빨간 랜턴이 우리를 위해 걸려 있어. 우리의 새 보금자리로 우리를 부르며.

en: Is that? Is that a cabin?
Nestled between the rocks?!
With a red lantern on the door?!
I can't believe it.
Margot said we had to persevere. And we did.
ko: 마고가 견뎌 내야 한다고 했어. 그리고 우린 견뎌 냈어.

en: We found our place in the world and we became one. A pack.
ko: 우린 세상 속 우리 자리를 찾았고 하나가 됐어. 하나의 무리가.

en: So you can find your way home too, Barkley.
ko: 그러니 너도 집으로 오는 길을 찾을 수 있을 거야, 바클리.

en: Welcome home.
Iggy loves Chomper.
Noodle Leaves.
I know the map isn't great, but we should be almost there...
ko: 지도가 좀 부실하다는 건 알지만, 거의 다 왔을 거야...

en: Just a little further, Chomper.
Wait, is that...
What do you see up there, Stilton?
You seem really excited.
Wait, no...
Should we camp?
Let's take a break.
Let's rest.
Yes
No
We'll make camp at the next safe spot.
Let's set up camp as soon as we can.
Let's look for a good spot to camp.
We set up a pretty good camp.
We've got our meat all strung up to be out of reach of bears.
ko: 고기는 곰이 닿지 않게 전부 매달아 뒀어.

en: And we can make a fire. It'll be nice to cook up some food or warm my bones.
ko: 그리고 불도 피울 수 있어. 음식을 요리하거나 몸을 녹이면 좋을 거야.

en: And, of course, I can check on all of you.
ko: 그리고 물론, 너희 모두 상태도 살펴볼 수 있고.

en: This will help us to catch some food while we sleep.
ko: 이게 있으면 자는 동안에도 먹을 걸 잡을 수 있을 거야.

en: And save some bullets.
This looks pretty good.
This is a good spot to rest.
We should be able to take care of ourselves here.
ko: 여기서라면 몸을 추스를 수 있을 거야.

en: Take a break, pups.
Where were we again? I should check my map.
Maybe I should check the map and get my bearings.
What's left to take care of.
Ok, so where were we.
I don't even remember setting up this camp. Guess we needed a break.
ko: 이 야영지를 차린 기억도 안 나. 휴식이 필요했나 봐.

en: I must've set this camp up with my eyes closed. Go me.
ko: 눈 감고 야영지를 차렸나 봐. 대단하다, 나.

en: Alright, what needs to be done.
How's everyone doing?
A fire would be nice.
We don't have anything to make a fire.
Start fire with birch.
Nah
Use flint to start fire.
Ok, just a little birch bark, a little spark, and... behold! Fire!
ko: 좋아, 자작나무 껍질 조금, 불꽃 조금, 그리고... 보아라! 불이다!

en: A least I'm well practiced in fire starting.
ko: 적어도 불 피우는 건 연습을 많이 했지.

en: Birch bark works wonders for starting fires.
ko: 자작나무 껍질은 불 피우는 데 기가 막혀.

en: I can't wait to feel the warmth on my face.
Nah, we don't need a fire right now.
I'm ready to cook some food.
Yum yum!
We don't have anything to cook right now.
Maybe we should eat...
I should start a fire and cook.
I don't want to start a fire - I'll eat it raw.
Can't start a fire. Guess it'll have to be raw.
ko: 불을 피울 수 없어. 날로 먹어야겠네.

en: On second thought, maybe not.
You seem to really be coming into your own.
ko: 넌 정말 너다워지고 있는 것 같아.

en: Though, it'd be nice if you didn't derail our journey by chasing squirrels.
ko: 그래도 다람쥐 쫓다가 우리 여정을 엉망으로 만들지 않으면 좋겠어.

en: Ok, buddy, I know that squirrel looked tasty, and he did fill your belly, but you can't just make those decisions on your own. They affect all of us.
ko: 좋아, 친구, 그 다람쥐가 맛있어 보였고 배도 채워 준 건 알아. 그래도 그런 결정을 혼자 내리면 안 돼. 우리 모두에게 영향을 주니까.

en: There's more than just you to think about out here.
ko: 여기선 너 말고도 생각해야 할 게 많아.

en: We've got to make decisions that help all of us.
ko: 우리 모두에게 도움이 되는 결정을 내려야 해.

en: Yeah, I know, you're keeping your energy up.
But let's try to find some restraint out there.
They're all counting on you to get them home.
ko: 다들 네가 집에 데려다주길 믿고 있어.

en: Can you believe we're actually out here?
Ugh, you're just the best, Chomper.
This is going to be good for us.
ko: 이건 우리한테 좋은 일이 될 거야.

en: How bout those chin pets?
Some more scratches?
Yeah, there you go.
Chomper loves pets!
Who's a good dog, Chomper?
Let's get those pets in, buddy.
I'd take this mitten off but I fear frostbite.
Aw, come here, buddy.
Pets, pets, pets.
Scratches, scratches, scratches.
That feel good, Chomper?
Maybe a bit of a massage? Keep you loose for the trail.
ko: 마사지 좀 해 줄까? 트레일 달리기 전에 몸 좀 풀어 두자.

en: I'm not sure if I'm supposed to be proud or scared of how good you are at catching prey.
ko: 네가 사냥감을 이렇게 잘 잡는 걸 자랑스러워해야 할지 무서워해야 할지 모르겠어.

en: No small creature is going to stand in your way.
ko: 어떤 작은 동물도 네 앞을 막지 못하겠구나.

en: You're powered by tiny bits of prey.
I know you're part of the food chain, but just try to think about more than your desire to chomp.
ko: 네가 먹이 사슬의 일부인 건 알지만, 깨물고 싶은 욕구 말고 다른 것도 좀 생각해 봐.

en: I'm thankful you've gotten so good at hunting, you're chomping tendencies just might get us home.
ko: 네가 사냥을 이렇게 잘하게 돼서 다행이야. 네 깨무는 습관이 우릴 집에 데려다줄지도 몰라.

en: I shouldn't have brought you out here buddy. I didn't think it was going to be this wild. I thought it'd be like more extreme camping… we're great at camping.
ko: 널 여기 데려오지 말았어야 했어, 친구. 이렇게까지 야생일 줄은 몰랐어. 좀 더 극한의 캠핑 정도일 줄 알았는데… 우린 캠핑 잘하잖아.

en: We just have to keep going, no matter if mistakes are made.
It's ok. This is just a bit harder than I thought it was going to be. Which means, I can't take it easy, I can't let my guard down. I have to protect us from whatever is out here… even squirrels.
ko: 괜찮아. 생각했던 것보다 조금 더 힘들 뿐이야. 그러니까 방심하면 안 되고, 경계를 늦추면 안 돼. 여기 뭐가 있든 우릴 지켜야 해… 다람쥐로부터도.

en: Ok, fine, you've got the squirrels covered.
You know, you're actually becoming a pretty great leader. Look at how far you've gotten us.
ko: 있잖아, 너 사실 꽤 훌륭한 리더가 되어 가고 있어. 우릴 얼마나 멀리 데려왔는지 봐.

en: You've even protected the team… though I'd prefer if you let me do more of the protecting.
ko: 팀을 지켜 주기까지 했잖아… 지키는 건 나한테 더 맡겨 주면 좋겠지만.

en: But we know it's our job to get everyone home. This is just the start… we've got a long ways to go, I think.
ko: 그래도 모두를 집에 데려가는 게 우리 일이라는 건 알잖아. 이건 시작일 뿐이야… 갈 길이 멀 것 같아.

en: We're nearly there, Chomps. You've really come into your own as a leader.
ko: 거의 다 왔어, 촘프스. 넌 정말 리더로서 제 몫을 해내게 됐어.

en: And you've stuck by me through everything. I can't thank you enough, buddy.
ko: 그리고 모든 순간 내 곁을 지켜 줬지. 아무리 고마워해도 모자라, 친구.

en: Though, I'd appreciate it if you stopped chewing through the gang line constantly. It's a lot of work to put you all back into position.
ko: 그래도 갱라인 좀 계속 씹어 끊지 않으면 고맙겠어. 너희를 다시 제자리에 세우는 거 정말 일이야.

en: Ok, fine, you're right, I did need their help.
ko: 좋아, 알았어, 네 말이 맞아. 걔들 도움이 필요했어.

en: You're always looking out for us.
How's your nose, girl?
Yeah, I know, it's painful. You can't just rush in like that.
ko: 그래, 알아, 아프지. 그렇게 무작정 뛰어들면 안 돼.

en: Come here, buddy.
I'm so proud of you, Gale. Taking your time and everything.
ko: 정말 자랑스러워, 게일. 서두르지 않고 잘했어.

en: What'd you think of that porcupine? They're much cooler when you're not covered in quills.
ko: 그 호저 어땠어? 가시로 뒤덮이지 않았을 땐 훨씬 멋있지.

en: Let's get you those scratches.
You're such a snowball, Iggy.
It's hard to get through all your fur.
Thanks for looking out for the team.
But I want you to be careful.
Hopefully we can avoid any encounters where I need you as a last resort.
ko: 널 최후의 수단으로 써야 하는 상황은 피할 수 있으면 좋겠다.

en: I can't believe you were willing to to risk yourself for the team.
ko: 팀을 위해 네 몸을 내던질 생각까지 했다니 믿기지 않아.

en: You're a good leader, Igloo.
And Chomper seems to adore you.
ko: 그리고 촘퍼가 널 정말 좋아하는 것 같아.

en: I think you like him too.
You know, this camp feels like home too.
I've got all of you and that's what really matters.
ko: 너희 모두가 있잖아. 그게 진짜 중요한 거야.

en: Ready for more belly rubs, buddy?
ko: 배 쓰다듬기 더 할 준비 됐어, 친구?

en: You know, you really have a powerful bark.
ko: 있잖아, 너 짖는 소리 정말 우렁차다.

en: You don't have to jump in to protect me, I can protect myself.
ko: 날 지키려고 뛰어들 필요 없어. 나도 내 몸은 지킬 수 있어.

en: I mean, you won't even leave my side here at camp.
ko: 아니, 넌 여기 야영지에서도 내 곁을 안 떠나잖아.

en: Yeah... I do appreciate it.
Need some pets?
How you doing, Barkley?
Thanks for coming out here with us. It's nice to have someone ready to protect us.
ko: 우리랑 같이 와 줘서 고마워. 우릴 지켜 줄 녀석이 있다는 게 든든해.

en: You don't always have to jump in, though.
Maybe try for a bark before a bite sometime.
ko: 언젠간 물기 전에 먼저 짖어 봐.

en: Yeah, ok, I'll stop talking. Just pets.
ko: 그래, 알았어, 그만 말할게. 쓰다듬기만 할게.

en: Ready for pets, Barkley.
It's good to have you on the team, Barkley.
We're going to have a pretty amazing new home.
ko: 우린 정말 멋진 새 보금자리를 갖게 될 거야.

en: This the spot?
<> How's that bark coming along, buddy?
ko: <> 짖는 연습은 잘 돼 가, 친구?

en: <> You feel like you got the hang of it?
<> You wanna try out your bark?
<> Yeah, now's not the time to be loud.
ko: <> 그래, 지금은 시끄럽게 할 때가 아니지.

en: <> More scratches, right.
Oh god, Barkley, I'm so happy I still get to give you belly rubs.
ko: 세상에, 바클리, 아직 네 배를 쓰다듬어 줄 수 있어서 정말 행복해.

en: You used that bark of yours perfectly, buddy.
ko: 네 짖는 소리를 완벽하게 썼어, 친구.

en: I need you here on this team.
Not as a protector but as the belly rub enthusiast that you are.
ko: 수호자로서가 아니라, 배 쓰다듬기를 사랑하는 너 그대로.

en: Good job, Barkley. I think we just might make it home.
ko: 잘했어, 바클리. 우리 집에 갈 수 있을 것 같아.

en: <>We're getting close, huh, buddy?
<>This has been quite the adventure.
<>I could've done with less facing my own mortality.
ko: <>내 죽음과 마주하는 일은 좀 덜 했으면 좋았겠지만.

en: <>But we're doing good.
<>Oh, time for pets? Yeah, you're right. It's always time for pets.
ko: <>오, 쓰다듬을 시간이야? 그래, 네 말이 맞아. 쓰다듬기엔 언제나 좋은 시간이지.

en: Maybe a bit of a massage? Keep you loose for the trail?
ko: 마사지 좀 해 줄까? 트레일 달리기 전에 몸 좀 풀어 둘래?

en: I'm happy to try to find all the food you need.
ko: 네가 필요한 식량은 내가 기꺼이 다 찾아 볼게.

en: You don't care much for pets, do you?
ko: 넌 쓰다듬는 거 별로 안 좋아하지?

en: More of the food motivated type.
Well, I don't have food right now, just pets, so I hope you accept them.
ko: 음, 지금은 먹을 게 없고 쓰다듬기만 있어. 그거라도 받아 줬으면 좋겠다.

en: Ugh, you're so wonderfully scruffy.
ko: 으, 넌 정말 기분 좋게 꼬질꼬질해.

en: Man, when you really set your belly on something you can do anything, huh, buddy.
ko: 와, 넌 배가 뭔가에 꽂히면 뭐든 할 수 있구나, 친구.

en: Thanks for saving me out there.
That was not how I wanted this journey to end.
ko: 이 여정이 그렇게 끝나는 건 원치 않았어.

en: You're a good, pup, Bodega.
You've been a great help.
Yeah, I'll get back to sorting dinner.
Ok, but just a few more pets.
Yeah, there ya go, buddy.
Hi, Noodle.
This feeling more exciting to you?
Yeah, ok, let's just get some scratches in.
ko: 그래, 좋아, 그냥 좀 긁어 줄게.

en: Right, I'm just here to pet you.
ko: 그래, 난 그냥 쓰다듬으러 온 거야.

en: I can't believe we released a wolf.
ko: 우리가 늑대를 풀어 줬다니 믿기지 않아.

en: I wonder how long it was out there.
Do you think it'll be ok?
I know, Noodle, but it wasn't ours to release.
ko: 알아, 누들. 그래도 우리가 풀어 줄 일은 아니었어.

en: We don't know who trapped it or why?
I'm sorry, buddy.
Hey, Noodle.
Let's get some pets in.
Yeah, you're doing great out there.
Good job, buddy.
Noodle pets!
I can't believe that wolf found us and got us some food.
ko: 그 늑대가 우릴 찾아와서 먹을 걸 구해 줬다니 믿기지 않아.

en: I'm glad I followed your lead, buddy. It was a good choice.
ko: 네 판단을 따르길 잘했어, 친구. 좋은 선택이었어.

en: It seems like you've made a friend.
I wonder if we'll see them again.
You can't keep running from things, you know. Well, considering how fast you are, maybe you can.
ko: 계속 도망만 칠 순 없어, 알지? 음, 네가 얼마나 빠른지 생각하면, 그럴 수도 있겠다.

en: But at some point you have to face your fears, know what you're up against.
ko: 그래도 언젠간 두려움과 마주해야 해. 상대가 뭔지 알아야 하고.

en: Ok, I'll stop telling you what you know.
ko: 좋아, 네가 이미 아는 얘기는 그만할게.

en: How bout some scratches.
You faced down an elk out there. I know you were scared, but you've got me. I'll help you face down whatever is out there.
ko: 넌 아까 엘크랑 정면으로 맞섰어. 무서웠던 거 알아. 그래도 내가 있잖아. 뭐가 있든 맞설 수 있게 도와줄게.

en: And I've got you to help me do the same.
ko: 그리고 나한텐 네가 있으니까 나도 똑같이 할 수 있어.

en: Ok just because we've gotten past the facing your fears part, doesn’t mean you need to seek them out.
ko: 좋아, 두려움과 마주하는 단계를 넘겼다고 해서 일부러 찾아다닐 필요는 없어.

en: I know you can handle yourself. And you know that too.
ko: 네가 스스로를 지킬 수 있다는 거 알아. 너도 알고.

en: You're definitely ready for anything now. You just had to realize that too.
ko: 이제 넌 확실히 뭐든 할 준비가 됐어. 너도 그걸 깨닫기만 하면 됐던 거야.

en: Any good spots to put the trap, Stilton?
ko: 덫 놓기 좋은 곳 있어, 스틸턴?

en: Worth setting the trap, Stilton?
I really think you can understand me.
ko: 넌 정말 내 말을 알아듣는 것 같아.

en: You keeping a lookout for all of us?
Yeah, I don't want to distract you too much, but I think it's time for some good ole pets.
ko: 그래, 너무 방해하고 싶진 않은데, 이제 좀 쓰다듬어 줄 시간인 것 같아.

en: Maybe some of these?
And a bit of a scratch here.
You little ham. You just want everyone to love you.
ko: 이 관종아. 모두가 널 사랑해 주길 바라는구나.

en: And I do.
Fin...
Did you take my beanie?
It kinda looks like you did.
Are you comforted by my scent?
Cause I think you're thinking about being my friend.
ko: 왜냐하면 네가 나랑 친구가 될 생각을 하는 것 같거든.

en: Ok, well I'll need that hat back before we go running, but you can keep it for now.
ko: 좋아, 달리러 가기 전엔 그 모자 돌려받아야 하지만, 지금은 갖고 있어도 돼.

en: Hey, Fin.
So, I know you took my beanie. Are you ready for a pet?
ko: 그래서, 네가 내 비니 가져간 거 알아. 쓰다듬어도 될까?

en: Ok, not yet. I get it.
But you are warming up to me. We'll just take our time.
ko: 그래도 나한테 마음을 열고 있잖아. 천천히 하자.

en: And maybe I'll give you my beanie again when I go to sleep.
ko: 그리고 내가 잘 때 비니 또 빌려줄게.

en: Alright, girl. A promise is a promise.
Here is my beanie. Feel free to snuggle it.
I'll probably be a bit cold tonight, but it's worth it.
ko: 오늘 밤엔 좀 춥겠지만, 그럴 가치가 있어.

en: Ok, Fin, I'll see you in the morning.
You ready to try this again.
It's ok. Just smell my mitten.
ko: 괜찮아. 내 장갑 냄새만 맡아 봐.

en: I'm going to move to the side of your neck.
I'm just going to scratch right here.
Oh my god. We're doing it, Fin!
Awwwww. We had a moment!
I knew you were starting to like me.
ko: 네가 날 좋아하기 시작했다는 거 알았어.

en: <>Ok, let's try this again.
<>There ya go, Fin.
<>See, we've got a thing going.
<>Aw, I like you too, buddy.
<>You're such a good, pup.
<>I'm going to get you your own beanie someday.
<>Maybe I'll even cut ear holes in it.
You did good out there.
I don't mind you found a skunk.
I trust you, Fin. You can trust me.
ko: 난 널 믿어, 핀. 너도 날 믿어도 돼.

en: But you still smell a little.
It's ok. You don't have to be the petting type.
ko: 괜찮아. 꼭 쓰다듬받는 걸 좋아할 필요는 없어.

en: You barely know me.
But I think you'll grow to like me. I already like you.
ko: 그래도 날 좋아하게 될 거야. 난 이미 네가 좋거든.

en: Let's just take it slow and we'll find ways to show we trust one another.
ko: 천천히 가자. 서로를 믿는다는 걸 보여 줄 방법을 찾게 될 거야.

en: I don't need it.
Time to patch myself up.
Gotta patch up my pup.
Nevermind.
I shouldn't have risked it.
I'll... I'll be ok.
Well, I feel a bit better.
That should be good enough.
Hey, buddy. How you holding up?
Tend to wounds with med pack
Comfort
Maybe later
I got you, Noodle.
Come here, Chomper, let me fix that up.
ko: 이리 와, 촘퍼. 그거 치료해 줄게.

en: I can patch that, Gale.
Let me take care of you, Barkley.
There you go, Igloo.
It's ok, Slayer.
Good as new, Fin.
All better, Stilton.
This should do the trick, Bodega.
This will fix you up.
Let me heal that.
I'll bandage you up.
I know it hurts, we'll try to find another med pack.
ko: 아픈 거 알아. 구급상자를 하나 더 찾아볼게.

en: If any of us gets hurt again, we're done.
ko: 우리 중 누구라도 또 다치면, 끝이야.

en: Do the best you can.
Food time! Chow down, pups!
ko: 밥 먹을 시간! 실컷 먹어, 얘들아!

en: I'm sorry, buddy. I don't have anything to feed you.
ko: 미안해, 친구. 줄 게 아무것도 없어.

en: Might be time to get some rest.
ko: 좀 쉴 때가 된 것 같아.

en: I need to eat first, I'm not sure I'll wake up if I don't.
ko: 먼저 뭘 좀 먹어야겠어. 안 그러면 못 깨어날지도 몰라.

en: I'm not ready for the long sleep. I need to eat or I don't think I'll wake up.
ko: 영원히 잠들 준비는 안 됐어. 뭘 좀 먹어야 해. 안 그러면 못 깨어날 것 같아.

en: I'm sure my stomach will be grumbling by morning, but the dogs will be energized.
ko: 아침엔 배가 꼬르륵거리겠지만, 개들은 기운이 넘칠 거야.

en: Well, should we go to sleep?
Give Fin beanie.
I really think Fin is starting to like me. We'll be a little cold tonight, but it's worth it.
ko: 핀이 정말 날 좋아하기 시작한 것 같아. 오늘 밤엔 좀 춥겠지만, 그럴 가치가 있어.

en: (6 hours pass)
Alright, everyone feeling better?
Get back on the trail?
Fin, I'm going to need my beanie back now. Thanks, buddy.
ko: 핀, 이제 비니 돌려줘야 해. 고마워, 친구.

en: Ready to go?
Alright. Let's mush on!
I think we're done here. Let's go.
ko: 여기선 다 끝난 것 같아. 가자.

en: Let's be safe out there.
What do you think, Stilton. Will we catch something?
ko: 어떻게 생각해, 스틸턴. 뭐 좀 잡힐까?

en: Should I set the trap?
Yes.
No.
Yes. Let Stilton pick spot.
We'll just hide it over here.
We'll check on it when we wake up.
Maybe later.
Stilton, where should I set the trap tonight?
ko: 스틸턴, 오늘 밤엔 덫을 어디에 놓을까?

en: What do you see out there?
Let's see what we've caught...
Looks like we have a bunny.
Nice, we caught a weasel.
Got us a beaver.
Looks like we got something.
Perfect, more meat.
We'll have more food to cook up.
A snack for you pups.
You were right, buddy! I found another rabbit out there.
ko: 네 말이 맞았어, 친구! 저기서 토끼 한 마리를 또 찾았어.

en: Good choice, Stilton. There were a couple of weasels over there.
ko: 좋은 선택이었어, 스틸턴. 저기 족제비가 두어 마리 있었어.

en: Did you know there were going to ptarmigans roosting, too?
ko: 뇌조가 둥지를 틀고 있을 줄도 알았어?

en: He's one of us forever now.
That was a mistake.
We should get out of here.
Why did I go out there?!
I think I just have to risk the bad luck.
That worked up an appetite. I'm going to have to keep an eye on my hunger when I venture off.
ko: 배가 고파졌어. 멀리 나갈 땐 허기를 잘 살펴야겠어.

en: Chomper you back at the lead?
You know, Chomper, you can't just follow me whenever you want.
ko: 있잖아, 촘퍼, 아무 때나 날 따라오면 안 돼.

en: Chomper, I hope you learn how to make rabbit rope lines. We're running low on the store bought kind.
ko: 촘퍼, 토끼털로 줄 만드는 법 좀 배웠으면 좋겠다. 가게에서 산 줄이 다 떨어져 가.

en: Chomper, do you mind not releasing everyone all the time?
ko: 촘퍼, 매번 다들 풀어 주지 좀 않을래?

en: Alright, everyone back in their harnesses?
Thanks for coming out there with me.
You know, you all don't have to follow me.
ko: 있잖아, 다들 날 따라올 필요는 없어.

en: I'm not doing too good.
Hey pups...
I'm back.
That was worth it.
Hey, look what I found.
That was a good diversion.
Ok, I'm back.
Thanks for waiting, pups.
Thanks for holding down the sled, pups.
You pups do ok?
Let's go, Chomper.
Ugh, ok, let's just patch this up.
I'm glad I have some training. I can at least keep this from killing me.
ko: 훈련을 좀 받아서 다행이야. 적어도 이걸로 죽진 않게 막을 수 있어.

en: Let's bandage this up.
Thank god we packed these.
I can keep going now.
Ok, we've only got one med pack left.
We're onto our last med pack.
We've still got one med pack. Hopefully we don't have any more emergencies.
ko: 아직 구급상자가 하나 있어. 더는 응급 상황이 없길 바라.

en: We've got one med pack for all of us. Let's be careful.
ko: 우리 모두를 위한 구급상자가 하나뿐이야. 조심하자.

en: I'm feeling better, but that was the last med pack. We have to be careful.
ko: 좀 나아졌지만, 그게 마지막 구급상자였어. 조심해야 해.

en: I don't think I can take another hit like that.
ko: 그런 걸 한 번 더 당하면 못 버틸 것 같아.

en: We're out of bandages.
That was the last med pack. No more room for error.
ko: 그게 마지막 구급상자였어. 이제 실수할 여유가 없어.

en: Just be kind to us, wilderness. We're out of med packs.
ko: 야생아, 제발 우리한테 너그러워 줘. 구급상자가 다 떨어졌어.

en: We'll just have to shoot first, talk to animals second.
ko: 이제 먼저 쏘고, 동물한테 말 거는 건 그다음이야.

en: We can't risk getting hurt now.
ko: 이제 다치는 위험은 감수할 수 없어.

en: Right, the last med pack. Well, it's not death.
ko: 그래, 마지막 구급상자. 뭐, 죽는 건 아니니까.

en: Found a med pack
And we found a med pack
And thank god, a med pack.
That was pretty amazing.
I feel like I'm learning so much out here.
ko: 여기서 정말 많은 걸 배우는 것 같아.

en: I didn't know I wanted to live in a documentary, but I definitely did.
ko: 다큐멘터리 속에 살고 싶었는지 몰랐는데, 확실히 그랬나 봐.

en: I can't believe they actually do that.
Sometimes this place just doesn't seem real.
This place brings out the unexpected, doesn't it.
ko: 이곳은 예상치 못한 걸 끌어내지, 그렇지 않아?

en: I know it hurts. We'll try to find another med pack.
ko: 아픈 거 알아. 구급상자를 하나 더 찾아볼게.

en: It's ok. Get in the sled. You don't need to run right now.
ko: 괜찮아. 썰매에 타. 지금은 달릴 필요 없어.

en: I didn't expect it to rip our sled.
Our sled is a bit worse for wear but it should still work.
ko: 썰매가 좀 상했지만 아직 쓸 만할 거야.

en: I shouldn't have expected it to stay pristine.
ko: 멀쩡하게 유지될 거라고 기대하면 안 됐지.

en: Ugh we're out of bullets.
We're going to need to find bullets.
Great. No bullets.
Ok, so we're out of bullets.
So, no bullets. This might be tough.
ko: 그러니까, 총알이 없어. 힘들 수도 있겠다.

en: We don't need bullets to survive.
ko: 살아남는 데 총알이 꼭 필요한 건 아니야.

en: Let's just hope we don't run into anything that wants to eat us.
ko: 우릴 잡아먹으려는 녀석과 마주치지 않길 바라자.

en: We've got one bullet left.
We're onto our last bullet.
Only one bullet left.
This is our last bullet.
We need to make it count.
We've got to find some food soon.
At least we've already got some food.
Alright, we've got two bullets.
Two bullets left, team.
Ok, at least we've got two bullets.
ko: 좋아, 적어도 총알이 두 발은 있어.

en: Three bullets left.
Four bullets left.
Five bullets left.
Got some bullets.
These bullets will help.
At least one of us won't starve.
ko: 적어도 우리 중 하나는 굶지 않겠어.

en: I brought you back a snack, Iggy.
Good find, pups.
Another meal ready to go.
We've got some more meat.
Some more food.
We should probably eat.
You pups look hungry.
Yeah, I should feed you pups.
I'm starving.
Might be time to have a meal.
ko: 밥 먹을 때가 된 것 같아.

en: I wouldn't mind a snack.
This birch will really help.
ko: 이 자작나무가 정말 도움이 될 거야.

en: We can start a fire at camp now.
ko: 이제 야영지에서 불을 피울 수 있어.

en: We'll be able to get warm.
I don't know if I'm cut out for living off the land, but I don't think you can know that until you just try.
ko: 내가 자연에서 얻어 살아가는 데 맞는 사람인지는 모르겠지만, 직접 해 보기 전엔 알 수 없는 법이야.

en: We'll get better at this.
One paw in front of the other, right?
ko: 한 발 한 발 내딛는 거야, 그렇지?

en: That's how you get there. You just keep taking steps, even if they're not always as sure-footed as you'd like.
ko: 그렇게 도착하는 거야. 원하는 만큼 확실한 걸음이 아니더라도, 그냥 계속 내딛는 거지.

en: There's no reason to be afraid out here.
Margot did this by understanding how to live with the land, not just off the land.
ko: 마고는 자연에서 얻어 사는 게 아니라 자연과 함께 사는 법을 이해했기에 해낸 거야.

en: You can't always take and expect it to keep giving. You have to prepare to give back.
ko: 늘 가져가기만 하면서 계속 내주길 바랄 순 없어. 돌려줄 준비도 해야 해.

en: I thought I could just conquer whatever got in my way, and I had for most of my life.
ko: 앞을 가로막는 건 뭐든 이겨 낼 수 있다고 생각했고, 평생 대부분 그렇게 해 왔어.

en: And I know I could go pass the tests if I wanted to... I just don't think I want to.
ko: 그리고 원한다면 시험에 합격할 수도 있다는 걸 알아... 그냥 원하지 않는 것 같아.

en: Studying for an exam is way easier than what we're doing right now.
ko: 시험공부는 지금 우리가 하는 일보다 훨씬 쉬워.

en: And yet, I'd rather be here.
ko: 그런데도 난 여기 있는 게 더 좋아.

en: Pushed to the point where I don't think I can handle any more and finding out, that I always have a little more to give.
ko: 더는 못 버틸 것 같은 한계까지 몰렸다가, 언제나 조금 더 내줄 게 남아 있다는 걸 알게 되는 거.

en: A little more fight.
I thought this was just about getting from A to B.
ko: 그냥 A에서 B로 가는 일인 줄 알았어.

en: The destination was the goal and that was all that mattered.
You just had to find a way.
But I'm not sure the destination matters if you don't like the who you're there with... especially if it's just you.
ko: 하지만 거기 함께 있는 존재를 좋아하지 않는다면 목적지가 중요할까... 특히 그게 나 자신뿐이라면.

en: I was worried I'd lose sight of who I was out here, become someone different.
ko: 여기서 내가 누구인지 잊고, 다른 사람이 될까 봐 걱정했어.

en: But I think I'm just becoming who I am.
ko: 그런데 그냥 진짜 내가 되어 가고 있는 것 같아.

en: And that scares me even more.
And that excites me even more.
I mean, Chomper, you've led this team well. You've taken a few more squirrel-based detours than I would've liked, but you're figuring it out.
ko: 있잖아, 촘퍼, 넌 이 팀을 잘 이끌었어. 다람쥐 때문에 돌아간 길이 내 바람보다 좀 많았지만, 점점 알아 가고 있잖아.

en: You can't always rush in to everything assuming it will be ok. Take a breath and make sure you're ready for what's next.
ko: 모든 일에 괜찮을 거라 믿고 무작정 뛰어들 순 없어. 숨 한번 고르고 다음 일에 준비됐는지 확인해.

en: And if you aren't today, maybe you will be soon.
ko: 오늘 준비가 안 됐다면, 곧 될지도 몰라.

en: We don't know what's coming next, but we have to go look.
ko: 다음에 뭐가 올지 모르지만, 가서 봐야 해.

en: We can handle what's in front of us. We can take action, but there's nothing we can do about what we don't know.
ko: 눈앞에 있는 건 감당할 수 있어. 행동할 수도 있고. 하지만 모르는 건 어쩔 수가 없어.

en: So we learn, we look to the land and we prepare ourselves so we can face the things that scare us most if they come to pass.
ko: 그러니 배우고, 대지를 살피고, 대비하는 거야. 가장 무서운 일이 닥쳐도 맞설 수 있도록.

en: But let's hope they don't
You know when you just feel like people don't look at you the same anymore?
ko: 사람들이 더는 예전처럼 날 봐 주지 않는다고 느낄 때 있지?

en: They give you that look of, "oh her, she used to be great but now, well..."
ko: 아, 쟤. 예전엔 대단했는데 지금은, 뭐... 하는 눈빛.

en: Yeah, that look. That moment right when they drop their eyes from yours.
ko: 그래, 그 눈빛. 날 보던 눈을 내리깔던 바로 그 순간.

en: It doesn't need to stay that way. You can always find a way back, you just need someone to believe.
ko: 계속 그럴 필요는 없어. 돌아갈 길은 언제든 찾을 수 있어. 믿어 주는 누군가가 있기만 하면 돼.

en: Even if the only person is you. Ok, and you too, Fin.
ko: 그게 나 하나뿐이라도. 그래, 너도 있지, 핀.

en: I really thought I needed the praise, the awards to feel like I had accomplished something, but hearing Margot's story that she just wanted to finish just to know that she could... I needed to find that too.
ko: 뭔가 이뤘다고 느끼려면 칭찬과 상이 필요하다고 정말 믿었어. 그런데 그저 해낼 수 있다는 걸 알고 싶어서 완주하고 싶었다는 마고의 이야기를 들으니... 나도 그걸 찾아야 했어.

en: Though I'm not sure if I will.
But I can't stop. That won't answer anything.
ko: 그래도 멈출 순 없어. 멈추면 아무 답도 얻지 못해.

en: I thought I could do this all on my own. Just me and nature, but I'd be nothing without all of you.
ko: 이 모든 걸 혼자 해낼 수 있다고 생각했어. 나와 자연뿐이라고. 그런데 너희가 없었으면 난 아무것도 아니었을 거야.

en: I came out here because I thought I needed to be by myself. A trial by fire to know what i could handle, but I found something so much more: a fuzzy little family.
ko: 혼자 있어야 한다고 생각해서 여기 왔어. 내가 뭘 견딜 수 있는지 알기 위한 불의 시련이었지. 그런데 그보다 훨씬 큰 걸 찾았어. 복슬복슬한 작은 가족을.

en: You forgive my mistakes and my miscalculations even when i don't feel like I deserve that.
ko: 너희는 내가 그럴 자격이 없다고 느낄 때조차 내 실수와 오판을 용서해 줘.

en: We all needed a chance to try again.
ko: 우린 모두 다시 해 볼 기회가 필요했어.

en: To find our home.
And each other.
Just stay still up there, Chomper. We'll stop soon.
ko: 거기 가만히 있어, 촘퍼. 곧 멈출 거야.

en: We're gonna be ok, Iggy. Just rest.
ko: 우린 괜찮을 거야, 이기. 그냥 쉬어.

en: Try not to move, we'll camp soon.
It's ok, buddy, I got you. We're going to figure this out.
ko: 괜찮아, 친구, 내가 있잖아. 방법을 찾을 거야.

en: We'll find something to fix you.
My stomach is really grumbling.
I need to eat soon.
When did we last eat.
You pups need the food more than I did. W
We'll find something.
I know you're hungry, but we don't have any food.
ko: 배고픈 거 알지만, 식량이 하나도 없어.

en: I promise, I'll get the the next food I can.
ko: 약속할게, 다음에 구할 수 있는 식량은 꼭 구할게.

en: We'll get some food soon.
Chomper, maybe you can catch something?
ko: 촘퍼, 네가 뭐 좀 잡을 수 있을까?

en: I'm not sure what we're going to do without anyway to get food.
ko: 식량을 구할 방법이 없으면 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어.

en: You getting hungry, Bodega?
Wait... you're always hungry. Yeah, ok, we'll stop soon.
ko: 잠깐... 넌 늘 배고프지. 그래, 알았어, 곧 멈출게.

en: You pups are looking tired.
Let's get some rest.
We should eat soon.
I'll feed you soon.
Yeah, we should camp soon.
Yawnnnn.
It's getting hard to keep my eyes open.
I hope a plush little pillowtop is waiting for me at the cabin.
ko: 오두막에 푹신한 침대가 기다리고 있으면 좋겠다.

en: Yeah, i know this is crazy, but it felt right. And sometimes you just have to follow your gut.
ko: 그래, 미친 짓인 거 알지만, 옳다고 느껴졌어. 그리고 가끔은 직감을 따라야 해.

en: I stopped feeling like me, I just felt like I was the carreer I was chasing and nothing else mattered but that.
ko: 더는 나 자신 같지 않았어. 내가 좇던 경력이 나의 전부인 것 같았고, 그것 말고는 아무것도 중요하지 않았어.

en: I know that you can't just follow your dreams without any consequences, but I needed to do more than check the same list as everyone else.
ko: 대가 없이 꿈만 좇을 순 없다는 거 알아. 그래도 남들과 똑같은 목록에 체크하는 것 이상의 뭔가를 해야 했어.

en: I really am happy for the training I had, and I want to help, but I don't think I can help others until I feel like I know who I am.
ko: 내가 받은 교육엔 정말 감사하고, 사람들을 돕고도 싶어. 하지만 내가 누군지 안다고 느끼기 전엔 남을 도울 수 없을 것 같아.

en: I don't want to be scared when things get bad.
ko: 상황이 나빠질 때 겁먹고 싶지 않아.

en: I want to be able to conquer it.
I want to know that I'm scared and figure out why.
ko: 내가 두렵다는 걸 알고, 왜 그런지 알아내고 싶어.

en: But let's not dwell on that, look, we're in Alaska. It's just us and the wilderness and like a lot of snow.
ko: 그래도 그 생각에 빠져 있진 말자. 봐, 우린 알래스카에 있어. 우리와 야생, 그리고 엄청난 양의 눈뿐이야.

en: I'm only mildly creeped out.
Nothing goes to waste out here.
There's a lot I can learn from them.
Do you think the bears have developed a taste for people?
I probably taste pretty good. And hey, as we've been saying, meat is meat, especially to them.
ko: 나 아마 꽤 맛있을 거야. 그리고 뭐, 우리가 늘 말했듯이 고기는 고기지. 특히 걔들한텐.

en: And we're out here invading their space. So, fine. Fair play, bear.
ko: 그리고 우리가 걔들 영역을 침범하고 있잖아. 그러니까, 좋아. 공정한 게임이야, 곰아.

en: At least you're all ok. I don't know what i'd do if the bear hurt you.
ko: 적어도 너희는 다 괜찮아. 곰이 너희를 다치게 했으면 어떻게 했을지 모르겠어.

en: Now, out here we don't say "left" and "right," we use
ko: 자, 여기선 "왼쪽", "오른쪽"이라고 하지 않고, 이렇게 말해.

en: Haw for left.
and "Gee" for right.
So let's go...
Haw (left)!
Gee (right)!
Haw!
Gee!
A fork in the road, where to?
Hmm. Let's go...
Now what?
We're making progress.
Getting closer.
Looks like we're getting there.
Alright, let's keep going.
Good work.
Haw
Gee
Oh god, you pups look like you're getting too tired to run.
ko: 세상에, 너희 너무 지쳐서 못 달릴 것 같아.

en: You're right, we can eat.
ko: 네 말이 맞아, 먹을 수 있어.

en: Let's make camp and we'll go from there.
I don't think I can go any further.
We have to make camp so I can eat.
Then we can keep going.
Ok?
I'm exhausted.
I'm not sure I can trust my eyes out here.
ko: 여기선 내 눈을 믿을 수 있을지 모르겠어.

en: You ever feel like you start seeing things?
ko: 헛것이 보이기 시작하는 느낌 받아 본 적 있어?

en: I'm sure it'll be fine, but we'll need to rest at some point.
ko: 괜찮을 거야. 그래도 언젠간 쉬어야 해.

en: The dogs can't run as far without rest.
ko: 개들은 쉬지 않으면 멀리 못 달려.

en: I can feel the chill throughout my body.
Every movement takes more work.
I'm spending half my energy just trying to stay warm.
ko: 따뜻하게 버티는 데만 기운의 절반을 쓰고 있어.

en: Good work pups, I know this is tiring but you're doing great!
ko: 잘했어, 얘들아. 힘든 거 알지만 정말 잘하고 있어!

en: Nice job, pups! Another few miles down.
ko: 잘했어, 얘들아! 또 몇 마일 왔어.

en: I can see you're getting tired, but you're doing great.
ko: 지친 게 보여. 그래도 정말 잘하고 있어.

en: We'll rest soon.
I'll get you some food soon.
You've got this pups!
You ok, pups?
I've pushed you too hard, haven't I?
It's ok. We're done. You've done all you can.
ko: 괜찮아. 여기까지야. 할 수 있는 건 다 했어.

en: (Your dogs ran out of energy.)
It's not looking good, pups.
I think it's time for us to just rest.
ko: 이제 그냥 쉴 때가 된 것 같아.

en: Let's take a break, hopefully someone will find us soon.
ko: 좀 쉬자. 누군가 곧 우릴 찾아 주길 바라며.

en: No. No. Wait...
It's ok, pups. Let's rest here.
We'll just rest here, pups. It'll be ok.
I'm feeling a little weak, pups...
It's getting dark, right?
I'll just rest my eyes. Keep on running, pups.
ko: 잠깐 눈만 붙일게. 계속 달려, 얘들아.

en: (You starved.)
Ooh. Nightmare. I am so happy that was a nightmare.
Oh, thank god that was just a nightmare.
We're ok. We're all ok.
I need to remember to eat when I have the chance.
ko: 기회가 있을 때 먹는 걸 잊지 말아야 해.

en: I should listen to my stomach.
Everything takes so much effort. I have to keep myself fed if I want to do anything.
ko: 모든 게 너무 힘이 들어. 뭐라도 하려면 잘 먹어야 해.

en: It's easy to forget about taking care of yourself. But you can't care for others if you don't have the energy to do anything.
ko: 자신을 돌보는 건 잊기 쉬워. 하지만 아무것도 할 기운이 없으면 남을 돌볼 수도 없어.

en: I kept missing my shots.
We just couldn't find any meat.
We ran out of meat.
I couldn't find any food.
I'll make sure we find food.
I'll try to find more things we can eat.
ko: 먹을 수 있는 걸 더 찾아볼게.

en: I just couldn't find any food.
There just wasn't any food around.
I'll make sure to feed you.
I'll do better when we're actually out there.
I didn't think ahead.
I need to keep an eye on all of us.
A nightmare. Ok, well, at least I have an idea what could happen to me out there.
ko: 악몽이었어. 좋아, 음, 적어도 여기서 나한테 무슨 일이 일어날 수 있는지 감은 잡았어.

en: Yeah, we really need to take care of ourselves out there.
ko: 그래, 밖에선 정말 우리 몸을 잘 챙겨야 해.

en: We've got a lot of stomachs to think about.
I can't take care of you if I don't have the strength to keep my eyes open.
ko: 눈 뜨고 있을 기운도 없으면 너희를 돌볼 수 없어.

en: We have to plan ahead. Are we ready for this?
I didn't think it could be that hard.
It was just a dream. Well, a nightmare, but that's how you prepare. Imagine the worst that can happen so you know how it feels; so you can steel yourself and make a different choice when you wake.
ko: 그냥 꿈이었어. 음, 악몽이지만, 그게 대비하는 방법이야. 최악의 상황을 상상해서 어떤 기분인지 알아 두는 거지. 깨어났을 때 마음을 다잡고 다른 선택을 할 수 있도록.

en: I know it's crazy, but we find ourselves in challenges. Like you've all been waiting to get back out there and run and soon enough we'll be racing again. Finding our joy in the unknown.
ko: 미친 소리인 거 알지만, 우린 도전 속에서 우리 자신을 찾아. 너희가 다시 나가서 달리기만을 기다려 온 것처럼, 곧 우린 다시 경주하게 될 거야. 미지 속에서 기쁨을 찾으면서.

en: I already had one of you in the sled.
ko: 이미 너희 중 하나를 썰매에 태우고 있었어.

en: I hadn't had the chance to heal her yet.
ko: 아직 그 애를 치료할 기회가 없었어.

en: I hadn't had the chance to heal him yet.
ko: 아직 그 녀석을 치료할 기회가 없었어.

en: I needed the bandage. At least, I thought I did.
But two... there's nothing I can do if two of you get injured.
ko: 하지만 둘이라니... 너희 중 둘이 다치면 내가 할 수 있는 게 없어.

en: I won't leave one of you behind.
ko: 너희 중 누구도 두고 가지 않을 거야.

en: Yeah, you're right. It's ok. I'm just catastrophizing.
ko: 그래, 네 말이 맞아. 괜찮아. 그냥 최악을 상상하는 것뿐이야.

en: That's how we prepare. It's how we know what to do when things get bad.
ko: 그게 우리가 대비하는 방법이야. 상황이 나빠졌을 때 뭘 해야 할지 알게 되는 방법.

en: And let's do our best to not let them get that bad.
ko: 그리고 그렇게까지 나빠지지 않도록 최선을 다하자.

en: Cause I do believe this is the life for us.
Yeah. We've got this. (Try again.)
ko: 그래. 우린 할 수 있어. (다시 시도)

en: We're not ready. (Save and Quit to Menu)
ko: 아직 준비가 안 됐어. (저장 후 메뉴로)

en: It's a good thing we have an overactive imagination.
We know what we're up against. Well, we can imagine what we're up against.
ko: 우리가 뭘 상대하는지 알아. 음, 뭘 상대할지 상상할 수 있지.

en: And the only way to know if we belong is to just get out there and start, right?
ko: 그리고 우리가 여기 어울리는지 알 수 있는 유일한 방법은 그냥 나가서 시작하는 거야, 그렇지?

en: And the only way to prove if we belong is to just get out there and conquer our fears, right?
ko: 그리고 우리가 여기 어울린다는 걸 증명하는 유일한 방법은 나가서 두려움을 이겨 내는 거야, 그렇지?

en: And the only way to find out who you are, is to challenge yourself and see what you care about, right?
ko: 그리고 내가 누군지 알아내는 유일한 방법은 스스로에게 도전하고 내가 뭘 소중히 여기는지 보는 거야, 그렇지?

en: Huh, Chomps?
Let's keep going (try again)
Let's take a break. (Save and quit)
So, let's go. Let's get out there and live wildly. Live the life that feels true to us.
ko: 그러니까, 가자. 나가서 거침없이 살자. 우리에게 진실하게 느껴지는 삶을 살자.

en: But we're ready for it, aren't we, Chomper?
We'll be fine. (try again)
Let's take a break. (save and quit)
So what do you say...
Let's go. (try again)
Nah, let's quit.
It's ok, it was just a nightmare. We know what to look out for. We're ready.
ko: 괜찮아, 그냥 악몽이었어. 뭘 조심해야 할지 알잖아. 우린 준비됐어.

en: It's ok, they were just nightmares. That's not going to happen to us.
ko: 괜찮아, 그냥 악몽들이었어. 우리한텐 그런 일 안 일어나.

en: But I suppose it is making me prepared.
ko: 그래도 덕분에 대비가 되는 것 같아.

en: I know what to be wary of...
Ok, just have to be prepared... and hope the world is on my side...
ko: 좋아, 대비만 하면 돼... 그리고 세상이 내 편이길 바라고...

en: And that little nightmare reminded me...
ko: 그리고 그 작은 악몽 덕분에 기억났어...

en: To pack our axe to strip those birch trees.
ko: 자작나무 껍질을 벗길 도끼를 챙기는 걸.

en: To bring some flint so we can always start a fire.
ko: 언제든 불을 피울 수 있게 부싯돌을 챙기는 걸.

en: To calibrate this gun so it shoots true.
ko: 똑바로 쏘도록 이 총의 영점을 잡는 걸.

en: To put all your booties on so your feet stay properly warm and safe.
ko: 발이 따뜻하고 안전하도록 너희 모두에게 덧신을 신기는 걸.

en: To pack a trap so we can catch food while we're sleeping at camp.
ko: 야영지에서 자는 동안에도 먹을 걸 잡을 수 있게 덫을 챙기는 걸.

en: There are so many tree stumps over there.
We don't have time for trees. Let's go.
ko: 나무 신경 쓸 시간 없어. 가자.

en: We've got our flint. We don't need to worry about trees now.
ko: 부싯돌이 있어. 이제 나무 걱정은 안 해도 돼.

en: I'd be a lot more comfortable if it didn't just feel like people disappeared here.
ko: 여기서 사람들이 그냥 사라진 것 같은 느낌만 아니면 훨씬 마음이 편할 텐데.

en: Well, there's an axe here...
Take the axe.
Leave the axe.
Look around more.
I'm just going to, um, take this...
I don't think they'll mind.
The most useful tool in the world.
Finders keepers applies, right?
ko: 먼저 찾은 사람이 임자라는 법칙이 통하지, 그렇지?

en: Though, is this really where I want to be living?
ko: 그래도, 정말 여기서 살고 싶은 걸까?

en: This place where people just, like, disappear and then someone comes along and just takes your axe?
ko: 사람들이 그냥, 사라지고, 그다음엔 누가 와서 도끼를 가져가 버리는 이런 곳에서?

en: I'm not sure we should move here when we just keep finding abandoned places.
ko: 버려진 곳만 계속 발견되는데 여기로 이사 와도 되는 걸까.

en: Are they just leaving? Are they coming here for a single season only?
ko: 다들 그냥 떠나는 걸까? 한 철만 지내러 오는 걸까?

en: Are they being eaten?!
I've been as close to a bear's gullet as i'd like.
ko: 곰의 목구멍엔 이미 원하는 만큼 가까이 가 봤어.

en: It opens locks, strips bark, hits things. The first and best multi-tool.
ko: 자물쇠도 열고, 껍질도 벗기고, 뭐든 내려치고. 최초이자 최고의 만능 도구야.

en: I should've packed an axe instead of waiting to get the one at our cabin.
ko: 오두막에 있는 도끼를 기다릴 게 아니라 하나 챙겨 왔어야 했어.

en: It's far more useful with me than not.
ko: 없는 것보다 있는 게 훨씬 쓸모 있어.

en: Oh well. I've got one now.
ko: 뭐, 어쩔 수 없지. 이제 하나 생겼잖아.

en: I kind of feel like maybe I'm just rationalizing theft.
ko: 왠지 도둑질을 합리화하고 있는 것 같기도 해.

en: But if I don't take it, someone else will.
ko: 그래도 내가 안 가져가면 다른 누군가가 가져가겠지.

en: Well, should I try this out? There seems to be plenty of birch here.
ko: 음, 한번 써 볼까? 여기 자작나무가 많아 보이는데.

en: Collect birch with axe. (No fullness lost)
Get back to trail.
We'll be fine. Let's go.
We've already got flint. Let's go.
I don't want to look at the world as though I can solve every problem by cutting it down.
ko: 모든 문제를 베어 버려서 해결할 수 있다는 식으로 세상을 보고 싶진 않아.

en: Sometimes I want to think outside the box, not just split it open and rip out what's inside.
ko: 가끔은 틀을 쪼개서 안을 뜯어내는 게 아니라, 틀 밖에서 생각하고 싶어.

en: But it looks like this person found some good birch trees.
ko: 그래도 이 사람은 좋은 자작나무를 찾은 것 같아.

en: Look at birch tree.
Get back on trail.
I'm done here. Let's go.
I bet stripping this bark would've been easier with that axe.
ko: 그 도끼가 있었으면 껍질 벗기기가 훨씬 쉬웠을 텐데.

en: We've chosen the harder path, and that's ok. It's the one we want.
ko: 우린 더 힘든 길을 택했고, 그래도 괜찮아. 그게 우리가 원하는 길이니까.

en: Take bark.
Leave bark.
But maybe not today. Let's just get back on the trail.
ko: 그래도 오늘은 아니야. 그냥 트레일로 돌아가자.

en: Rip off birch.
Get axe.
I don't know if I'll ever feel comfortable running on top of water.
ko: 물 위를 달리는 게 편해질 날이 올지 모르겠어.

en: Doesn't look like you pups like it much either.
ko: 너희도 별로 안 좋아하는 것 같네.

en: There's something up ahead.
Is that a fish rack? I suppose a river is a good spot for it.
ko: 저거 생선 건조대야? 강가는 그런 거 두기 좋은 곳이지.

en: Open water means softer edges. Let's get out of here.
ko: 얼음이 녹은 물이 있다는 건 가장자리가 무르다는 뜻이야. 여기서 나가자.

en: I wonder when someone last fished here?
ko: 마지막으로 여기서 누가 낚시한 게 언제였을까?

en: It doesn't look like this has held fish in forever... and there's a fishing pole still here.
ko: 여기에 물고기가 걸려 있던 건 까마득한 옛날 같은데... 낚싯대가 아직 있네.

en: I mean, they left it for a reason...
They probably quit fishing.
They knew no one would take it.
ko: 아무도 안 가져갈 줄 알았나 봐.

en: A bear definitely got them.
I left a perfectly good couch on the street hoping it would serve someone else well...
ko: 멀쩡한 소파를 다른 사람이 잘 쓰길 바라며 길에 내놓은 적이 있었는데...

en: This is probably one of those situations.
Maybe they carved "free" into the dirt but the snow is covering it?
ko: 땅에 '무료'라고 새겨 뒀는데 눈에 덮인 걸지도?

en: Yeah. Take the fishing pole.
Leave the fishing pole.
How am I supposed to know if this has been abandoned or if the person intends to return?
ko: 이게 버려진 건지, 주인이 돌아올 생각인 건지 내가 어떻게 알아?

en: Maybe this was left so I could find it and survive?
ko: 내가 찾아서 살아남으라고 두고 간 걸지도?

en: Or, maybe they're coming back some day?
I wish I had time to wait, but I don't know if it'd be one day or, you know, never.
ko: 기다릴 시간이 있으면 좋겠지만, 하루가 될지, 아니면 영영 안 올지 모르잖아.

en: Ok, if we take it, we just mark it in the map and we could return it some day.
ko: 좋아, 가져가더라도 지도에 표시해 두고 언젠가 돌려주면 돼.

en: Or, at least, check in to see if someone comes by.
ko: 아니면 적어도 누가 오는지 들러서 확인하든가.

en: Take it anyway.
At this point it seems safest to assume any unexplained absence means a bear got them.
ko: 이쯤 되면 설명할 수 없는 부재는 곰한테 당했다고 보는 게 제일 안전할 것 같아.

en: Yeah, pretty certain that's what happened.
It almost happened to us! Seems like it's pretty common.
ko: 우리도 당할 뻔했잖아! 꽤 흔한 일 같아.

en: Ok, so...
Take the fishing pole.
I can always bring this back later.
This can certainly be put to better use that as a decoration.
ko: 장식품으로 두는 것보다 훨씬 쓸모 있게 쓸 수 있을 거야.

en: Maybe I should try it out here?
Fish.
Get back on the trail.
Another day. We've got to get back on the trail.
I don't want to spend any more time near frozen water than I have to.
ko: 필요 이상으로 얼어붙은 물 근처에 있고 싶지 않아.

en: I can at least try to fight off animals. If the ice breaks, well, I hope my karma is ok.
ko: 동물이라면 적어도 맞서 싸워 볼 수는 있어. 얼음이 깨지면, 뭐, 내 업보가 괜찮길 바라야지.

en: We've been fine with our gun.
And our scavenging.
And we've got a trap that does the trick.
Ok, Chomper, you've also done a great job.
Ok, pups. You've done a great job on your own too.
ko: 좋아, 얘들아. 너희도 스스로 정말 잘했어.

en: Alright, let's get back out there.
[anim:] the lure immediately dips in.
Or not!
Time to get back out there.
Try again. You've got this.
ko: 다시 해 봐. 넌 할 수 있어.

en: Just try again.
Any idea what that is?
Right, you can't answer.
We don't need what's up there. It's probably just wet, burnt things.
ko: 저기 있는 건 필요 없어. 아마 젖고 탄 것들뿐일 거야.

en: I'll just take a poke around...
There's a fire starter in these ashes...
Take fire starter.
Leave fire starter.
I don't mind having one less thing to worry about.
ko: 걱정거리가 하나 줄어드는 건 나쁘지 않지.

en: I'm having a hard enough time finding food.
Considering my bullets keep missing, it's about time something got easier.
ko: 총알이 자꾸 빗나가는 걸 생각하면, 뭐 하나쯤은 쉬워질 때가 됐어.

en: I guess I don't have to worry about that birch bark I couldn't find.
ko: 찾지 못한 자작나무 껍질 걱정은 이제 안 해도 되겠네.

en: Looks like I can finally get warm. This shivering is burning calories I don't have.
ko: 드디어 몸을 녹일 수 있겠다. 떨면서 없는 칼로리까지 태우고 있었거든.

en: I'm fine without it.
What do you guys smell?
I don't see anything.
Let the dogs follow the scent.
No wild goose or reindeer hunts today, pups.
I see what you were after.
I can't believe someone just left this animal like this.
ko: 누가 이 동물을 이렇게 내버려 두고 갔다니 믿을 수가 없어.

en: It must've suffered.
They didn't even get the meat.
They lost a good trap.
Traps can be a cruel necessity out here, but you can't just leave the creature forever.
ko: 여기서 덫은 잔인한 필수품일 수 있지만, 잡힌 동물을 영영 내버려 두면 안 돼.

en: If we use a trap we will check it often.
If something is caught, we have to finish it quickly.
ko: 뭔가 잡히면 빨리 끝내 줘야 해.

en: I don't love the idea of using one, but we need a steady way to get food.
ko: 덫을 쓴다는 게 썩 내키진 않지만, 꾸준히 식량을 얻을 방법이 필요해.

en: I can't believe they'd be so careless to kill and animal and not even get its meat.
ko: 동물을 죽여 놓고 고기도 안 가져갈 만큼 부주의하다니 믿을 수가 없어.

en: I'll hope, well, hope's not the right word, but maybe something happened to the trapper.
ko: 바라건대, 아니, 바란다는 말은 적절하지 않지만, 덫 놓은 사람한테 무슨 일이 생긴 걸지도 몰라.

en: Maybe they got lost. I don't want to believe this was done for fun or forgetfulness.
ko: 길을 잃었을지도 모르지. 재미로 했거나 깜빡한 거라고는 믿고 싶지 않아.

en: But, a trap would be really useful.
Not only did they not collect their kill, though the scavengers seemed to have quite a good time...
ko: 잡은 걸 챙기지 않은 것도 모자라서, 청소동물들은 꽤 즐거웠던 모양이지만...

en: They left a trap out here.
Well, it seems they're not interested in using it and we could use any chance at food we can find.
ko: 음, 쓸 생각은 없는 것 같고, 우린 식량을 얻을 기회라면 뭐든 필요해.

en: We can set it up before we go to sleep.
In the morning, we'll see if we've caught anything.
We might be able to save some bullets and still feed all of us.
ko: 총알을 아끼면서도 다 같이 먹을 수 있을지도 몰라.

en: Take the trap.
Leave the trap.
Even if I take it, it doesn't mean I have to use it.
ko: 가져간다고 해서 꼭 써야 하는 건 아니야.

en: But I should try to plan for the worst, right?
I just don't like traps.
My gun will work fine.
Maybe they'll come back for it.
And this might make things a lot harder, but maybe that's ok.
ko: 이것 때문에 훨씬 힘들어질 수도 있지만, 그래도 괜찮을지도 몰라.

en: That's the challenge I've chosen and I'm sticking with my feelings on this.
ko: 이게 내가 선택한 도전이고, 이 문제에 대해선 내 감정을 따를 거야.

en: I can handle anything out here with what I have.
ko: 지금 가진 걸로 여기서 뭐든 감당할 수 있어.

en: I don't need things to be "easier".
What am I proving to myself if I make it easier?
ko: 더 쉽게 만들면 나 자신에게 뭘 증명하는 거겠어?

en: Though isn't prepartion the idea of making something easier so you're more likely to succeed?
ko: 그런데 준비란 원래 성공할 가능성을 높이려고 일을 더 쉽게 만드는 거 아니야?

en: Doesn't matter. We're starting this new life on our terms.
ko: 상관없어. 우리 방식대로 새 삶을 시작하는 거야.

en: We'll be ready for anything.
ko: 우린 뭐든 대비가 돼 있을 거야.

en: Someone owned this at some point.
Finders keepers probably applies out here, but I'm just going to leave this one.
ko: 여기선 먼저 찾은 사람이 임자겠지만, 이건 그냥 두고 갈게.

en: If I decide I need one later, maybe I'll find another abandoned and long forgotten trap.
ko: 나중에 필요하다고 생각되면, 오래전에 버려지고 잊힌 덫을 또 찾을지도 몰라.

en: It's ok. Even if we never use the trap, we took it from the wild.
ko: 괜찮아. 덫을 한 번도 안 쓰더라도, 야생에서 하나를 치운 거잖아.

en: And if we decide to use it, and we might need to, we just have to be mindful about it.
ko: 그리고 쓰기로 한다면, 그래야 할 수도 있고, 신중하게 쓰기만 하면 돼.

en: We'll set it before we go to bed and check it first thing when we wake up.
ko: 자기 전에 설치하고 일어나자마자 확인할 거야.

en: And we'll thank each creature for the help they're giving us. This is for food and for life.
ko: 그리고 우리를 도와주는 생명 하나하나에 감사할 거야. 이건 먹기 위해서, 살기 위해서야.

en: Leave the detritus. Who knows what's on the other end of this pile.
ko: 잔해는 그냥 둬. 이 더미 반대편에 뭐가 있을지 누가 알아.

en: But where did this come from?
Let Chomper choose.
I don't need to find the bear that ripped whatever this was open.
ko: 이게 뭐였든 찢어발긴 곰을 찾을 필요는 없어.

en: Is that a can of dog food?
And a harness?
We're not even on a race trail. Why would someone's gear bag be here?
ko: 여긴 경주 트레일도 아닌데. 왜 누군가의 장비 가방이 여기 있지?

en: Oh... I'm going to hope that racer was already a scratch before a bear took away their stuff.
ko: 아... 곰이 짐을 가져가기 전에 그 레이서가 이미 경기를 포기한 상태였길 바라야겠다.

en: So what else do people pack in these anyway?
ko: 그래서 사람들은 이런 데 뭘 챙기는 거지?

en: Are those dog booties?
Oh! Of course! I bet you pups can run farther if your paws are protected.

en: The Pack Life update 1.1.0 is here!

Thank you for supporting The Red Lantern.
This update improves stability, quality of life, fixes various bugs, and now lets you continue your game from the cabin once you find your way home.
Key Fixes are:
- Finish dog story arcs in training runs from the cabin and embark on a zen run.
- Unlock special accessories for your dogs.
- Players should no longer be able to hunt and end up teleporting to the end of an encounter.
- Dogs are better trained and follow a new path in the world.
- Cleaned up some encounter logic.
- Added some new encounter pathways.
- Additional bug fixes throughout the game.
- Some extra surprises.
ko:
레드 랜턴을 응원해 주셔서 감사합니다.
이번 업데이트는 안정성과 편의성을 개선하고, 다양한 버그를 수정했으며, 집을 찾은 뒤 오두막에서 게임을 계속할 수 있게 되었습니다.
주요 변경 사항:
- 오두막에서 훈련 주행으로 개들의 이야기를 완성하고 젠 주행을 떠날 수 있습니다.
- 개들의 특별한 액세서리를 해금할 수 있습니다.
- 사냥 후 사건의 끝으로 순간 이동하는 문제가 수정되었습니다.
- 개들이 더 잘 훈련되어 세계에서 새로운 경로를 따라갑니다.
- 일부 사건 로직을 정리했습니다.
- 새로운 사건 경로를 추가했습니다.
- 게임 전반의 추가 버그 수정.
- 그리고 몇 가지 깜짝 선물.

en: Welcome Home

Now that you've found home, you'll be able to live your life with the pups.
From the cabin you can:
- Go on training runs with your dogs to complete their stories.
- Adopt the dogs you skipped originally and have them at the cabin.
- Set new lead dogs on training runs.
- Give your dogs an accessory when they've completed their story.
- Play a game of catch.
- Get lots of pets in.
- Go out on a zen run where you can just watch your dogs run through the wild.
- And a winter surprise.

- 처음에 지나쳤던 개들을 입양해 오두막에서 함께 지내세요.
- 훈련 주행에서 새로운 선두견을 정하세요.

- 그리고 겨울의 깜짝 선물.
